atithiryasya santuṣṭastasya tuṣṭo hariḥ svayam ..44..
3.44.d:
अतिथिः पूजितो येन पूजिताः सर्वदेवताः ॥
अतिथिर्यस्य सन्तुष्टस्तस्य तुष्टो हरिः स्वयम् ॥44॥
3.44.m:
By whom a guest is honoured, all the gods are honoured;
the one with whom a guest is pleased, Hari himself is pleased with him.

3.44.s:
snānena sarvatīrtheṣu sarvadānena yatphalam ..
sarvavratopavāsena sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣayā .. 45' ..
sarvaistapobhirvividhairnityairnaimittikādibhiḥ ..
tadevātithisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .. 46 ..
3.44.d:
स्नानेन सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वदानेन यत्फलम् ॥
सर्वव्रतोपवासेन सर्वयज्ञेषु दीक्षया ॥ 45' ॥
सर्वैस्तपोभिर्विविधैर्नित्यैर्नैमित्तिकादिभिः ॥
तदेवातिथिसेवायाः कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.44.m:
Whatever fruit [is gained] by bathing in all sacred places, by all gifts,
by all vows and fasts, by consecration in all sacrifices,
by all diverse austerities, both obligatory and occasional,
those very [fruits] are not worth a sixteenth part of serving a guest.

3.44.s:
atithiryasya bhagnāśo yāti ruṣṭaśca mandirāt ..
koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam .. 47 ..
3.44.d:
अतिथिर्यस्य भग्नाशो याति रुष्टश्च मन्दिरात् ॥
कोटिजन्मार्जितं पुण्यं तस्य नश्यति निश्चितम् ॥ 47 ॥
3.44.m: He from whose house a guest departs frustrated in hope and angry,

3.44.s:
strīgoghnaśca kṛtaghnaśca brahmaghno gurutalpagaḥ ..
pitṛmātṛgurūṇāṃ ca nindako naraghātakaḥ .. 48 ..
3.44.d:
स्त्रीगोघ्नश्च कृतघ्नश्च ब्रह्मघ्नो गुरुतल्पगः ॥
पितृमातृगुरूणां च निन्दको नरघातकः ॥ 48 ॥
3.44.m:
The slayer of a woman, the slayer of a cow, the ungrateful, the slayer of a brahmin, the violator of the guru's bed,
the reviler of father, mother, and gurus, and the slayer of men,

3.44.s:
sandhyāhīnaḥ svaghātī ca satyaghno harinindakaḥ ..
brahmasvasthāpyahārī ca mithyāsākṣyapradāyakaḥ .. 49 ..
3.44.d:
सन्ध्याहीनः स्वघाती च सत्यघ्नो हरिनिन्दकः ॥
ब्रह्मस्वस्थाप्यहारी च मिथ्यासाक्ष्यप्रदायकः ॥ 49 ॥
3.44.m:
one who neglects the twilight prayers, the suicide, the destroyer of truth, the reviler of Hari,
the embezzler of a brahmin's property and deposits, and the giver of false testimony—

3.44.s:
mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca vṛṣavāhaśca sūpakṛt ..
śavadāhī grāmayājī brāhmaṇo vṛṣalīpatiḥ .. 3.44.50 ..
3.44.d:
मित्रद्रोही कृतघ्नश्च वृषवाहश्च सूपकृत् ॥
शवदाही ग्रामयाजी ब्राह्मणो वृषलीपतिः ॥ 3.44.50 ॥
3.44.m:
a betrayer of friends, an ungrateful person, one who rides a bull, a professional cook,
a burner of corpses, a village priest, and a brāhmaṇa who is the husband of an outcaste woman,

3.44.s:
śūdraśrāddhānnabhojī ca śūdraśrāddheṣu bhojakaḥ ..
kanyāvikrayakārī ca śrīharernāmavikrayī .. 51 ..
3.44.d:
शूद्रश्राद्धान्नभोजी च शूद्रश्राद्धेषु भोजकः ॥
कन्याविक्रयकारी च श्रीहरेर्नामविक्रयी ॥ 51 ॥
3.44.m:
one who eats food offered in a śūdra's śrāddha, one who feeds others at śūdra śrāddhas,
a seller of daughters, and one who sells the name of Śrī Hari,

3.44.s:
lākṣāmāṃsatilānāṃ ca lavaṇasya tilasya ca ..
vikretā brāhmaṇaścaiva turagāṇāṃ gavāṃ tathā .. 52 ..
3.44.d:
लाक्षामांसतिलानां च लवणस्य तिलस्य च ॥
विक्रेता ब्राह्मणश्चैव तुरगाणां गवां तथा ॥ 52 ॥
3.44.m:
and of lac, meat, sesame, and of salt and sesame—
a brāhmaṇa who is a seller of these, and also of horses and cows,

3.44.s:
ekādaśīkṛṣṇasevāhīno vipraśca bhārate..
ete mahāpātakinastriṣu lokeṣu ninditāḥ..53..
3.44.d:
एकादशीकृष्णसेवाहीनो विप्रश्च भारते॥
एते महापातकिनस्त्रिषु लोकेषु निन्दिताः॥53॥
3.44.m:
and a vipra in Bhārata who is devoid of devotion to Kṛṣṇa on Ekādaśī—
these are great sinners, condemned in the three worlds.

3.44.s:
kālasūtre ca narake patanti brahmaṇāṃ śatam ..
etebhyo'pyadhikaḥ so'pi yaścātithiparāṅmukhaḥ .. 54 ..
3.44.d:
कालसूत्रे च नरके पतन्ति ब्रह्मणां शतम् ॥
एतेभ्योऽप्यधिकः सोऽपि यश्चातिथिपराङ्मुखः ॥ 54 ॥
3.44.m:
And they fall into the Kālasūtra hell for a hundred [lifetimes of] Brahmā.
Even greater than these is that person who turns away from a guest.

3.44.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā santuṣṭaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ..
meghagambhīrayā vācā tamuvāca jagatpatiḥ .. 95 ..
3.44.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
शङ्करस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सन्तुष्टः श्रीहरिः स्वयम् ॥
मेघगम्भीरया वाचा तमुवाच जगत्पतिः ॥ 95 ॥
3.44.m:
Hearing the speech of Śaṅkara, Śrī Hari himself was pleased;
with a voice deep like a thundercloud, the Lord of the universe said to him:

3.44.s:
viṣṇuruvāca .. śvetadvīpādāgato'haṃ jñātvā kolāhalaṃ ca vaḥ ..
asya rāmasya rakṣārthaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktasya sāmpratam .. 56 ..
3.44.d:
विष्णुरुवाच ॥ श्वेतद्वीपादागतोऽहं ज्ञात्वा कोलाहलं च वः ॥
अस्य रामस्य रक्षार्थं कृष्णभक्तस्य साम्प्रतम् ॥ 56 ॥
3.44.m:
Viṣṇu said: / Having learned of your commotion, I have come from Śvetadvīpa,
now for the sake of protecting this Rāma, a devotee of Kṛṣṇa.

3.44.s:
naiteṣāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit ..
rakṣāmi tāṃścakrahasto gurumanyaṃ vinā śiva .. 57 ..
3.44.d:
नैतेषां कृष्णभक्तानामशुभं विद्यते क्वचित् ॥
रक्षामि तांश्चक्रहस्तो गुरुमन्यं विना शिव ॥ 57 ॥
3.44.m:
Misfortune never befalls these devotees of Kṛṣṇa anywhere.
Discus in hand, I protect them, O Śiva, except from another guru.

3.44.s:
nāhaṃ pātā gurau ruṣṭe balavadguruhelanam ..
tatparaḥ pātakī nāsti sevāhīno gurośca yaḥ .. 58 ..
3.44.d:
नाहं पाता गुरौ रुष्टे बलवद्गुरुहेलनम् ॥
तत्परः पातकी नास्ति सेवाहीनो गुरोश्च यः ॥ 58 ॥
3.44.m:
When the guru is angered, I am not the protector; disrespect to a guru is powerful.
There is no sinner greater than that person who is devoid of service to the guru.

3.44.s:
mānyaḥ pūjyaśca sarvebhyaḥ sarveṣāṃ janako bhavet ..
aho yasya prasādena sarvānpaśyati mānavaḥ .. 59 ..
3.44.d:
मान्यः पूज्यश्च सर्वेभ्यः सर्वेषां जनको भवेत् ॥
अहो यस्य प्रसादेन सर्वान्पश्यति मानवः ॥ 59 ॥
3.44.m:
The father should be respected and worshipped above all by everyone;
oh, through his grace a human being sees all!

3.44.s:
janako janmadānācca pālanācca pitā nṛṇām ..
tato vistārakaraṇātkalayā sa prajāpatiḥ .. 3.44.60 ..
3.44.d:
जनको जन्मदानाच्च पालनाच्च पिता नृणाम् ॥
ततो विस्तारकरणात्कलया स प्रजापतिः ॥ 3.44.60 ॥
3.44.m:
He is the generator because of giving birth, and the father of men because of protecting them;
and from bringing about expansion he is Prajāpati in a part.

3.44.s:
pituḥ śataguṇaṃ mātā poṣaṇādgarbhadhāraṇāt ..
vandyā pūjyā ca mānyā ca prasūssyādvai vasundharā .. 61 ..
3.44.d:
पितुः शतगुणं माता पोषणाद्गर्भधारणात् ॥
वन्द्या पूज्या च मान्या च प्रसूस्स्याद्वै वसुन्धरा ॥ 61 ॥
3.44.m:
A mother is a hundred times superior to a father, because of nourishing and carrying in the womb;
the mother who gives birth is indeed praiseworthy, worthy of worship, and to be respected like the earth.

3.44.s:
mātuḥ śataguṇaṃ vandyaḥ pūjyo mānyo'nnadāyakaḥ ..
yadvinā naśvaro deho viṣṇuśca kalayā'nnadaḥ .. 62 ..
3.44.d:
मातुः शतगुणं वन्द्यः पूज्यो मान्योऽन्नदायकः ॥
यद्विना नश्वरो देहो विष्णुश्च कलयाऽन्नदः ॥ 62 ॥
3.44.m:
The giver of food is a hundred times more praiseworthy, worthy of worship, and to be respected than a mother;
without food the body perishes, and the giver of food is Viṣṇu in a part.

3.44.s:
annadātuḥ śataguṇo'bhīṣṭadevaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
gurustasmācchataguṇo vidyāmantrapradāyakaḥ .. 63 ..
3.44.d:
अन्नदातुः शतगुणोऽभीष्टदेवः परः स्मृतः ॥
गुरुस्तस्माच्छतगुणो विद्यामन्त्रप्रदायकः ॥ 63 ॥
3.44.m:
The chosen deity is considered a hundred times superior to the giver of food;
a hundred times superior even to that is the guru who gives knowledge and mantras.

3.44.s:
ajñānatimirācchannaṃ jñānadīpena cakṣuṣā ..
yaḥ sarvārthaṃ darśayati tatparo naiva bāndhavaḥ ..64..
3.44.d:
अज्ञानतिमिराच्छन्नं ज्ञानदीपेन चक्षुषा ॥
यः सर्वार्थं दर्शयति तत्परो नैव बान्धवः ॥64॥
3.44.m:
He who reveals everything through the eye [that is] the lamp of knowledge,
dispelling the darkness of ignorance—there is no kinsman superior to him.

3.44.s:
gurudattena mantreṇa tapaseṣṭasukhaṃ labhet..
sarvajñatvaṃ sarvasiddhiṃ tatparo naiva bāndhavaḥ..65..
3.44.d:
गुरुदत्तेन मन्त्रेण तपसेष्टसुखं लभेत्॥
सर्वज्ञत्वं सर्वसिद्धिं तत्परो नैव बान्धवः॥65॥
3.44.m:
Through the mantra given by the guru, one attains the desired bliss by asceticism,
omniscience, and all perfections; there is no kinsman superior to him.

3.44.s:
sarvaṃ jayati sarvatra vidyayā gurudattayā ..
tasmātpūjyo hi jagati ko vā bandhustato'dhikaḥ .. 66 ..
3.44.d:
सर्वं जयति सर्वत्र विद्यया गुरुदत्तया ॥
तस्मात्पूज्यो हि जगति को वा बन्धुस्ततोऽधिकः ॥ 66 ॥
3.44.m:
One conquers everything everywhere by means of the knowledge given by the guru;
therefore he is indeed worthy of worship in the world; what kinsman could be greater than him?

3.44.s:
vidyāndho vā dhanāndho vā yo mūḍho na bhajedgurum ..
brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaiḥ sa lipto nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 67 ..
3.44.d:
विद्यान्धो वा धनान्धो वा यो मूढो न भजेद्गुरुम् ॥
ब्रह्महत्यादिभिः पापैः स लिप्तो नात्र संशयः ॥ 67 ॥
3.44.m:
That fool who, blinded by learning or blinded by wealth, does not revere his guru
is tainted by sins such as the killing of a brāhmaṇa; of this there is no doubt.

3.44.s:
daridraṃ patitaṃ kṣudraṃ narabuddhyā''caredgurum ..
tīrthasnāto'pi na śucirnādhikārī ca karmasu .. 68 ..
3.44.d:
दरिद्रं पतितं क्षुद्रं नरबुद्ध्या'ऽचरेद्गुरुम् ॥
तीर्थस्नातोऽपि न शुचिर्नाधिकारी च कर्मसु ॥ 68 ॥
3.44.m: He who treats his guru as poor, fallen, low, or with human regard

3.44.s:
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bhāryyāṃ gurupatnīṃ guruṃ param ..
yo na puṣṇāti kāpaṭyātsa mahāpātakī śiva .. 69 ..
3.44.d:
पितरं मातरं भार्य्यां गुरुपत्नीं गुरुं परम् ॥
यो न पुष्णाति कापट्यात्स महापातकी शिव ॥ 69 ॥
3.44.m:
Father, mother, wife, the guru's wife, and the supreme guru—
he who out of deceit does not support them is a great sinner, O Śiva.

3.44.s:
gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ ..
gurureva paraṃ brahma gururbhāskararūpakaḥ .. 3.44.70 ..
3.44.d:
गुरुर्ब्रह्मा गुरुर्विष्णुर्गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः ॥
गुरुरेव परं ब्रह्म गुरुर्भास्कररूपकः ॥ 3.44.70 ॥
3.44.m: the guru alone is the supreme Brahman; the guru has the form of the sun.

3.44.s:
guruścandrastathendraśca vāyuśca varuṇo'nalaḥ ..
sarvarūpo hi bhagavānparamātmā svayaṃ guruḥ .. 71 ..
3.44.d:
गुरुश्चन्द्रस्तथेन्द्रश्च वायुश्च वरुणोऽनलः ॥
सर्वरूपो हि भगवान्परमात्मा स्वयं गुरुः ॥ 71 ॥
3.44.m:
The guru is the moon, likewise Indra, Vāyu, Varuṇa, and fire;
the Lord, the Paramātman himself in all forms, is the guru.

3.44.s:
nāsti vedātparaṃ śāstraṃ nahi kṛṣṇātparaḥ suraḥ ..
nāsti gaṅgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ na puṣpaṃ tulasīdalāt .. 72 ..
3.44.d:
नास्ति वेदात्परं शास्त्रं नहि कृष्णात्परः सुरः ॥
नास्ति गङ्गासमं तीर्थं न पुष्पं तुलसीदलात् ॥ 72 ॥
3.44.m:
There is no sacred text superior to the Veda; there is no god superior to Kṛṣṇa;
there is no sacred bathing place equal to Gaṅgā; there is no flower [superior] to a Tulasī leaf.

3.44.s:
nāsti kṣamāvatī bhūmeḥ putrānnāstyaparaḥ priyaḥ ..
na ca daivātparā śaktirnaikādaśyāḥ paraṃ vratam .. 73 ..
3.44.d:
नास्ति क्षमावती भूमेः पुत्रान्नास्त्यपरः प्रियः ॥
न च दैवात्परा शक्तिर्नैकादश्याः परं व्रतम् ॥ 73 ॥
3.44.m:
No one is as forgiving as the earth; there is none dearer than a son;
and there is no power superior to fate; there is no vow superior to Ekādaśī.

3.44.s:
śālagrāmātparo yantro na kṣetraṃ bhāratātparam ..
paraṃ puṇyasthalānāṃ ca puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yathā .. 74 ..
3.44.d:
शालग्रामात्परो यन्त्रो न क्षेत्रं भारतात्परम् ॥
परं पुण्यस्थलानां च पुण्यं वृन्दावनं यथा ॥ 74 ॥
3.44.m:
There is no sacred device superior to the Śālagrāma; there is no sacred field superior to Bhārata;
and of all holy places, Vṛndāvana is the most holy;

3.44.s:
mokṣadānāṃ yathā kāśī vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā śivaḥ ..
na pārvatyāḥ parā sādhvī na gaṇeśātparo vaśī ..75..
3.44.d:
मोक्षदानां यथा काशी वैष्णवानां यथा शिवः ॥
न पार्वत्याः परा साध्वी न गणेशात्परो वशी ॥75॥
3.44.m:
as Kāśī is supreme among givers of liberation, as Śiva is supreme among Vaiṣṇavas,
no chaste woman is superior to Pārvatī; no self-controlled person is superior to Gaṇeśa;

3.44.s:
na ca vidyāsamo bandhurnāsti kaścidguroḥ paraḥ ..
vidyādātuḥ putradārau tatsamau nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 76 ..
3.44.d:
न च विद्यासमो बन्धुर्नास्ति कश्चिद्गुरोः परः ॥
विद्यादातुः पुत्रदारौ तत्समौ नात्र संशयः ॥ 76 ॥
3.44.m:
and there is no kinsman equal to knowledge; there is no one superior to a guru.
The son and wife of the giver of knowledge are equal to him; of this there is no doubt.

3.44.s:
gurustriyāṃ ca putre cāpyabhavadrāmahelanam ..
paraṃ sammārjanaṃ kartumāgato'haṃ tavālayam .. 77 ..
3.44.d:
गुरुस्त्रियां च पुत्रे चाप्यभवद्रामहेलनम् ॥
परं सम्मार्जनं कर्तुमागतोऽहं तवालयम् ॥ 77 ॥
3.44.m:
Disrespect was shown by Rāma toward the guru's wife and his son;
I have come to your abode to effect complete reconciliation.

3.44.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
ityevamuktvā śambhuṃ ca durgāṃ sambodhya nārada ..
uvāca bhagavāṃstatra satyasāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ .. 78 ..
3.44.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
इत्येवमुक्त्वा शम्भुं च दुर्गां सम्बोध्य नारद ॥
उवाच भगवांस्तत्र सत्यसारं परं वचः ॥ 78 ॥
3.44.m:
Having spoken thus to Śambhu, and addressing Durgā, O Nārada,
the Blessed Lord there spoke words of supreme truth and essence:

3.44.s:
śrīviṣṇuruvāca ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śubham ..
nītiyuktaṃ vedasāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham .. 79 ..
3.44.d:
श्रीविष्णुरुवाच ॥
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि मदीयं वचनं शुभम् ॥
नीतियुक्तं वेदसारं परिणामसुखावहम् ॥ 79 ॥
3.44.m:
Listen, O goddess! I shall speak my auspicious word,
Endowed with moral wisdom, the essence of the Veda, yielding happiness in the end.

3.44.s:
yathā te gajavaktraśca kārttikeyaśca pārvati .. .
tathā paraśurāmaśca bhārgavo nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 3.44.80 ..
3.44.d:
यथा ते गजवक्त्रश्च कार्त्तिकेयश्च पार्वति ॥ ।
तथा परशुरामश्च भार्गवो नात्र संशयः ॥ 3.44.80 ॥
3.44.m:
Just as the elephant-faced one and Kārttikeya are [dear] to you, O Pārvatī,
so also is Paraśurāma, descendant of Bhṛgu; of this there is no doubt.

3.44.s:
nāstyeṣu snehabhedaśca tava vā śaṃkarasya ca ..
vicāryya sarvaṃ sarvajñe kuru mātaryathocitam .. 81 ..
3.44.d:
नास्त्येषु स्नेहभेदश्च तव वा शंकरस्य च ॥
विचार्य्य सर्वं सर्वज्ञे कुरु मातर्यथोचितम् ॥ 81 ॥
3.44.m:
There is no difference in affection toward them on your part or Śaṅkara's.
Having deliberated upon everything, O all-knowing one, do what is proper, O mother!

3.44.s:
putreṇa sārddhaṃ putrasya vivādo daivadoṣataḥ ..
daivaṃ hantuṃ ko hi śakto daivaṃ ca balavattaram .. 82 ..
3.44.d:
पुत्रेण सार्द्धं पुत्रस्य विवादो दैवदोषतः ॥
दैवं हन्तुं को हि शक्तो दैवं च बलवत्तरम् ॥ 82 ॥
3.44.m:
The dispute of son with son came about through the fault of fate.
Who indeed is capable of destroying fate? For fate is stronger than all.

3.44.s:
putrābhidhānaṃ vedeṣu paśya vatse varānane ..
ekadanta iti khyātaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam .. 83 ..
3.44.d:
पुत्राभिधानं वेदेषु पश्य वत्से वरानने ॥
एकदन्त इति ख्यातं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् ॥ 83 ॥
3.44.m:
Consider your son's name in the Vedas, O child, O fair-faced one!
Renowned as Ekadanta, he is bowed to by all the gods.

3.44.s:
putranāmāṣṭakaṃ stotraṃ sāmavedoktamīśvari ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahitaṃ mātaḥ sarvavighnaharaṃ param .. 84 ..
3.44.d:
पुत्रनामाष्टकं स्तोत्रं सामवेदोक्तमीश्वरि ॥
शृणुष्वावहितं मातः सर्वविघ्नहरं परम् ॥ 84 ॥
3.44.m:
The hymn of praise of the son's eight names, proclaimed in the Sāmaveda, O sovereign lady—
Listen to it attentively, O mother, supreme and removing all obstacles.

3.44.s:
viṣṇuruvāca ..
gaṇeśamekadantaṃ ca herambaṃ vighnanāyakam ..
lambodaraṃ śūrpakarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ guhāgrajam .. 85 ..
3.44.d:
विष्णुरुवाच ॥
गणेशमेकदन्तं च हेरम्बं विघ्ननायकम् ॥
लम्बोदरं शूर्पकर्णं गजवक्त्रं गुहाग्रजम् ॥ 85 ॥
3.44.m:
Gaṇeśa, Ekadanta, Heramba, Vighnanāyaka,
Lambodara, Śūrpakarṇa, Gajavaktra, Guhāgraja—

3.44.s:
aṣṭākhyārthaṃ ca putrasya śṛṇu mātarharapriye ..
stotrāṇāṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca sarvavighnaharaṃ param .. 86 ..
3.44.d:
अष्टाख्यार्थं च पुत्रस्य शृणु मातर्हरप्रिये ॥
स्तोत्राणां सारभूतं च सर्वविघ्नहरं परम् ॥ 86 ॥
3.44.m:
Hear the meanings of these eight names of your son, O mother, beloved of Hara,
Which are the essence of hymns of praise, supreme, and remove all obstacles.

3.44.s:
jñānārthavācako gaśca ṇaśca nirvāṇavācakaḥ ..
tayorīśaṃ paraṃ brahma gaṇeśaṃ praṇamāmyaham .. 87 ..
3.44.d:
ज्ञानार्थवाचको गश्च णश्च निर्वाणवाचकः ॥
तयोरीशं परं ब्रह्म गणेशं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ 87 ॥
3.44.m:
The syllable 'ga' denotes knowledge, and 'ṇa' denotes nirvāṇa.
I bow to Gaṇeśa, the lord of both, the supreme Brahman.

3.44.s:
ekaśabdaḥ pradhānārtho dantaśca balavācakaḥ ..
balaṃ pradhānaṃ sarvasmādekadantaṃ namāmyaham .. 88 ..
3.44.d:
एकशब्दः प्रधानार्थो दन्तश्च बलवाचकः ॥
बलं प्रधानं सर्वस्मादेकदन्तं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 88 ॥
3.44.m:
The word 'eka' signifies preeminence, and 'danta' denotes strength.
His strength is preeminent above all; I bow to Ekadanta.

3.44.s:
dīnārthavācako heśca rambaḥ pālakavācakaḥ ..
pālakaṃ dīnalokānāṃ herambaṃ praṇamāmyaham .. 89 ..
3.44.d:
दीनार्थवाचको हेश्च रम्बः पालकवाचकः ॥
पालकं दीनलोकानां हेरम्बं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ 89 ॥
3.44.m:
The syllable 'he' denotes the helpless, and 'ramba' denotes a protector.
I bow to Heramba, the protector of the helpless folk.

3.44.s:
vipattivācako vighno nāyakaḥ khaṇḍanārthakaḥ ..
vipatkhaṇḍanakāraṃ taṃ praṇame vighnanāyakam .. .. 3.44.90 ..
3.44.d:
विपत्तिवाचको विघ्नो नायकः खण्डनार्थकः ॥
विपत्खण्डनकारं तं प्रणमे विघ्ननायकम् ॥ ॥ 3.44.90 ॥
3.44.m:
The word 'vighna' denotes misfortune, and 'nāyaka' means destruction [thereof].
I bow to Vighnanāyaka, who destroys misfortune.

3.44.s:
viṣṇudattaiśca naivedyairyasya lambaṃ purodaram ..
pitrā dattaiśca vividhairvande lambodaraṃ ca tam .. 91 ..
3.44.d:
विष्णुदत्तैश्च नैवेद्यैर्यस्य लम्बं पुरोदरम् ॥
पित्रा दत्तैश्च विविधैर्वन्दे लम्बोदरं च तम् ॥ 91 ॥
3.44.m:
Whose belly is prominent in front because of the food offerings given by Viṣṇu
And the various [offerings] given by his father—to that Lambodara I pay homage.

3.44.s:
śūrpākārau ca yatkarṇau vighnavāraṇakārakau ..
sampaddau jñānarūpau ca śūrpakarṇaṃ namāmyaham ..92..
3.44.d:
शूर्पाकारौ च यत्कर्णौ विघ्नवारणकारकौ ॥
सम्पद्दौ ज्ञानरूपौ च शूर्पकर्णं नमाम्यहम् ॥92॥
3.44.m:
Whose ears have the shape of winnowing baskets, warding off obstacles,
Granting prosperity and embodying wisdom—I bow to Śūrpakarṇa.

3.44.s:
viṣṇuprasādaṃ muninā dattaṃ yanmūrdhni puṣpakam ..
tadgajendramukhaṃ kāntaṃ gajavaktraṃ namāmyaham ..93 ..
3.44.d:
विष्णुप्रसादं मुनिना दत्तं यन्मूर्ध्नि पुष्पकम् ॥
तद्गजेन्द्रमुखं कान्तं गजवक्त्रं नमाम्यहम् ॥93 ॥
3.44.m:
The gracious gift of Viṣṇu, a flower, which was placed upon his head by the sage,
Became that lovely elephant-king's head; I bow to Gajavaktra.

3.44.s:
guhasyāgre ca jāto'yamāvirbhūto harālaye ..
vande guhāgrajaṃ devaṃ sarvadevāgrapūjitam.. .. 94 ..
3.44.d:
गुहस्याग्रे च जातोऽयमाविर्भूतो हरालये ॥
वन्दे गुहाग्रजं देवं सर्वदेवाग्रपूजितम्॥ ॥ 94 ॥
3.44.m:
He was born before Guha, appearing in Hara's abode.
I worship the god Guhāgraja, worshiped first among all the gods.

3.44.s:
etannāmāṣṭakaṃ durge nānāśaktiyutaṃ param ..
etannāmāṣṭakaṃ stotraṃ nānārthasahitaṃ śubham .. 95 ..
3.44.d:
एतन्नामाष्टकं दुर्गे नानाशक्तियुतं परम् ॥
एतन्नामाष्टकं स्तोत्रं नानार्थसहितं शुभम् ॥ 95 ॥
3.44.m:
This hymn of eight names, O Durgā, is endowed with diverse potencies and is supreme.
This hymn of praise of eight names is full of various meanings and auspicious.

3.44.s:
trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ sa sukhī sarvato jayī ..
tato vighnāḥ palāyante vainateyādyathoragāḥ .. 96 ..
3.44.d:
त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नित्यं स सुखी सर्वतो जयी ॥
ततो विघ्नाः पलायन्ते वैनतेयाद्यथोरगाः ॥ 96 ॥
3.44.m:
Whoever constantly recites it at the three junctures of the day becomes happy and victorious everywhere.
Obstacles flee from him just as serpents flee from Vainateya.

3.44.s:
gaṇeśvaraprasādena mahājñānī bhaveddhruvam ..
putrārthī labhate putraṃ bhāryyārthī kuśalāṃ striyam ..97..
3.44.d:
गणेश्वरप्रसादेन महाज्ञानी भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रं भार्य्यार्थी कुशलां स्त्रियम् ॥97॥
3.44.m: By the grace of Gaṇeśvara, one surely becomes a possessor of great wisdom.

3.44.s:
mahājaḍaḥ kavīndraśca vidyāvāṃśca bhaveddhruvam ..
putrastvaṃ paśya vede ca tathā kopaṃ ca no kuru.. .. 98 ..
3.44.d:
महाजडः कवीन्द्रश्च विद्यावांश्च भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥
पुत्रस्त्वं पश्य वेदे च तथा कोपं च नो कुरु॥ ॥ 98 ॥
3.44.m:
Even a great fool surely becomes a master poet and possessed of learning.
Look upon your son [thus] in the Veda, and do not be angry.

3.45.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
pārvatīṃ bodhayitvā tu viṣṇū rāmamuvāca ha ..
hitaṃ sāraṃ nītisāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham .. 1 ..
3.45.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
पार्वतीं बोधयित्वा तु विष्णू राममुवाच ह ॥
हितं सारं नीतिसारं परिणामसुखावहम् ॥ 1 ॥

3.45.s:
viṣṇuruvāca ..
rāma tvamadhunā satyamaparādhī śrutermmate ..
kopātkṛtvā dantabhaṅgaṃ gaṇeśasya sthito'śive .. 2 ..
3.45.d:
विष्णुरुवाच ॥
राम त्वमधुना सत्यमपराधी श्रुतेर्म्मते ॥
कोपात्कृत्वा दन्तभङ्गं गणेशस्य स्थितोऽशिवे ॥ 2 ॥

3.45.s:
stotreṇaiva mayoktena stutvā gaṇapatiṃ param ..
kāṇvaśākhoktavidhinā stuhi durgāṃ jagatprasūm .. 3 ..
3.45.d:
स्तोत्रेणैव मयोक्तेन स्तुत्वा गणपतिं परम् ॥
काण्वशाखोक्तविधिना स्तुहि दुर्गां जगत्प्रसूम् ॥ 3 ॥

3.45.s:
śrīkṛṣṇasya parā śaktirbuddhirūpā jagatprabhoḥ ..
asyāṃ ca tava ruṣṭāyāṃ hatā buddhirbhaviṣyati .. 4 ..
3.45.d:
श्रीकृष्णस्य परा शक्तिर्बुद्धिरूपा जगत्प्रभोः ॥
अस्यां च तव रुष्टायां हता बुद्धिर्भविष्यति ॥ 4 ॥

3.45.s:
sarvaśaktisvarūpeyamanayā śaktimajjagat..
anayā śaktimānkṛṣṇo nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ .. 5 ..
3.45.d:
सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपेयमनया शक्तिमज्जगत्॥
अनया शक्तिमान्कृष्णो निर्गुणः प्रकृतेः परः ॥ 5 ॥

3.45.s:
sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ na śaktaśca brahmā śaktyā'nayā vinā ..
vayamasyāṃ prasūtāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ .. 6 ..
3.45.d:
सृष्टिं कर्तुं न शक्तश्च ब्रह्मा शक्त्याऽनया विना ॥
वयमस्यां प्रसूताश्च ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ॥ 6 ॥

3.45.s:
surasaṃghe'suragraste kāle ghoratare dvija ..
tejastu sarvadevānāmāvirbhūtā purā satī .. 7 ..
3.45.d:
सुरसंघेऽसुरग्रस्ते काले घोरतरे द्विज ॥
तेजस्तु सर्वदेवानामाविर्भूता पुरा सती ॥ 7 ॥

3.45.s:
kṛṣṇājñayā'surānhatvā dattvā tebhyaḥ padaṃ tataḥ ..
dakṣapatnyāṃ janiṃ lebhe dakṣasya tapasā purā .. 8 ..
3.45.d:
कृष्णाज्ञयाऽसुरान्हत्वा दत्त्वा तेभ्यः पदं ततः ॥
दक्षपत्न्यां जनिं लेभे दक्षस्य तपसा पुरा ॥ 8 ॥

3.45.s:
bhāryyā bhūtvā śaṃkarasya punaḥ patyuśca nindayā ..
dehaṃ tyaktvā śailapatnyāṃ janiṃ lebhe purā satī .. 9 ..
3.45.d:
भार्य्या भूत्वा शंकरस्य पुनः पत्युश्च निन्दया ॥
देहं त्यक्त्वा शैलपत्न्यां जनिं लेभे पुरा सती ॥ 9 ॥

3.45.s:
śaṃkarastapasā labdho yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ..
labdho gaṇapatiḥ putraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ kṛṣṇasevayā .. 3.45.10 ..
3.45.d:
शंकरस्तपसा लब्धो योगीन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुः ॥
लब्धो गणपतिः पुत्रः कृष्णांशः कृष्णसेवया ॥ 3.45.10 ॥

3.45.s:
yaṃ dhyāyasyeva nityaṃ kiṃ taṃ na jānāsi bālaka ..
sa eva bhagavānkṛṣṇaścāṃśena girijāsutaḥ .. 11 ..
3.45.d:
यं ध्यायस्येव नित्यं किं तं न जानासि बालक ॥
स एव भगवान्कृष्णश्चांशेन गिरिजासुतः ॥ 11 ॥

3.45.s:
kṛtāñjalirnato bhūtvā stuhi durgāṃ śivapriyām ..
śivāṃ śivapradāṃ śaivāṃ śivabījāṃ śiveśvarīm .. 12 ..
3.45.d:
कृताञ्जलिर्नतो भूत्वा स्तुहि दुर्गां शिवप्रियाम् ॥
शिवां शिवप्रदां शैवां शिवबीजां शिवेश्वरीम् ॥ 12 ॥

3.45.s:
śivāyāḥ stotrarājena purā śūlikṛtena vai ..
tripurasya vadhe ghore brahmaṇā preritena ca .. 13 ..
3.45.d:
शिवायाः स्तोत्रराजेन पुरा शूलिकृतेन वै ॥
त्रिपुरस्य वधे घोरे ब्रह्मणा प्रेरितेन च ॥ 13 ॥

3.45.s:
ityuktvā śrīpadaṃ śīghraṃ jagāma śrīniketanam ..
gate harau hariṃ smṛtvā rāmastāṃ stotumudyataḥ .. 14 ..
3.45.d:
इत्युक्त्वा श्रीपदं शीघ्रं जगाम श्रीनिकेतनम् ॥
गते हरौ हरिं स्मृत्वा रामस्तां स्तोतुमुद्यतः ॥ 14 ॥

3.45.s:
stotreṇa viṣṇudattena sarvavighnahareṇa ca ..
dharmmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ kāraṇena ca nārada .. 15 ..
3.45.d:
स्तोत्रेण विष्णुदत्तेन सर्वविघ्नहरेण च ॥
धर्म्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां कारणेन च नारद ॥ 15 ॥

3.45.s:
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā snātvā gaṅgodake śubhe ..
guruṃ praṇamya bhakteśaṃ dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ..16..
3.45.d:
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा स्नात्वा गङ्गोदके शुभे ॥
गुरुं प्रणम्य भक्तेशं धृत्वा धौते च वाससी ॥16॥

3.45.s:
ācamya natvā mūrdhnā tāṃ bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ..
pulakāñcitasarvāṃgaścānandāśrusamanvitaḥ ..17..
3.45.d:
आचम्य नत्वा मूर्ध्ना तां भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः ॥
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वांगश्चानन्दाश्रुसमन्वितः ॥17॥

3.45.s:
paraśurāma uvāca ..
śrīkṛṣṇasya ca goloke paripūrṇatamasya ca ..
āvirbhūtā vigrahataḥ purā sṛṣṭyunmukhasya ca .. 18 ..
3.45.d:
परशुराम उवाच ॥
श्रीकृष्णस्य च गोलोके परिपूर्णतमस्य च ॥
आविर्भूता विग्रहतः पुरा सृष्ट्युन्मुखस्य च ॥ 18 ॥

3.45.s:
sūryyakoṭiprabhāyuktā vastrālaṅkārabhūṣitā ..
vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā sasmitā sumanoharā .. 19 ..
3.45.d:
सूर्य्यकोटिप्रभायुक्ता वस्त्रालङ्कारभूषिता ॥
वह्निशुद्धांशुकाधाना सस्मिता सुमनोहरा ॥ 19 ॥

3.45.s:
navayauvanasampannā sindūrāruṇyaśobhitā ..
lalitaṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam .. 3.45.20 ..
3.45.d:
नवयौवनसम्पन्ना सिन्दूरारुण्यशोभिता ॥
ललितं कबरीभारं मालतीमाल्यमण्डितम् ॥ 3.45.20 ॥

3.45.s:
aho'nirvacanīyā tvaṃ cārumūrttiṃ ca bibhratī ..
mokṣapradā mumukṣūṇāṃ mahāviṣṇorvidhiḥ svayam .. 21 ..
3.45.d:
अहोऽनिर्वचनीया त्वं चारुमूर्त्तिं च बिभ्रती ॥
मोक्षप्रदा मुमुक्षूणां महाविष्णोर्विधिः स्वयम् ॥ 21 ॥

3.45.s:
mumoha kṣaṇamātreṇa dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ sarvamohinīm ..
bālaissaṃbhūya sahasā sasmitā dhāvitā purā .. 22 ..
3.45.d:
मुमोह क्षणमात्रेण दृष्ट्वा त्वां सर्वमोहिनीम् ॥
बालैस्संभूय सहसा सस्मिता धाविता पुरा ॥ 22 ॥

3.45.s:
sadbhiḥ khyātā tena rādhā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ..
kṛṣṇastāṃ sahasā bhīto vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra ha .. 23 ..
3.45.d:
सद्भिः ख्याता तेन राधा मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी ॥
कृष्णस्तां सहसा भीतो वीर्य्याधानं चकार ह ॥ 23 ॥

3.45.s:
tato ḍimbhaṃ mahajjajñe tato jāto mahāvirāṭ ..
yasyaiva lomakūpeṣu brahmāṇḍānyakhilāni ca .. 24 ..
3.45.d:
ततो डिम्भं महज्जज्ञे ततो जातो महाविराट् ॥
यस्यैव लोमकूपेषु ब्रह्माण्डान्यखिलानि च ॥ 24 ॥

3.45.s:
rādhāratikrameṇaiva tanniśvāso babhūva ha ..
sa niśśvāso mahāvāyuḥ sa virāḍ viśvadhārakaḥ .. 25 ..
3.45.d:
राधारतिक्रमेणैव तन्निश्वासो बभूव ह ॥
स निश्श्वासो महावायुः स विराड् विश्वधारकः ॥ 25 ॥

3.45.s:
bhayagharmmajalenaiva pupluve viśvagolakam ..
sa virāḍ viśvanilayo jalarāśirbabhūva ha .. 26 ..
3.45.d:
भयघर्म्मजलेनैव पुप्लुवे विश्वगोलकम् ॥
स विराड् विश्वनिलयो जलराशिर्बभूव ह ॥ 26 ॥

3.45.s:
tatastvaṃ pañcadhābhūya pañca mūrtīśca bibhratī..
prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛmūrtiryā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ..
kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ rādhāṃ tāṃ vadanti purāvidaḥ .. 27 ..
3.45.d:
ततस्त्वं पञ्चधाभूय पञ्च मूर्तीश्च बिभ्रती॥
प्राणाधिष्ठातृमूर्तिर्या कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ॥
कृष्णप्राणाधिकां राधां तां वदन्ति पुराविदः ॥ 27 ॥

3.45.s:
vedādhiṣṭhātṛmūrtiryā vedaśāstraprasūrapi ..
tāṃ sāvitrīṃ śuddharūpāṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ .. 28 ..
3.45.d:
वेदाधिष्ठातृमूर्तिर्या वेदशास्त्रप्रसूरपि ॥
तां सावित्रीं शुद्धरूपां प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ॥ 28 ॥

3.45.s:
aiśvaryyādhiṣṭhātṛmūrtiḥ śāntistvaṃ śāntarūpiṇī ..
lakṣmīṃ vadanti santastāṃ śuddhāṃ sattvasvarūpiṇīm .. 29..
3.45.d:
ऐश्वर्य्याधिष्ठातृमूर्तिः शान्तिस्त्वं शान्तरूपिणी ॥
लक्ष्मीं वदन्ति सन्तस्तां शुद्धां सत्त्वस्वरूपिणीम् ॥ 29॥

3.45.s:
rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā śuklamūrtissatāṃ prasūḥ ..
sarasvatīṃ tāṃ śāstrajñāṃ śāstrajñāḥ pravadantyaho .. 3.45.30 ..
3.45.d:
रागाधिष्ठातृदेवी या शुक्लमूर्तिस्सतां प्रसूः ॥
सरस्वतीं तां शास्त्रज्ञां शास्त्रज्ञाः प्रवदन्त्यहो ॥ 3.45.30 ॥

3.45.s:
buddhirvidyā sarvaśakteryā mūrtiradhidevatā ..
sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyā sarvamaṅgalarūpiṇī .. 31 ..
3.45.d:
बुद्धिर्विद्या सर्वशक्तेर्या मूर्तिरधिदेवता ॥
सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्या सर्वमङ्गलरूपिणी ॥ 31 ॥

3.45.s: sarvamaṅgalabījasya śivasya nilaye'dhunā ..32..
3.45.d: सर्वमङ्गलबीजस्य शिवस्य निलयेऽधुना ॥32॥

3.45.s:
śive śivāsvarūpā tvaṃ lakṣmīrnārāyaṇāntike ..
sarasvatī ca sāvitrī vedasūrbrahmaṇaḥ priyā ..33..
3.45.d:
शिवे शिवास्वरूपा त्वं लक्ष्मीर्नारायणान्तिके ॥
सरस्वती च सावित्री वेदसूर्ब्रह्मणः प्रिया ॥33॥

3.45.s:
rādhā rāseśvarasyaiva paripūrṇatamasya ca ..
paramānandarūpasya paramānandarūpiṇī..34..
3.45.d:
राधा रासेश्वरस्यैव परिपूर्णतमस्य च ॥
परमानन्दरूपस्य परमानन्दरूपिणी॥34॥

3.45.s: tvatkalāṃśāṃśakalayā devānāmapi yoṣitaḥ .. 35 ..
3.45.d: त्वत्कलांशांशकलया देवानामपि योषितः ॥ 35 ॥

3.45.s:
tvaṃ vidyā yoṣitaḥ sarvāssarveṣāṃ bījarūpiṇī ..
chāyā sūryyasya candrasya rohiṇī sarva mohinī..36..
3.45.d:
त्वं विद्या योषितः सर्वास्सर्वेषां बीजरूपिणी ॥
छाया सूर्य्यस्य चन्द्रस्य रोहिणी सर्व मोहिनी॥36॥

3.45.s:
śacī śakrasya kāmasya kāminī ratirīśvarī..
varuṇānī jaleśasya vāyoḥ strī prāṇavallabhā..37..
3.45.d:
शची शक्रस्य कामस्य कामिनी रतिरीश्वरी॥
वरुणानी जलेशस्य वायोः स्त्री प्राणवल्लभा॥37॥

3.45.s:
vahneḥ priyā hi svāhā ca kuberasya ca sundarī..
yamasya tu suśīlā ca nairṛtasya ca kaiṭabhī ..38..
3.45.d:
वह्नेः प्रिया हि स्वाहा च कुबेरस्य च सुन्दरी॥
यमस्य तु सुशीला च नैरृतस्य च कैटभी ॥38॥

3.45.s:
aiśānī syācchaśikalā śatarūpā manoḥ priyā..
devahūtiḥ kardamasya vasiṣṭhasyāpyarundhatī .. 39 ..
3.45.d:
ऐशानी स्याच्छशिकला शतरूपा मनोः प्रिया॥
देवहूतिः कर्दमस्य वसिष्ठस्याप्यरुन्धती ॥ 39 ॥

3.45.s:
lopāmudrā'pyagastyasya devamātā'ditistathā ..
ahalyā gautamasyāpi sarvādhārā vasundharā .. 3.45.40 ..
3.45.d:
लोपामुद्राऽप्यगस्त्यस्य देवमाताऽदितिस्तथा ॥
अहल्या गौतमस्यापि सर्वाधारा वसुन्धरा ॥ 3.45.40 ॥

3.45.s:
gaṅgā ca tulasī cāpi pṛthivyāṃ yā saridvarā ..
etāḥ sarvāśca yā hyanyā sarvāstvatkalayā'mbike .. 41 ..
3.45.d:
गङ्गा च तुलसी चापि पृथिव्यां या सरिद्वरा ॥
एताः सर्वाश्च या ह्यन्या सर्वास्त्वत्कलयाऽम्बिके ॥ 41 ॥

3.45.s:
gṛhalakṣmī gṛhe nṝṇāṃ rājalakṣmīśca rājasu ..
tapasvināṃ tapasyā tvaṃ gāyatrī brāhmaṇasya ca .. 42 ..
3.45.d:
गृहलक्ष्मी गृहे नॄणां राजलक्ष्मीश्च राजसु ॥
तपस्विनां तपस्या त्वं गायत्री ब्राह्मणस्य च ॥ 42 ॥
3.45.m: you are the asceticism of ascetics, and the Gāyatrī of the brāhmaṇa. // 42

3.45.s:
satāṃ sattvasvarūpā tvamasatāṃ kalahāṅkurā ..
jyotīrūpā nirguṇasya śaktistvaṃ saguṇasya ca .. 43 ..
3.45.d:
सतां सत्त्वस्वरूपा त्वमसतां कलहाङ्कुरा ॥
ज्योतीरूपा निर्गुणस्य शक्तिस्त्वं सगुणस्य च ॥ 43 ॥
3.45.m:
You have the nature of sattva among the virtuous, and are the sprout of quarrel among the wicked;
you are the form of light of the nirguṇa, and the power of the saguṇa. // 43

3.45.s:
sūryye prabhāsvarūpā tvaṃ dāhikā ca hutāśane ..
jale śaityasvarūpā ca śobhārūpā niśākare .. 44 ..
3.45.d:
सूर्य्ये प्रभास्वरूपा त्वं दाहिका च हुताशने ॥
जले शैत्यस्वरूपा च शोभारूपा निशाकरे ॥ 44 ॥
3.45.m:
You are the nature of brilliance in the sun, and the burning power in fire;
you are coolness in water, and beauty in the moon. // 44

3.45.s:
tvaṃ bhūmau gandharūpā cāpyākāśe śabdarūpiṇī ..
kṣutpipāsādayastvaṃ ca jīvināṃ sarvaśaktayaḥ .. 45 ..
3.45.d:
त्वं भूमौ गन्धरूपा चाप्याकाशे शब्दरूपिणी ॥
क्षुत्पिपासादयस्त्वं च जीविनां सर्वशक्तयः ॥ 45 ॥
3.45.m:
You are the form of fragrance in the earth, and the form of sound in space;
you are hunger, thirst, and the rest, and all the powers of living beings. // 45

3.45.s:
sarvabījasvarūpā tvaṃ saṃsāre sārarūpiṇī ..
smṛtirmedhā ca buddhirvā jñānaśaktirvipaścitām .. 46 ..
3.45.d:
सर्वबीजस्वरूपा त्वं संसारे साररूपिणी ॥
स्मृतिर्मेधा च बुद्धिर्वा ज्ञानशक्तिर्विपश्चिताम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.45.m:
You have the nature of the seed of all, having the nature of the essence in worldly existence;
you are memory, intellect, understanding, or the power of knowledge of the wise. // 46

3.45.s:
kṛṣṇena vidyā yā dattā sarvajñāna prasūḥ śubhā ..
śūline kṛpayā sā tvaṃ yayā mṛtyuñjayaḥ śivaḥ ..47..
3.45.d:
कृष्णेन विद्या या दत्ता सर्वज्ञान प्रसूः शुभा ॥
शूलिने कृपया सा त्वं यया मृत्युञ्जयः शिवः ॥47॥
3.45.m:
The knowledge which was given by Kṛṣṇa, the auspicious mother of all knowledge,
to the bearer of the trident out of compassion—that are you, by whom Śiva is the conqueror of death. // 47

3.45.s:
sṛṣṭipālanasaṃhāraśaktayastrividhāśca yāḥ ..
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ sā tvameva namo'stu te .. 48 ..
3.45.d:
सृष्टिपालनसंहारशक्तयस्त्रिविधाश्च याः ॥
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां सा त्वमेव नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 48 ॥
3.45.m:
The threefold powers of creation, preservation, and destruction
belonging to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśāna—that indeed are you; homage be to you! // 48

3.45.s:
madhukaiṭabhabhītyā ca trasto dhātā prakampitaḥ ..
stutvā muktaśca yāṃ devīṃ tāṃ mūrdhnā praṇamāmyaham .. 49 ..
3.45.d:
मधुकैटभभीत्या च त्रस्तो धाता प्रकम्पितः ॥
स्तुत्वा मुक्तश्च यां देवीं तां मूर्ध्ना प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ 49 ॥
3.45.m:
Frightened and trembling through fear of Madhu and Kaiṭabha,
the Creator praised that goddess and was freed; to her I bow with my head! // 49

3.45.s:
madhukaiṭabhayoryuddhe trātā'sau viṣṇurīśvarīm ..
babhūva śaktimānstutvā tvāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham .. 3.45.50 ..
3.45.d:
मधुकैटभयोर्युद्धे त्राताऽसौ विष्णुरीश्वरीम् ॥
बभूव शक्तिमान्स्तुत्वा त्वां दुर्गां प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ 3.45.50 ॥
3.45.m:
In the battle of Madhu and Kaiṭabha, that savior Viṣṇu,
having praised the Sovereign Goddess, became empowered; to you, Durgā, I bow! // 3.45.50

3.45.s:
tripurasya mahāyuddhe sarathe patite śive ..
yāṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ surāḥ sarve tāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham .. 51 ..
3.45.d:
त्रिपुरस्य महायुद्धे सरथे पतिते शिवे ॥
यां तुष्टुवुः सुराः सर्वे तां दुर्गां प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ 51 ॥
3.45.m:
When Śiva fell with his chariot in the great battle against Tripura,
the goddess whom all the gods praised—to that Durgā I bow! // 51

3.45.s:
viṣṇunā vṛṣarūpeṇa svayaṃ śambhuḥ samutthitaḥ ..
jaghāna tripuraṃ stutvā tāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham .. 52 ..
3.45.d:
विष्णुना वृषरूपेण स्वयं शम्भुः समुत्थितः ॥
जघान त्रिपुरं स्तुत्वा तां दुर्गां प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ 52 ॥
3.45.m:
Śambhu himself, having risen up by means of Viṣṇu in the form of a bull,
slew Tripura after praising [her]; to that Durgā I bow! // 52

3.45.s:
yadājñayā vāti vātaḥ sūryastapati santatam ..
varṣatīndro dahatyagnistāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham .. 53 ..
3.45.d:
यदाज्ञया वाति वातः सूर्यस्तपति सन्ततम् ॥
वर्षतीन्द्रो दहत्यग्निस्तां दुर्गां प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ 53 ॥
3.45.m:
By whose command the wind blows, the sun shines constantly,
Indra rains, and fire burns—to that Durgā I bow! // 53

3.45.s:
yadājñayā hi kālaśca śaśvadbhramati vegataḥ ..
mṛtyuścarati jantūnāṃ tāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham.. .. 54 ..
3.45.d:
यदाज्ञया हि कालश्च शश्वद्भ्रमति वेगतः ॥
मृत्युश्चरति जन्तूनां तां दुर्गां प्रणमाम्यहम्॥ ॥ 54 ॥
3.45.m:
By whose command indeed Time revolves constantly with speed,
and death stalks living creatures—to that Durgā I bow! // 54

3.45.s:
sraṣṭā sṛjati sṛṣṭiṃ ca pātā pāti yadājñayā ..
saṃharttā saṃharetkāle tāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham .. 55 ..
3.45.d:
स्रष्टा सृजति सृष्टिं च पाता पाति यदाज्ञया ॥
संहर्त्ता संहरेत्काले तां दुर्गां प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ 55 ॥
3.45.m:
By whose command the Creator creates creation, the Protector protects,
and the Destroyer destroys in due time—to that Durgā I bow! // 55

3.45.s:
jyotissvarūpo bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇo nirguṇaḥ svayam ..
yayā vinā na śaktaśca sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ namāmi tām .. 56 ..
3.45.d:
ज्योतिस्स्वरूपो भगवाञ्छ्रीकृष्णो निर्गुणः स्वयम् ॥
यया विना न शक्तश्च सृष्टिं कर्तुं नमामि ताम् ॥ 56 ॥
3.45.m:
The Blessed One, Śrī Kṛṣṇa himself, whose nature is light, without gunas,
is not capable of performing creation without whom—to her I bow! // 56

3.45.s:
rakṣa rakṣa jaganmātaraparādhaṃ kṣamasva me ..
śiśūnāmaparādhena kuto mātā hi kupyati .. 57 ..
3.45.d:
रक्ष रक्ष जगन्मातरपराधं क्षमस्व मे ॥
शिशूनामपराधेन कुतो माता हि कुप्यति ॥ 57 ॥
3.45.m:
Protect me, protect me, O Mother of the universe! Forgive my transgression;
for how could a mother become angry at the transgression of her children? // 57

3.45.s:
uktvā paraśurāmaśceti natvā tāṃ ruroda ha ..
tuṣṭā durgā saṃbhrameṇa cābhayaṃ ca varaṃ dadau .. 58 ..
3.45.d:
उक्त्वा परशुरामश्चेति नत्वा तां रुरोद ह ॥
तुष्टा दुर्गा संभ्रमेण चाभयं च वरं ददौ ॥ 58 ॥
3.45.m:
Having spoken thus and having bowed down to her, Paraśurāma wept.
Satisfied, Durgā with agitation granted fearlessness and a boon: // 58

3.45.s:
amaro bhava he putra vatsa susthiratāṃ vraja ..
sarvaprasādātsarvatra jayo'stu tava santatam .. 59 ..
3.45.d:
अमरो भव हे पुत्र वत्स सुस्थिरतां व्रज ॥
सर्वप्रसादात्सर्वत्र जयोऽस्तु तव सन्ततम् ॥ 59 ॥
3.45.m:
“Become immortal, O son! Child, attain composure;
by the grace of all, let there be victory for you everywhere and constantly! // 59

3.45.s:
sarvāntarātmā bhagavāṃstuṣṭassyātsantataṃ hariḥ ..
bhaktirbhavatu te kṛṣṇe śivade ca śive gurau .. 3.45.60 ..
3.45.d:
सर्वान्तरात्मा भगवांस्तुष्टस्स्यात्सन्ततं हरिः ॥
भक्तिर्भवतु ते कृष्णे शिवदे च शिवे गुरौ ॥ 3.45.60 ॥
3.45.m:
May the Blessed One Hari, the Inner Self of all, be constantly pleased;
may you have devotion to Kṛṣṇa, and to Śiva the bestower of welfare, your guru! // 3.45.60

3.45.s:
iṣṭadeve gurau yasya bhaktirbhavati śāśvatī ..
taṃ hantuṃ nahi śaktā vā ruṣṭā vā sarvadevatāḥ .. 61 ..
3.45.d:
इष्टदेवे गुरौ यस्य भक्तिर्भवति शाश्वती ॥
तं हन्तुं नहि शक्ता वा रुष्टा वा सर्वदेवताः ॥ 61 ॥
3.45.m:
For one who has eternal devotion to his chosen deity and to his guru,
even all the gods, if enraged, are not able to kill him. // 61

3.45.s:
śrīkṛṣṇasya ca bhaktastvaṃ śiṣyo vai śaṃkarasya ca ..
gurupatnīṃ stauṣi yasmātkastvāṃ hantumiheśvaraḥ .. 62 ..
3.45.d:
श्रीकृष्णस्य च भक्तस्त्वं शिष्यो वै शंकरस्य च ॥
गुरुपत्नीं स्तौषि यस्मात्कस्त्वां हन्तुमिहेश्वरः ॥ 62 ॥
3.45.m:
You are a devotee of Śrī Kṛṣṇa and a disciple of Śaṅkara;
since you praise the wife of your guru, who here is capable of killing you? // 62

3.45.s:
aho na kṛṣṇabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit ..
anyadeveṣu ye bhaktā na bhaktā vā niraṅkuśāḥ .. 63 ..
3.45.d:
अहो न कृष्णभक्तानामशुभं विद्यते क्वचित् ॥
अन्यदेवेषु ये भक्ता न भक्ता वा निरङ्कुशाः ॥ 63 ॥
3.45.m:
Ah, for the devotees of Kṛṣṇa there is never any misfortune anywhere!
Those who are devoted to other deities, or are non-devotees, are unrestrained. // 63

3.45.s:
candramā balavāṃstuṣṭo yeṣāṃ bhāgyavatāṃ bhṛgo ..
teṣāṃ tārāgaṇā ruṣṭāḥ kiṃ kurvaṃti ca durbalāḥ..64..
3.45.d:
चन्द्रमा बलवांस्तुष्टो येषां भाग्यवतां भृगो ॥
तेषां तारागणा रुष्टाः किं कुर्वंति च दुर्बलाः॥64॥
3.45.m:
For those fortunate ones with whom the powerful moon is pleased, O descendant of Bhṛgu,
what can the multitude of stars do when enraged, being weak? // 64

3.45.s:
yasmai tuṣṭaḥ pālayati naradevo mahānsukhī ..
tasya kiṃ vā kariṣyanti ruṣṭā bhṛtyāśca durbalāḥ..65..
3.45.d:
यस्मै तुष्टः पालयति नरदेवो महान्सुखी ॥
तस्य किं वा करिष्यन्ति रुष्टा भृत्याश्च दुर्बलाः॥65॥
3.45.m:
For him whom a great, contented king protects when pleased,
what will angry and weak servants do to him? // 65 //”

3.45.s:
ityuktvā pārvatī tuṣṭā dattvā rāmāya cāśiṣam ..
jagāmāntaḥpuraṃ tūrṇaṃ harṣaśabdo babhūva ha ..66..
3.45.d:
इत्युक्त्वा पार्वती तुष्टा दत्त्वा रामाय चाशिषम् ॥
जगामान्तःपुरं तूर्णं हर्षशब्दो बभूव ह ॥66॥
3.45.m:
Having spoken thus, pleased Pārvatī, having given a blessing to Rāma,
went quickly to the inner apartment, and indeed a sound of joy arose. // 66

3.45.s:
stotraṃ vai kāṇvaśākhoktaṃ pūjākāle ca yaḥ paṭhet ..
yātrākāle tathā prātarvācchitārthaṃ labheddhruvam ..67..
3.45.d:
स्तोत्रं वै काण्वशाखोक्तं पूजाकाले च यः पठेत् ॥
यात्राकाले तथा प्रातर्वाच्छितार्थं लभेद्ध्रुवम् ॥67॥
3.45.m:
Whoever recites this hymn of praise spoken in the Kāṇva recension at the time of worship,
at the time of a journey, and in the morning, surely attains his desired objective. // 67

3.45.s:
putrārthī labhate putraṃ kanyārthī kanyakāṃ labhet ..
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ prajārthī cāpnuyātprajāḥ ..
bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyaṃ naṣṭavitto dhanaṃ labhet ..68..
3.45.d:
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रं कन्यार्थी कन्यकां लभेत् ॥
विद्यार्थी लभते विद्यां प्रजार्थी चाप्नुयात्प्रजाः ॥
भ्रष्टराज्यो लभेद्राज्यं नष्टवित्तो धनं लभेत् ॥68॥

3.45.s:
yasya ruṣṭo gururdevo rājā vā bāndhavo'thavā ..
tasmai tuṣṭaśca varadaḥ stotrarājaprasādataḥ .. 69 ..
3.45.d:
यस्य रुष्टो गुरुर्देवो राजा वा बान्धवोऽथवा ॥
तस्मै तुष्टश्च वरदः स्तोत्रराजप्रसादतः ॥ 69 ॥
3.45.m:
A person with whom their guru, deity, king, or kinsman is angry,
will find them pleased and granting boons through the grace of this king of hymns of praise. // 69

3.45.s:
dasyugrastaḥ phaṇigrastaśśatrugrasto bhayānakaḥ ..
vyādhigrasto bhavenmuktaḥ stotrasmaraṇamātrataḥ .. .. 3.45.70 ..
3.45.d:
दस्युग्रस्तः फणिग्रस्तश्शत्रुग्रस्तो भयानकः ॥
व्याधिग्रस्तो भवेन्मुक्तः स्तोत्रस्मरणमात्रतः ॥ ॥ 3.45.70 ॥
3.45.m:
One seized by bandits, seized by a serpent, or seized by an enemy, a terrified person,
or one afflicted by disease, becomes free merely by remembering this hymn of praise. // 3.45.70

3.45.s:
rājadvāre śmaśāne ca kārāgāre ca bandhane ..
jalarāśau nimagnaśca muktastatsmṛtimātrataḥ ..71..
3.45.d:
राजद्वारे श्मशाने च कारागारे च बन्धने ॥
जलराशौ निमग्नश्च मुक्तस्तत्स्मृतिमात्रतः ॥71॥
3.45.m:
At the king’s court, in a cremation ground, in prison, and in captivity,
or drowning in an expanse of water, one is freed merely by remembering it. // 71

3.45.s:
svāmibhede putrabhede mitrabhede ca dāruṇe ..
stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa vāñchitārthaṃ labheddhruvam .. 72 ..
3.45.d:
स्वामिभेदे पुत्रभेदे मित्रभेदे च दारुणे ॥
स्तोत्रस्मरणमात्रेण वाञ्छितार्थं लभेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 72 ॥
3.45.m:
In a terrible rift with one's master, a rift with one's son, or a rift with one's friend,
merely by remembering this hymn of praise, one surely obtains one's desired object. // 72

3.45.s:
kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ varṣaṃ ca stotrarājaṃ śṛṇoti yā ..
bhaktyā durgāṃ ca sampūjya mahāvandhyā prasūyate .. 73 ..
3.45.d:
कृत्वा हविष्यं वर्षं च स्तोत्रराजं शृणोति या ॥
भक्त्या दुर्गां च सम्पूज्य महावन्ध्या प्रसूयते ॥ 73 ॥
3.45.m:
A woman who, having kept a diet of sacrificial food for a year, listens to this king of hymns of praise
and worships Durgā with devotion, even if completely barren, gives birth. // 73

3.45.s:
labhate sā divyaputraṃ jñāninaṃ cirajīvinam ..
asaubhāgyā ca saubhāgyaṃ ṣaṇmāsaśravaṇāllabhet ..74..
3.45.d:
लभते सा दिव्यपुत्रं ज्ञानिनं चिरजीविनम् ॥
असौभाग्या च सौभाग्यं षण्मासश्रवणाल्लभेत् ॥74॥
3.45.m:
She obtains a divine son who is wise and long-lived;
and an unfortunate woman attains good fortune by listening to it for six months. // 74

3.45.s:
navamāsaṃ kākavandhyā mṛtavatsā ca bhaktitaḥ ..
stotrarājaṃ yā śṛṇoti sā putraṃ labhate dhruvam ..72..
3.45.d:
नवमासं काकवन्ध्या मृतवत्सा च भक्तितः ॥
स्तोत्रराजं या शृणोति सा पुत्रं लभते ध्रुवम् ॥72॥
3.45.m:
A woman who has borne only one child, or whose children have died, if with devotion
she listens to this king of hymns of praise for nine months, she surely obtains a son. // 75

3.45.s:
kanyāmātā putrahīnā pañcamāsaṃ śṛṇoti yā ..
ghaṭe sampūjya durgāṃ ca sā putraṃ labhate dhruvam .. 76 ..
3.45.d:
कन्यामाता पुत्रहीना पञ्चमासं शृणोति या ॥
घटे सम्पूज्य दुर्गां च सा पुत्रं लभते ध्रुवम् ॥ 76 ॥
3.45.m:
A mother of only daughters who has no son, who listens for five months,
having worshipped Durgā in a sacred jar, surely obtains a son. // 76

3.46.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
stutvā tāṃ parśurāmo'sau harṣasaṃphullamānasaḥ ..
stotreṇa hariṇoktena sa tuṣṭāva gaṇādhipam .. 1 ..
3.46.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
स्तुत्वा तां पर्शुरामोऽसौ हर्षसंफुल्लमानसः ॥
स्तोत्रेण हरिणोक्तेन स तुष्टाव गणाधिपम् ॥ 1 ॥

3.46.s:
pūjāṃ cakāra bhaktyā ca naivedyairvividhairapi ..
dhūpairdīpaiśca gandhaiśca puṣpaiśca tulasīṃ vinā .. 2 ..
3.46.d:
पूजां चकार भक्त्या च नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि ॥
धूपैर्दीपैश्च गन्धैश्च पुष्पैश्च तुलसीं विना ॥ 2 ॥

3.46.s:
sampūjya bhrātaraṃ bhaktyā sa rāmaḥ śaṃkarājñayā ..
gurupatnīṃ guruṃ natvā gamanaṃ kartumudyataḥ .. 3 ..
3.46.d:
सम्पूज्य भ्रातरं भक्त्या स रामः शंकराज्ञया ॥
गुरुपत्नीं गुरुं नत्वा गमनं कर्तुमुद्यतः ॥ 3 ॥

3.46.s:
nārada uvāca ..
pūjāṃ bhagavataścakre rāmo gaṇapateryadā ..
naivadyairvividhaiḥ puṣpaistulasīṃ ca vinā katham .. 4 ..
3.46.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
पूजां भगवतश्चक्रे रामो गणपतेर्यदा ॥
नैवद्यैर्विविधैः पुष्पैस्तुलसीं च विना कथम् ॥ 4 ॥

3.46.s:
tulasī sarvapuṣpāṇāṃ mānyā dhanyā manoharā ..
kathaṃ pūjāṃ sārabhūtāṃ na gṛhṇāti gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 5 ..
3.46.d:
तुलसी सर्वपुष्पाणां मान्या धन्या मनोहरा ॥
कथं पूजां सारभूतां न गृह्णाति गणेश्वरः ॥ 5 ॥

3.46.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu nārada vakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
brahmakalpasya vṛttāntaṃ nigūḍhaṃ ca manoharam ..6..
3.46.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
शृणु नारद वक्ष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम् ॥
ब्रह्मकल्पस्य वृत्तान्तं निगूढं च मनोहरम् ॥6॥

3.46.s:
ekadā tulasī devī prodbhinnanavayauvanā ..
tīrthaṃ bhramantī tapasā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā .. 7 ..
3.46.d:
एकदा तुलसी देवी प्रोद्भिन्ननवयौवना ॥
तीर्थं भ्रमन्ती तपसा नारायणपरायणा ॥ 7 ॥

3.46.s:
dadarśa gaṅgātīre sā gaṇeśaṃ yauvanānvitam ..
atīva sundaraṃ śuddhaṃ sasmitaṃ pītavāsasam .. 8 ..
3.46.d:
ददर्श गङ्गातीरे सा गणेशं यौवनान्वितम् ॥
अतीव सुन्दरं शुद्धं सस्मितं पीतवाससम् ॥ 8 ॥

3.46.s:
candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..
dhyāyantaṃ kṛṣṇapādābjaṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham .. 9 ..
3.46.d:
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वांगं रत्नभूषणभूषितम् ॥
ध्यायन्तं कृष्णपादाब्जं जन्ममृत्युजरापहम् ॥ 9 ॥

3.46.s:
jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorgurum ..
surūpahāryyaṃ niṣkāmaṃ sakāmā tamuvāca ha .. 3.46.10 ..
3.46.d:
जितेन्द्रियाणां प्रवरं योगीन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुम् ॥
सुरूपहार्य्यं निष्कामं सकामा तमुवाच ह ॥ 3.46.10 ॥

3.46.s:
tulasyuvāca ..
aho dhyāyasi kiṃ deva śāntarūpa gajānana ..
kathaṃ lambodaro deho gajavaktraṃ kathaṃ tava .. 11 ..
3.46.d:
तुलस्युवाच ॥
अहो ध्यायसि किं देव शान्तरूप गजानन ॥
कथं लम्बोदरो देहो गजवक्त्रं कथं तव ॥ 11 ॥

3.46.s:
ekadantaḥ kathaṃ vaktre vadāmutra ca kāraṇam ..
tyaja dhyānaṃ mahābhāga sāyaṃkāla upasthitaḥ .. 12 ..
3.46.d:
एकदन्तः कथं वक्त्रे वदामुत्र च कारणम् ॥
त्यज ध्यानं महाभाग सायंकाल उपस्थितः ॥ 12 ॥

3.46.s:
ityuktvā tulasī devī prajahāsa punaḥ punaḥ ..
paraṃ cetasi dagdhā sā kāmabāṇaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ .. 13 ..
3.46.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तुलसी देवी प्रजहास पुनः पुनः ॥
परं चेतसि दग्धा सा कामबाणैः सुदारुणैः ॥ 13 ॥

3.46.s:
gaṇeśasya pradhānāṃge dattvā kiñcijjalaṃ mune ..
jaghāna tarjanyagreṇa niṣpandaṃ kṛṣṇamānasam .. 14 ..
3.46.d:
गणेशस्य प्रधानांगे दत्त्वा किञ्चिज्जलं मुने ॥
जघान तर्जन्यग्रेण निष्पन्दं कृष्णमानसम् ॥ 14 ॥

3.46.s:
babhūva dhyānabhagnaṃ ca tasya nārada cetanam ..
duḥkhaṃ ca dhyānabhedena tadvicchedo hi śokadaḥ .. 15 ..
3.46.d:
बभूव ध्यानभग्नं च तस्य नारद चेतनम् ॥
दुःखं च ध्यानभेदेन तद्विच्छेदो हि शोकदः ॥ 15 ॥

3.46.s:
dhyānaṃ tyaktvā hariṃ smṛtvā cāpaśyatkāminīṃ puraḥ ..
navayauvanasampannāṃ sasmitāṃ kāmapīḍitām .. .. 16 ..
3.46.d:
ध्यानं त्यक्त्वा हरिं स्मृत्वा चापश्यत्कामिनीं पुरः ॥
नवयौवनसम्पन्नां सस्मितां कामपीडिताम् ॥ ॥ 16 ॥

3.46.s:
lambodaraśca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vinayapūrvakam ..
uvāca sasmitaḥ śāntaḥ śāntāṃ kāmāturāṃ vaśī .. 17 ..
3.46.d:
लम्बोदरश्च तां दृष्ट्वा परं विनयपूर्वकम् ॥
उवाच सस्मितः शान्तः शान्तां कामातुरां वशी ॥ 17 ॥

3.46.s:
gaṇeśvara uvāca ..
kā tvaṃ vatse kasya kanyā mātarmā brūhi kiṃ śubhe ..
pāpado'śubhadaḥ śaśvaddhyānabhaṃgastapasvinām .. 18 ..
3.46.d:
गणेश्वर उवाच ॥
का त्वं वत्से कस्य कन्या मातर्मा ब्रूहि किं शुभे ॥
पापदोऽशुभदः शश्वद्ध्यानभंगस्तपस्विनाम् ॥ 18 ॥

3.46.s:
kṛṣṇaḥ karotu kalyāṇaṃ hantu vighnaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ ..
taddhyānabhaṃgajāddoṣānnāśubhaṃ syāttu te śubhe .. 19 ..
3.46.d:
कृष्णः करोतु कल्याणं हन्तु विघ्नं कृपानिधिः ॥
तद्ध्यानभंगजाद्दोषान्नाशुभं स्यात्तु ते शुभे ॥ 19 ॥

3.46.s:
gaṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca smarāturā ..
sasmitaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ ca devaṃ madhurayā girā .. 3.46.20 ..
3.46.d:
गणेशवचनं श्रुत्वा तमुवाच स्मरातुरा ॥
सस्मितं सकटाक्षं च देवं मधुरया गिरा ॥ 3.46.20 ॥

3.46.s:
tulasyuvāca ..
dharmātmajasya kanyā'hamaprauḍhā ca tapasvinī ..
tapasyā me svāmino'rthe tvaṃ svāmī bhava me prabho .. 21 ..
3.46.d:
तुलस्युवाच ॥
धर्मात्मजस्य कन्याऽहमप्रौढा च तपस्विनी ॥
तपस्या मे स्वामिनोऽर्थे त्वं स्वामी भव मे प्रभो ॥ 21 ॥

3.46.s:
tulasīvacanaṃ śrutvā gaṇeśaḥ śrīhariṃ smaran ..
tāmuvāca mahāprājñaḥ prājñīṃ madhurayā girā .. 22 ..
3.46.d:
तुलसीवचनं श्रुत्वा गणेशः श्रीहरिं स्मरन् ॥
तामुवाच महाप्राज्ञः प्राज्ञीं मधुरया गिरा ॥ 22 ॥

3.46.s:
gaṇeśa uvāca ..
he mātarnāsti me vācchā ghore dāraparigrahe ..
dāragraho hi duḥkhāya na sukhāya kadācana .. 23 ..
3.46.d:
गणेश उवाच ॥
हे मातर्नास्ति मे वाच्छा घोरे दारपरिग्रहे ॥
दारग्रहो हि दुःखाय न सुखाय कदाचन ॥ 23 ॥

3.46.s:
haribhaktervyavāyaśca tapasyānāśakārakaḥ ..
mokṣadvārakapāṭaśca bhavabandhanapāśakaḥ .. 24 ..
3.46.d:
हरिभक्तेर्व्यवायश्च तपस्यानाशकारकः ॥
मोक्षद्वारकपाटश्च भवबन्धनपाशकः ॥ 24 ॥

3.46.s:
garbhavāsakaraḥ śaśvattattvajñānanikṛntakaḥ ..
saṃśayānāṃ samārambho yastyājyo vṛṣalairapi .. 25 ..
3.46.d:
गर्भवासकरः शश्वत्तत्त्वज्ञाननिकृन्तकः ॥
संशयानां समारम्भो यस्त्याज्यो वृषलैरपि ॥ 25 ॥

3.46.s:
geho'yaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca sarvamāyākaraṇḍakam ..
sāhasānāṃ samūhaśca doṣāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 26 ..
3.46.d:
गेहोऽयं कारणानां च सर्वमायाकरण्डकम् ॥
साहसानां समूहश्च दोषाणां च विशेषतः ॥ 26 ॥

3.46.s:
nivartasva mahābhāge paśyānyaṃ kāmukaṃ patim ..
kāmukenaiva kāmukyāḥ saṃgamo guṇavānbhaveta .. 27 ..
3.46.d:
निवर्तस्व महाभागे पश्यान्यं कामुकं पतिम् ॥
कामुकेनैव कामुक्याः संगमो गुणवान्भवेत ॥ 27 ॥

3.46.s:
ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā kopātsā taṃ śaśāpa ha ..
dārāste bhavitā'sādhvī gaṇeśvara na saṃśayaḥ .. 28 ..
3.46.d:
इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा कोपात्सा तं शशाप ह ॥
दारास्ते भविताऽसाध्वी गणेश्वर न संशयः ॥ 28 ॥

3.46.s:
ityākarṇya suraśreṣṭhastāṃ śaśāpa śivātmajaḥ ..
devi tvamasuragrastā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ .. 29 ..
3.46.d:
इत्याकर्ण्य सुरश्रेष्ठस्तां शशाप शिवात्मजः ॥
देवि त्वमसुरग्रस्ता भविष्यसि न संशयः ॥ 29 ॥

3.46.s:
tatpaścānmahatāṃ śāpādvṛkṣastvaṃ bhaviteti ca ..
mahātapasvītyuktvā tāṃ virarāma ca nārada .. 3.46.30 ..
3.46.d:
तत्पश्चान्महतां शापाद्वृक्षस्त्वं भवितेति च ॥
महातपस्वीत्युक्त्वा तां विरराम च नारद ॥ 3.46.30 ॥

3.46.s:
śāpaṃ śrutvā tu tulasī sā ruroda punaḥ punaḥ ..
tuṣṭāva ca suraśreṣṭhaṃ sa prasanna uvāca tām .. 31 ..
3.46.d:
शापं श्रुत्वा तु तुलसी सा रुरोद पुनः पुनः ॥
तुष्टाव च सुरश्रेष्ठं स प्रसन्न उवाच ताम् ॥ 31 ॥

3.46.s:
gaṇeśvara uvāca ..
puṣpāṇāṃ sārabhūtā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi manorame ..
kalāṃśena mahābhāge svayaṃ nārāyaṇapriyā .. 32 ..
3.46.d:
गणेश्वर उवाच ॥
पुष्पाणां सारभूता त्वं भविष्यसि मनोरमे ॥
कलांशेन महाभागे स्वयं नारायणप्रिया ॥ 32 ॥
3.46.m:
"You will become the essence of flowers, O charming woman.
By a part of a portion, O highly fortunate woman, you will yourself be dear to Nārāyaṇa. // 32

3.46.s:
priyā tvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya viśeṣataḥ ..
pūjā vimuktidā nṝṇāṃ mayā bhogyā na nityaśaḥ .. 33'..
ityuktvā tāṃ suraśreṣṭho jagāma tapase punaḥ ..
harerārādhanavyagro badarīsannidhiṃ yayau .. 34 ..
3.46.d:
प्रिया त्वं सर्वदेवानां श्रीकृष्णस्य विशेषतः ॥
पूजा विमुक्तिदा नॄणां मया भोग्या न नित्यशः ॥ 33'॥
इत्युक्त्वा तां सुरश्रेष्ठो जगाम तपसे पुनः ॥
हरेराराधनव्यग्रो बदरीसन्निधिं ययौ ॥ 34 ॥
3.46.m:
You shall be dear to all the gods, and especially to Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
[Your] worship grants liberation to men, [yet] you are never to be enjoyed by me." // 33
Having spoken thus to her, that best of gods departed again for austerities.
Intent on worshiping Hari, he went near Badarī. // 34

3.46.s:
jagāma tulasī devī hṛdayena vidūyatā ..
nirāhārā tapaścakre puṣkare lakṣavarṣakam .. 35 ..
3.46.d:
जगाम तुलसी देवी हृदयेन विदूयता ॥
निराहारा तपश्चक्रे पुष्करे लक्षवर्षकम् ॥ 35 ॥
3.46.m:
Goddess Tulasī departed with an aching heart;
fasting, she performed austerities at Puṣkara for a hundred thousand years. // 35

3.46.s:
paścānmunīndraśāpena gaṇeśasya ca nārada ..
sā priyā śaṃkhacūḍasya babhūva suciraṃ mune .. 36 ..
3.46.d:
पश्चान्मुनीन्द्रशापेन गणेशस्य च नारद ॥
सा प्रिया शंखचूडस्य बभूव सुचिरं मुने ॥ 36 ॥
3.46.m:
Afterwards, through the curse of the lord of sages and Gaṇeśa, O Nārada,
she became the beloved of Śaṅkhacūḍa for a very long time, O sage. // 36

3.46.s:
tataḥ śaṅkaraśūlena sa mamārāsureśvaraḥ ..
sā kalāṃśena vṛkṣatvaṃ yayau nārāyaṇapriyā .. 37 ..
3.46.d:
ततः शङ्करशूलेन स ममारासुरेश्वरः ॥
सा कलांशेन वृक्षत्वं ययौ नारायणप्रिया ॥ 37 ॥
3.46.m:
Then that lord of asuras died by Śaṅkara's trident,
and she, dear to Nārāyaṇa, became a tree by a part of a portion. // 37

3.46.s:
kathitaścetihāsaste śruto dharmamukhātpurā ..
mokṣapradaśca sāraśca purāṇena prakīrtitaḥ .. 38 ..
3.46.d:
कथितश्चेतिहासस्ते श्रुतो धर्ममुखात्पुरा ॥
मोक्षप्रदश्च सारश्च पुराणेन प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 38 ॥
3.46.m:
This history has been recounted to you, as heard from the mouth of Dharma long ago.
It is celebrated in the Purāṇa as giving liberation and as essential. // 38

3.46.s:
tataḥ paraśurāmo'sau jagāma tapase vanam ..
praṇamya śaṅkaraṃ durgāṃ saṃpūjya ca gaṇeśvaram .. 39 ..
3.46.d:
ततः परशुरामोऽसौ जगाम तपसे वनम् ॥
प्रणम्य शङ्करं दुर्गां संपूज्य च गणेश्वरम् ॥ 39 ॥
3.46.m:
Then Paraśurāma went to the forest to perform austerities,
having bowed to Śaṅkara and Durgā, and having worshiped Gaṇeśvara. // 39

3.46.s:
pūjito vanditaḥ sarvaiḥ surendramunipuṅgavaiḥ ..
pārvatīśivasānnidhye sukhaṃ tasthau gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 3.46.40 ..
3.46.d:
पूजितो वन्दितः सर्वैः सुरेन्द्रमुनिपुङ्गवैः ॥
पार्वतीशिवसान्निध्ये सुखं तस्थौ गणेश्वरः ॥ 3.46.40 ॥
3.46.m:
Worshiped and praised by all the chiefs of gods and best of sages,
Gaṇeśvara dwelt happily in the presence of Pārvatī and Śiva. // 3.46.40

3.46.s:
idaṃ gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ..
sa rājasūyayajñasya phalamāpnoti niścitam .. 41 ..
3.46.d:
इदं गणपतेः खण्डं यः शृणोति समाहितः ॥
स राजसूययज्ञस्य फलमाप्नोति निश्चितम् ॥ 41 ॥
3.46.m:
Whoever listens attentively to this section on Gaṇapati
surely obtains the fruit of the Rājasūya sacrifice. // 41

3.46.s:
aputro labhate putraṃ śrīgaṇeśaprasādataḥ ..
dhīraṃ vīraṃ ca dhaninaṃ guṇinaṃ cirajīvinam .. 42 ..
3.46.d:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं श्रीगणेशप्रसादतः ॥
धीरं वीरं च धनिनं गुणिनं चिरजीविनम् ॥ 42 ॥
3.46.m:
One who is childless obtains a son by the grace of Śrī Gaṇeśa—
a wise, brave, wealthy, virtuous, and long-lived one, // 42

3.46.s:
yaśasvinaṃ putriṇaṃ ca vidvāṃsaṃ sukavīśvaram ..
jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām .. 43 ..
3.46.d:
यशस्विनं पुत्रिणं च विद्वांसं सुकवीश्वरम् ॥
जितेन्द्रियाणां प्रवरं दातारं सर्वसम्पदाम् ॥ 43 ॥
3.46.m:
renowned, blessed with children, learned, and a master poet,
foremost among those of controlled senses, a giver of all wealth, // 43

3.46.s:
suśīlaṃ ca sadācāraṃ praśaṃsyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ labhet ..
ahiṃsakaṃ dayāluṃ ca tattvajñānaviśāradam .. 44 ..
3.46.d:
सुशीलं च सदाचारं प्रशंस्यं वैष्णवं लभेत् ॥
अहिंसकं दयालुं च तत्त्वज्ञानविशारदम् ॥ 44 ॥
3.46.m:
well-behaved, of good conduct, praiseworthy; he will obtain a Vaiṣṇava [son],
non-violent, compassionate, and skilled in the knowledge of reality. // 44

3.46.s:
bhaktyā gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ ..
śrutvā gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ mahāvandhyā prasūyate .. 49 ..
3.46.d:
भक्त्या गणेशं संपूज्य वस्त्रालङ्कारचन्दनैः ॥
श्रुत्वा गणपतेः खण्डं महावन्ध्या प्रसूयते ॥ 49 ॥
3.46.m:
Worshiping Gaṇeśa with devotion, with garments, ornaments, and sandalwood paste,
and hearing this section on Gaṇapati, a completely barren woman gives birth; // 45

3.46.s:
mṛtavatsā kākavandhyā brahmanputraṃ labheddhruvam ..
adūṣyadūṣaṇaparā śuddhā caiva labhetsutam .. 46 ..
3.46.d:
मृतवत्सा काकवन्ध्या ब्रह्मन्पुत्रं लभेद्ध्रुवम् ॥
अदूष्यदूषणपरा शुद्धा चैव लभेत्सुतम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.46.m:
one whose children die, or one who bears only once, O brahmin, surely obtains a son;
even one intent on blaming the blameless, having become purified, obtains a son. // 46

3.46.s:
saṃpūrṇaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ śrutvā yallabhate phalam ..
tatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ śrutvedaṃ khaṇḍamuttamam..47..
3.46.d:
संपूर्णं ब्रह्मवैवर्तं श्रुत्वा यल्लभते फलम् ॥
तत्फलं लभते मर्त्यः श्रुत्वेदं खण्डमुत्तमम्॥47॥
3.46.m:
Whatever fruit one obtains from hearing the entire Brahmavaivarta,
that very fruit a mortal obtains by hearing this excellent section. // 47

3.46.s:
vāñchāṃ kṛtvā tu manasi śṛṇoti paramāsthitaḥ..
tasmai dadāti sarveṣṭaṃ suraśreṣṭho gaṇeśvaraḥ ..48..
3.46.d:
वाञ्छां कृत्वा तु मनसि शृणोति परमास्थितः॥
तस्मै ददाति सर्वेष्टं सुरश्रेष्ठो गणेश्वरः ॥48॥
3.46.m:
And if, conceiving a desire in mind, one listens with utmost faith,
to him Gaṇeśvara, the foremost of gods, grants all that is desired. (48)

3.46.s:
śrutvā gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ vighnanāśāya yatnataḥ ..
svarṇayajñopavītaṃ ca śvetacchatraṃ ca mālyakam .. 49 ..
3.46.d:
श्रुत्वा गणपतेः खण्डं विघ्ननाशाय यत्नतः ॥
स्वर्णयज्ञोपवीतं च श्वेतच्छत्रं च माल्यकम् ॥ 49 ॥
3.46.m:
Having listened with effort to the section on Gaṇapati for the destruction of obstacles,
a golden sacred thread, a white parasol, a garland,

3.46.s:
pradīyate vācakāya svastikaṃ tilalaḍḍukān ..
paripakvaphalānyeva deśakālodbhavāni ca ..3.46.50..
3.46.d:
प्रदीयते वाचकाय स्वस्तिकं तिललड्डुकान् ॥
परिपक्वफलान्येव देशकालोद्भवानि च ॥3.46.50॥
3.46.m:
auspicious pastries, sesame sweets,
and fully ripened fruits produced according to season and place should be given to the reciter. (50)

rājño bodhaḥ bhārgaveṇa rājño yuddhāraṃbhaḥ .. 139 .. ślo-
3.47.d:
34 रामस्य कार्तवीर्यं प्रति दूतप्रेषणम्। तयो संवादः॥कार्तवीर्यस्याशुभदर्शनम् 81 श्लो
35 कार्तवीर्यपत्न्याः मनोरमायाः देहत्यागः । राज्ञः अनुतापः । आकाशवाण्या
राज्ञो बोधः भार्गवेण राज्ञो युद्धारंभः ॥ 139 ॥ श्लो-

3.47.s: 36 kātavīryapreritānāṃ rājñāṃ nāśaḥ sucaṃdreṇa rājñā saha rāmasya yuddham ..45.. ślo-
3.47.d: 36 कातवीर्यप्रेरितानां राज्ञां नाशः सुचंद्रेण राज्ञा सह रामस्य युद्धम् ॥45॥ श्लो-

3.47.s: 37 kālīkavacam .. 24 .. ślo0
3.47.d: 37 कालीकवचम् ॥ 24 ॥ श्लो0

38 sucandravadhe'parairindrādibhiryuddham .rāmeṇa pāśupatāstragrahelakṣmīkavacaprāptiḥ 82 ślo
49 durgākavacam . kārtavīryasya svato yuddhāyagamanam .. 23 .. ślo0
3.47.d:
38 सुचन्द्रवधेऽपरैरिन्द्रादिभिर्युद्धम् ।रामेण पाशुपतास्त्रग्रहेलक्ष्मीकवचप्राप्तिः 82 श्लो
49 दुर्गाकवचम् । कार्तवीर्यस्य स्वतो युद्धायगमनम् ॥ 23 ॥ श्लो0

3.47.s:
50 tayostumulasaṃgrāmavarṇanam . pāśupatāstreṇa kārtavīryavadhaḥ . paraśurāmeṇaikaviṃśati
kṛtva kṣatriyāṇāṃ vadhaḥ ..104 .. ślo0...
3.47.d:
50 तयोस्तुमुलसंग्रामवर्णनम् । पाशुपतास्त्रेण कार्तवीर्यवधः । परशुरामेणैकविंशति
कृत्व क्षत्रियाणां वधः ॥104 ॥ श्लो0॥।

3.47.s: 51 mahīṃ niḥkṣatriyāṃ kṛtvā rāmasya kailāsagamanam .. 35 ..ślo0
3.47.d: 51 महीं निःक्षत्रियां कृत्वा रामस्य कैलासगमनम् ॥ 35 ॥श्लो0

3.47.s:
52 rahaḥsthitayośśivayoḥ samīpagamane paraśurāmasya gaṇapatiṃ prati prārthanā tadā tayoḥ
parasparaṃ vivādaḥ ..69.. ślo-
3.47.d:
52 रहःस्थितयोश्शिवयोः समीपगमने परशुरामस्य गणपतिं प्रति प्रार्थना तदा तयोः
परस्परं विवादः ॥69॥ श्लो-

3.47.s: 43 paśurāmasyāṃtaḥpuragamane punargaṇapatikṛtamahānirodhaḥ ..42.. ślo-
3.47.d: 43 पशुरामस्यांतःपुरगमने पुनर्गणपतिकृतमहानिरोधः ॥42॥ श्लो-

3.47.s:
44 tadā tayoryuddhe gaṇeśadaṃtasya tatra bhaṃgaḥ .tatastatragatāyāṃ parvatyāṃ rāma haṃtumudyatāyāṃ
rāmakṛta viṣṇustotram ..98.. ślo0

44 तदा तयोर्युद्धे गणेशदंतस्य तत्र भंगः ।ततस्तत्रगतायां पर्वत्यां राम हंतुमुद्यतायां
रामकृत विष्णुस्तोत्रम् ॥98॥ श्लो0

3.47.s: 45 viṣṇunā gaurīprītaye rāmāya gaṇeśastavādyupadeśaḥ . durgāstotrama..76.. ślo0
3.47.d: 45 विष्णुना गौरीप्रीतये रामाय गणेशस्तवाद्युपदेशः । दुर्गास्तोत्रम॥76॥ श्लो0

3.47.s: 46 svasaṅgamāyāgatatulasrīnivāraṇaṃ gaṇeśakṛtam . gaṇeśatulasīsaṃvādaḥ . asya gaṇeśakhaṃḍasya paṭhanādeḥ phalaśrutiḥ..50.. ślo
3.47.d: 46 स्वसङ्गमायागततुलस्रीनिवारणं गणेशकृतम् । गणेशतुलसीसंवादः । अस्य गणेशखंडस्य पठनादेः फलश्रुतिः॥50॥ श्लो

3.47.s: .. iti gaṇeśakhaṃḍam ..

4.0.s:
.. śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ..
.. śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ ..
.. śrīgopījanavallabhāya namaḥ ..
.. atha brahmavaivartīyaśrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍaprāraṃbhaḥ ..
4.0.d:
॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
॥ श्रीसरस्वत्यै नमः ॥
॥ श्रीगोपीजनवल्लभाय नमः ॥
॥ अथ ब्रह्मवैवर्तीयश्रीकृष्णजन्मखण्डप्रारंभः ॥
4.0.m:
Obeisance to the blessed Sarasvatī.
Obeisance to the beloved of the cowherd maidens.
Now begins the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa belonging to the Brahmavaivarta.

4.1.s:
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam ..
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet .. 1 ..
nārada uvāca .. ..
śrutaṃ prathamato brahmanbrahmakhaṇḍaṃ manoharam ..
brahmaṇo vadanāṃbhojātparamādbhutameva ca ..1..
4.1.d:
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् ॥
देवीं सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत् ॥ 1 ॥
नारद उवाच ॥ ॥
श्रुतं प्रथमतो ब्रह्मन्ब्रह्मखण्डं मनोहरम् ॥
ब्रह्मणो वदनांभोजात्परमाद्भुतमेव च ॥1॥
4.1.m:
First, O Brahman, the delightful Brahmakhaṇḍa was heard,
truly exceedingly wondrous, from the lotus mouth of Brahmā.

4.1.s:
tatastadvacanāttūrṇaṃ samāgatya tavāṃtikam ..
śrutaṃ prakṛtikhaṇḍaṃ ca sudhākhaṃḍātparaṃ varam .. 2 ..
4.1.d:
ततस्तद्वचनात्तूर्णं समागत्य तवांतिकम् ॥
श्रुतं प्रकृतिखण्डं च सुधाखंडात्परं वरम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.1.m:
Then, having come swiftly to your presence on his word,
I heard the Prakṛtikhaṇḍa, superior even to a draught of nectar.

4.1.s:
tato gaṇapateḥ khaṃḍamakhaṃḍabhavakhaṃḍanam ..
na me tṛptaṃ mano lolaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ śrotumicchati .. 3 ..
4.1.d:
ततो गणपतेः खंडमखंडभवखंडनम् ॥
न मे तृप्तं मनो लोलं विशिष्टं श्रोतुमिच्छति ॥ 3 ॥
4.1.m:
Then [I heard] the section of Gaṇapati, which destroys unbroken worldly existence.
My restless mind is not satisfied; it desires to hear the distinguished [fourth section]:

4.1.s:
śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍaṃ ca janmādeḥ khaṃḍanaṃ nṛṇām ..
pradīpaṃ sarvatattvānāṃ karmaghnaṃ haribhaktidam .. 4 ..
4.1.d:
श्रीकृष्णजन्मखंडं च जन्मादेः खंडनं नृणाम् ॥
प्रदीपं सर्वतत्त्वानां कर्मघ्नं हरिभक्तिदम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.1.m:
The Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa, which puts an end to birth and the like for human beings,
the lamp of all essential truths, destroying karma, granting devotion to Hari,

4.1.s:
sadyo vairāgyajananaṃ bhavaroganikṛṃtanam ..
kāraṇaṃ muktibījānāṃ bhavābdhestāraṇaṃ param .. 5 ..
4.1.d:
सद्यो वैराग्यजननं भवरोगनिकृंतनम् ॥
कारणं मुक्तिबीजानां भवाब्धेस्तारणं परम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.1.m:
giving rise immediately to dispassion, cutting through the disease of worldly existence,
the cause of the seeds of liberation, the supreme means of crossing the ocean of transmigration,

4.1.s:
karmopabhogarogāṇāṃ khaṃḍane ca rasāyanam ..
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāṃbhojaprāptisopāna kāraṇam .. 6 ..
4.1.d:
कर्मोपभोगरोगाणां खंडने च रसायनम् ॥
श्रीकृष्णचरणांभोजप्राप्तिसोपान कारणम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.1.m:
the elixir for dispelling the diseases of the experience of karma,
the instrument [forming] a stairway to the attainment of the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,

4.1.s:
jīvanaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca jagatāṃ pāvanaṃ param ..
vada vistārya māṃ bhaktaṃ śiṣyaṃ ca śaraṇāgatam .. 7 ..
4.1.d:
जीवनं वैष्णवानां च जगतां पावनं परम् ॥
वद विस्तार्य मां भक्तं शिष्यं च शरणागतम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.1.m:
the life-breath of the Vaiṣṇavas, and the supreme purifier of the worlds.
Relate [it] in detail to me, a devotee, a disciple, and one who has taken refuge [in you].

4.1.s:
kena vā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇa ājagāma mahītalam ..
sarvāṃśaireka eveśaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam ..8..
4.1.d:
केन वा प्रार्थितः कृष्ण आजगाम महीतलम् ॥
सर्वांशैरेक एवेशः परिपूर्णतमः स्वयम् ॥8॥
4.1.m:
Prayed to by whom did Kṛṣṇa descend to the surface of the earth,
he who is the one Lord with all his portions, the most completely whole in his own person?

4.1.s:
yuge kutra kuto hetoḥ kutra vā''virbabhūva ha ..
vasudevo'sya janakaḥ ko vā kā vā ca devakī .. 9 ..
4.1.d:
युगे कुत्र कुतो हेतोः कुत्र वा'ऽविर्बभूव ह ॥
वसुदेवोऽस्य जनकः को वा का वा च देवकी ॥ 9 ॥
4.1.m:
In what yuga, for what reason, and where indeed did he appear?
Who was Vasudeva, his father, and who was Devakī?

4.1.s:
vada kasya kule janma māyayā suviḍaṃbanam ..
kiṃ cakāra samāgatya kena rūpeṇa vā hariḥ .. .. 4.1.10 ..
4.1.d:
वद कस्य कुले जन्म मायया सुविडंबनम् ॥
किं चकार समागत्य केन रूपेण वा हरिः ॥ ॥ 4.1.10 ॥
4.1.m:
Tell: in whose family was his birth, his deceptive imitation [of mortals] through māyā?
What did Hari do after arriving, or in what form?

4.1.s:
jagāma gokulaṃ kaṃsabhayena sūtikāgṛhāt ..
kathaṃ kaṃsātkīṭatulyādbhayeśasya bhayaṃ mune .. 11 ..
4.1.d:
जगाम गोकुलं कंसभयेन सूतिकागृहात् ॥
कथं कंसात्कीटतुल्याद्भयेशस्य भयं मुने ॥ 11 ॥
4.1.m:
He went to Gokula from the lying-in chamber out of fear of Kaṃsa.
How could there be fear, O sage, on the part of the ruler of fear from Kaṃsa, who was like a worm?

4.1.s:
harirvā gopaveṣeṇa gokule kiṃ cakāra ha ..
kuto gopāṅganāsārdhaṃ vijahāra jagatpatiḥ ..12..
4.1.d:
हरिर्वा गोपवेषेण गोकुले किं चकार ह ॥
कुतो गोपाङ्गनासार्धं विजहार जगत्पतिः ॥12॥
4.1.m:
Or what did Hari do in Gokula in the guise of a cowherd?
For what reason did the Lord of the universe sport with the cowherd maidens?

4.1.s:
kā vā gopāṃganā ke vā gopālā bālarūpiṇaḥ ..
kā vā yaśodā ko naṃdaḥ kiṃ vā puṇyaṃ cakāra ha ..13..
4.1.d:
का वा गोपांगना के वा गोपाला बालरूपिणः ॥
का वा यशोदा को नंदः किं वा पुण्यं चकार ह ॥13॥
4.1.m:
Who were the cowherd maidens, and who were the cowherds in the form of boys?
Who was Yaśodā, who was Nanda, and what merit indeed did he perform?

4.1.s:
kathaṃ rādhā puṇyavatī devī gokulavāsinī ..
vraje vā vrajakanyā sā babhūva preyaso hareḥ..14..
4.1.d:
कथं राधा पुण्यवती देवी गोकुलवासिनी ॥
व्रजे वा व्रजकन्या सा बभूव प्रेयसो हरेः॥14॥
4.1.m:
How was it that the meritorious goddess Rādhā became an inhabitant of Gokula,
or that in Vraja she became a maiden of Vraja, the beloved of Hari?

4.1.s:
kathaṃ gopyo durārādhyaṃ saṃprāpurīśvaraṃ param ..
kathaṃ tāśca parityajya jagāma mathurāṃ punaḥ .. 19 ..
4.1.d:
कथं गोप्यो दुराराध्यं संप्रापुरीश्वरं परम् ॥
कथं ताश्च परित्यज्य जगाम मथुरां पुनः ॥ 19 ॥
4.1.m:
How did the cowherd women attain the supreme Lord who is difficult to propitiate?
How, having abandoned them, did he go again to Mathurā?

4.1.s:
bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ vidhāya jagāma saḥ ..
kathayasva mahābhāga puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana .. 16 ..
4.1.d:
भारावतरणं कृत्वा किं विधाय जगाम सः ॥
कथयस्व महाभाग पुण्यश्रवणकीर्तन ॥ 16 ॥
4.1.m: Having removed the burden [of the earth], what did he accomplish before he departed?

4.1.s:
sudurlabhāṃ harikathāṃ taraṇiṃ bhavasāgare ..
niṣekabhoganigaḍakleśacchedana kartanīm .. 17 ..
4.1.d:
सुदुर्लभां हरिकथां तरणिं भवसागरे ॥
निषेकभोगनिगडक्लेशच्छेदन कर्तनीम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.1.m:
the exceedingly rare tale of Hari, a boat on the ocean of worldly existence,
a pair of shears to sever the affliction of the fetters of experiencing one's destiny,

4.1.s:
pāpeṃdhanānāṃ dahane jvaladagniśikhāmiva ..
puṃsāṃ śrutavatāṃ koṭijanmakilbiṣanāśinīm .. 18 ..
4.1.d:
पापेंधनानां दहने ज्वलदग्निशिखामिव ॥
पुंसां श्रुतवतां कोटिजन्मकिल्बिषनाशिनीम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.1.m:
like a blazing tongue of fire in burning the fuel of sins,
destroying the sins of millions of births for men who have heard it,

4.1.s:
muktiṃ karṇasudhāramyāṃ śokasāgaranāśinīm ..
mahyaṃ bhaktāya śiṣyāya jñānaṃ dehi kṛpānidhe .. 19 ..
4.1.d:
मुक्तिं कर्णसुधारम्यां शोकसागरनाशिनीम् ॥
मह्यं भक्ताय शिष्याय ज्ञानं देहि कृपानिधे ॥ 19 ॥
4.1.m:
bringing liberation, delightful as nectar to the ears, destroying the ocean of grief.
Grant knowledge to me, your devotee and disciple, O treasury of compassion!

4.1.s:
tapojapamahādānātpṛthivyāṃ tīrthadarśanāt ..
śrutipāṭhādanaśanādvratāddevārcanādapi .. 4.1.20 ..
4.1.d:
तपोजपमहादानात्पृथिव्यां तीर्थदर्शनात् ॥
श्रुतिपाठादनशनाद्व्रताद्देवार्चनादपि ॥ 4.1.20 ॥
4.1.m:
From austerity, recitation of mantras, great charity, visiting holy places on earth,
from reciting the scriptures, fasting, religious vows, and also the worship of deities,

4.1.s:
dīkṣāyāḥ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ ..
ṣoḍaśīṃ jñānadānasya kalāṃ nārhati tatphalam .. 21 ..
4.1.d:
दीक्षायाः सर्वयज्ञेषु यत्फलं लभते नरः ॥
षोडशीं ज्ञानदानस्य कलां नार्हति तत्फलम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.1.m:
and from initiation in all sacrifices, whatever fruit a man obtains,
that fruit is not worth a sixteenth part of the gift of knowledge.

4.1.s:
pitrā'haṃ preṣito jñānādānāya tava sannidhim ..
sudhāsamudraṃ saṃprāpya ko vā'nyatpātumicchati .. 22 ..
4.1.d:
पित्राऽहं प्रेषितो ज्ञानादानाय तव सन्निधिम् ॥
सुधासमुद्रं संप्राप्य को वाऽन्यत्पातुमिच्छति ॥ 22 ॥
4.1.m:
I have been sent by my father to your presence to receive knowledge.
Having reached the ocean of nectar, who would desire to drink anything else?

4.1.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
mayā jñāto'si dhanyastvaṃ puṇyarāśiḥ sumūrtimān ..
karoṣi bhramaṇaṃ lokānpāvituṃ kulapāvana .. 23 ..
4.1.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
मया ज्ञातोऽसि धन्यस्त्वं पुण्यराशिः सुमूर्तिमान् ॥
करोषि भ्रमणं लोकान्पावितुं कुलपावन ॥ 23 ॥
4.1.m:
You are known to me: you are blessed, an embodiment of a mass of merit;
you wander about in order to purify the worlds, O purifier of your lineage!

4.1.s:
janānāṃ hṛdayaṃ sadyaḥ suvyaktaṃ vacanena vai ..
śiṣye kalatre kanyāyāṃ dauhitre bāṃdhave'pi ca .. 24 ..
4.1.d:
जनानां हृदयं सद्यः सुव्यक्तं वचनेन वै ॥
शिष्ये कलत्रे कन्यायां दौहित्रे बांधवेऽपि च ॥ 24 ॥
4.1.m:
The hearts of men are instantly revealed by speech alone.
Toward a disciple, a wife, a daughter, a daughter's son, and even a relative,

4.1.s:
putre pautre ca vacasi pratāpe cāpadi striyām ..
vṛddhau vairiṇi vidyāyāṃ jñāyate hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām .. 25 ..
4.1.d:
पुत्रे पौत्रे च वचसि प्रतापे चापदि स्त्रियाम् ॥
वृद्धौ वैरिणि विद्यायां ज्ञायते हृदयं नृणाम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.1.m:
toward a son, a grandson, in speech, in valour, in misfortune, toward a woman,
in old age, toward an enemy, and in learning, the heart of human beings is known.

4.1.s:
jīvanmukto'si pūtastvaṃ śuddhabhakto gadābhṛtaḥ ..
punāsi pādarajasā sarvādhārāṃ vasundharām .. 26 ..
4.1.d:
जीवन्मुक्तोऽसि पूतस्त्वं शुद्धभक्तो गदाभृतः ॥
पुनासि पादरजसा सर्वाधारां वसुन्धराम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.1.m:
You are liberated while living, purified, a pure devotee of the wielder of the mace.
You purify with the dust of your feet the earth, the support of all.

4.1.s:
punāsi lokāntsarvāṃśca svīyavigrahadarśanāt ..
sumaṃgalāṃ harikathāṃ tena tvaṃ śrotumicchasi .. 27 ..
4.1.d:
पुनासि लोकान्त्सर्वांश्च स्वीयविग्रहदर्शनात् ॥
सुमंगलां हरिकथां तेन त्वं श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥ 27 ॥
4.1.m:
You purify all the worlds by the sight of your form;
therefore, you desire to hear the most auspicious narrative of Hari.

4.1.s:
yatra kṛṣṇakathāḥ saṃti tatraiva sarvadevatāḥ ..
ṛṣayo munayaścaiva tīrthāni nikhilāni ca .. 28 ..
4.1.d:
यत्र कृष्णकथाः संति तत्रैव सर्वदेवताः ॥
ऋषयो मुनयश्चैव तीर्थानि निखिलानि च ॥ 28 ॥
4.1.m:
Wherever there are discourses on Kṛṣṇa, right there are all the gods,
the ṛṣis, the sages, and all the sacred places.

4.1.s:
kathāḥ śrutvā kathāṃte te yāṃti santo nirāpadam ..
bhavaṃti tāni tīrthāni yeṣu kṛṣṇakathāḥ śubhāḥ .. 29 ..
4.1.d:
कथाः श्रुत्वा कथांते ते यांति सन्तो निरापदम् ॥
भवंति तानि तीर्थानि येषु कृष्णकथाः शुभाः ॥ 29 ॥
4.1.m:
Having heard the narratives, at the end of the narrative those good people go to a state free from danger.
Those places become sacred places where the auspicious discourses on Kṛṣṇa take place.

4.1.s:
sadyaḥ kṛṣṇakathāvaktā svasya puṃsāṃ śataṃ śatam..
samuddhṛtya śrutavatāṃ punāti nikhilaṃ kulam .. 4.1.30 ..
4.1.d:
सद्यः कृष्णकथावक्ता स्वस्य पुंसां शतं शतम्॥
समुद्धृत्य श्रुतवतां पुनाति निखिलं कुलम् ॥ 4.1.30 ॥
4.1.m:
The speaker of Kṛṣṇa's narratives instantly [redeems] a hundred and a hundred of his own men;
having delivered them, he purifies the entire family of those who have listened.

4.1.s:
praṣṭā tu praśnamātreṇa punāti kulamātmanaḥ ..
śrotā śravaṇamātreṇa svakulaṃ sva svabāṃdhavān .. 31 ..
4.1.d:
प्रष्टा तु प्रश्नमात्रेण पुनाति कुलमात्मनः ॥
श्रोता श्रवणमात्रेण स्वकुलं स्व स्वबांधवान् ॥ 31 ॥
4.1.m:
The inquirer, indeed, by merely inquiring, purifies his own family;
the listener, by mere listening, purifies his own family and each of his kinsmen.

4.1.s:
śatajanmatapastapto janmedaṃ bhārate labhet ..
karoti saphalaṃ janma śrutvā harikathāmṛtam .. 32 ..
4.1.d:
शतजन्मतपस्तप्तो जन्मेदं भारते लभेत् ॥
करोति सफलं जन्म श्रुत्वा हरिकथामृतम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.1.m:
One who has performed austerities for a hundred births may obtain this birth in Bhārata;
he makes his birth fruitful having heard the nectar of the narrative of Hari.

4.1.s:
arcanaṃ vaṃdanaṃ mantrajapaḥ sevanameva ca ..
smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ śaśvadguṇaśravaṇamīpsitam .. 33 ..
4.1.d:
अर्चनं वंदनं मन्त्रजपः सेवनमेव च ॥
स्मरणं कीर्तनं शश्वद्गुणश्रवणमीप्सितम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.1.m:
Worship, homage, recitation of mantras, and service,
remembrance, chanting, constant desired listening to virtues,

4.1.s:
nivedanaṃ tasya dāsyaṃ navadhā bhaktilakṣaṇam ..
karoti janma suphalaṃ kṛtvaitāni ca nārada .. 34 ..
4.1.d:
निवेदनं तस्य दास्यं नवधा भक्तिलक्षणम् ॥
करोति जन्म सुफलं कृत्वैतानि च नारद ॥ 34 ॥
4.1.m:
self-offering, and servitude to him: these are the nine marks of devotion.
One makes his birth truly fruitful having practiced these, O Nārada.

4.1.s:
na ca vighno bhavettasya paramāyurna naśyati ..
na yāti tatpuraḥ kālo vainateyamivoragaḥ .. 35 ..
4.1.d:
न च विघ्नो भवेत्तस्य परमायुर्न नश्यति ॥
न याति तत्पुरः कालो वैनतेयमिवोरगः ॥ 35 ॥
4.1.m:
No obstacle befalls him, nor does his full lifespan perish;
Time does not advance before him, like a serpent before the son of Vinatā.

4.1.s:
na jahāti samīpaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ tasya hariḥ svayam ..
upatiṣṭhati tūrṇaṃ tamaṇimādikasiddhayaḥ .. 36 ..
4.1.d:
न जहाति समीपं च क्षणं तस्य हरिः स्वयम् ॥
उपतिष्ठति तूर्णं तमणिमादिकसिद्धयः ॥ 36 ॥
4.1.m:
Hari himself does not leave his presence even for a moment;
the supernatural powers beginning with atom-like minuteness quickly attend upon him.

4.1.s:
sudarśanaṃ bhramatyeva tasya pārśve divāniśam ..
kṛṣṇājñayā ca rakṣārthaṃ ko vā kiṃ kartumīśvaraḥ .. 37 ..
4.1.d:
सुदर्शनं भ्रमत्येव तस्य पार्श्वे दिवानिशम् ॥
कृष्णाज्ञया च रक्षार्थं को वा किं कर्तुमीश्वरः ॥ 37 ॥
4.1.m:
The Sudarśana [discus] ever revolves at his side day and night;
and by Kṛṣṇa's command for his protection, who indeed is able to do what [to harm him]?

4.1.s:
na yāṃti tatsamīpaṃ ca svapne'pi yamakiṃkarāḥ ..
jvaladagniṃ yathā dṛṣṭvā śalabhā na vrajaṃti tam .. 36 ..
4.1.d:
न यांति तत्समीपं च स्वप्नेऽपि यमकिंकराः ॥
ज्वलदग्निं यथा दृष्ट्वा शलभा न व्रजंति तम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.1.m:
The servants of Yama do not approach him even in a dream,
just as moths, seeing a blazing fire, do not fly into it.

4.1.s:
vyādhayo vipadaḥ śokā viprāśca na prayāṃti tam ..
na yāti tatsamīpaṃ ca mṛtyurmṛtyubhayānmune .. 39 ..
4.1.d:
व्याधयो विपदः शोका विप्राश्च न प्रयांति तम् ॥
न याति तत्समीपं च मृत्युर्मृत्युभयान्मुने ॥ 39 ॥
4.1.m:
Diseases, misfortunes, griefs, and calamities do not go near him;
and Death himself, out of fear of death, does not come near him, O sage.

4.1.s:
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ..
sa ca sarvatra niḥśaṃkaḥ sukhī kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ .. 4.1.40 ..
4.1.d:
ऋषयो मुनयः सिद्धाः सन्तुष्टाः सर्वदेवताः ॥
स च सर्वत्र निःशंकः सुखी कृष्णप्रसादतः ॥ 4.1.40 ॥
4.1.m:
The ṛṣis, sages, and siddhas are pleased, and so are all the gods;
and he is everywhere fearless and happy by the grace of Kṛṣṇa.

4.1.s:
tava kṛṣṇakathāyāṃ ca ratirātyaṃtikī sadā ..
janakasya svabhāvo hi janye tiṣṭhati niścitam .. 41 ..
4.1.d:
तव कृष्णकथायां च रतिरात्यंतिकी सदा ॥
जनकस्य स्वभावो हि जन्ये तिष्ठति निश्चितम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.1.m: Your delight in the narrative of Kṛṣṇa is always absolute;

4.1.s:
vipreṃdra kā praśaṃseyaṃ janma te brahmamānase ..
yatra yatra kule janma tanmatistādṛśī bhavet .. 42 ..
4.1.d:
विप्रेंद्र का प्रशंसेयं जन्म ते ब्रह्ममानसे ॥
यत्र यत्र कुले जन्म तन्मतिस्तादृशी भवेत् ॥ 42 ॥
4.1.m:
O best of Brahmins, what praise is this? Your birth was in the mind of Brahmā;
in whatever family one is born, one's disposition becomes like that.

4.1.s:
pitā vidhātā jagatāṃ kṛṣṇapādābjasevayā ..
nityaṃ karoti yaḥ śaśvannavadhā bhaktilakṣaṇam .. 43 ..
4.1.d:
पिता विधाता जगतां कृष्णपादाब्जसेवया ॥
नित्यं करोति यः शश्वन्नवधा भक्तिलक्षणम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.1.m:
Your father is the creator of the worlds, who, through service to Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet,
daily and constantly performs the nine marks of devotion.

4.1.s:
ratiḥ kṛṣṇakathāyāṃ ca yasyāśrupulakodgamaḥ ..
mano nimagnaṃ tatraiva sa bhaktaḥ kathito budhaiḥ ..44..
4.1.d:
रतिः कृष्णकथायां च यस्याश्रुपुलकोद्गमः ॥
मनो निमग्नं तत्रैव स भक्तः कथितो बुधैः ॥44॥
4.1.m:
He who has delight in the narrative of Kṛṣṇa, in whom tears and thrilling of hair arise,
whose mind is immersed right there, he is called a devotee by the wise.

4.1.s:
putradārādikaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti śrīhareriti ..
ātmanā manasā vācā sa bhaktaḥ kathito budhaiḥ .. 45 ..
4.1.d:
पुत्रदारादिकं सर्वं जानाति श्रीहरेरिति ॥
आत्मना मनसा वाचा स भक्तः कथितो बुधैः ॥ 45 ॥
4.1.m:
He who considers his sons, wife, and all else as belonging to Śrī Hari,
in self, mind, and speech, is called a devotee by the wise.

4.1.s:
nirjane tīrthasaṃparke niḥsaṃgā ye mudā'nvitāḥ ..
dhyāyaṃte caraṇāṃbhojaṃ śrīhareste ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ..46..
4.1.d:
निर्जने तीर्थसंपर्के निःसंगा ये मुदाऽन्विताः ॥
ध्यायंते चरणांभोजं श्रीहरेस्ते च वैष्णवाः ॥46॥
4.1.m:
Those who, unattached and filled with joy in solitude or at sacred places,
meditate on the lotus feet of Śrī Hari, they are Vaiṣṇavas.

4.1.s:
dayā'sti sarvajīveṣu sarvaṃ kṛṣṇama yaṃ jagat ..
yo jānāti mahājñānī sa bhakto vaiṣṇavo mataḥ ..47..
4.1.d:
दयाऽस्ति सर्वजीवेषु सर्वं कृष्णम यं जगत् ॥
यो जानाति महाज्ञानी स भक्तो वैष्णवो मतः ॥47॥
4.1.m:
He who has compassion toward all living beings, and who knows that the entire universe consists of Kṛṣṇa,
is a person of great knowledge; he is considered a devotee, a Vaiṣṇava.

4.1.s:
śaśvadye nāma gāyaṃti guṇaṃ maṃtraṃ japaṃti ca ..
kurvaṃti śravaṇaṃ gāthā vadaṃti te'tivaiṣṇavāḥ .. 46 ..
4.1.d:
शश्वद्ये नाम गायंति गुणं मंत्रं जपंति च ॥
कुर्वंति श्रवणं गाथा वदंति तेऽतिवैष्णवाः ॥ 46 ॥
4.1.m:
Those who constantly sing the name and virtues, recite the mantra,
listen, and narrate the accounts, they are foremost Vaiṣṇavas.

4.1.s:
labdhānīṣṭāni vastūni pradātuṃ haraye mudā ..
tūrṇaṃ yasya mano hṛṣṭaṃ sa bhakto jñānināṃ varaḥ .. 49 ..
4.1.d:
लब्धानीष्टानि वस्तूनि प्रदातुं हरये मुदा ॥
तूर्णं यस्य मनो हृष्टं स भक्तो ज्ञानिनां वरः ॥ 49 ॥
4.1.m:
He whose mind is quickly delighted to offer gladly
desired objects that have been obtained to Hari, he is a devotee, the best among the wise.

4.1.s:
yanmano haripādābje svapne jñāne divāniśam..
pūrvakarmopabhogaṃ ca bahirbhuṅkte sa vaiṣṇavaḥ .. 4.1.50 ..
4.1.d:
यन्मनो हरिपादाब्जे स्वप्ने ज्ञाने दिवानिशम्॥
पूर्वकर्मोपभोगं च बहिर्भुङ्क्ते स वैष्णवः ॥ 4.1.50 ॥
4.1.m:
He whose mind is on Hari's lotus feet in dream and in waking, day and night,
and who outwardly experiences the fruition of past actions, he is a Vaiṣṇava.

4.1.s:
guruvaktrādviṣṇumaṃtro yasya karṇe viśatyalam ..
taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahāpūtaṃ pravadaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ .. 51 ..
4.1.d:
गुरुवक्त्राद्विष्णुमंत्रो यस्य कर्णे विशत्यलम् ॥
तं वैष्णवं महापूतं प्रवदंति मनीषिणः ॥ 51 ॥
4.1.m:
The wise call that man a highly purified Vaiṣṇava
into whose ear the Viṣṇu-mantra fully enters from the mouth of a guru.

4.1.s:
pūrvāntsapta parāntsapta sapta mātāmahādikān ..
sodarānuddharedbhaktaḥ svaprasūṃ ca prasūprasūm ..52..
4.1.d:
पूर्वान्त्सप्त परान्त्सप्त सप्त मातामहादिकान् ॥
सोदरानुद्धरेद्भक्तः स्वप्रसूं च प्रसूप्रसूम् ॥52॥
4.1.m:
Seven ancestors, seven descendants, and seven maternal grandfathers and their line,
his brothers, his own mother, and his mother's mother, the devotee would deliver;

4.1.s:
kalatraṃ kanyakāṃ baṃdhuṃ śiṣyaṃ dauhitramātmanaḥ ..
kiṃkarānkiṃkarīścaivamuddharedvaiṣṇavaḥ sadā .. 53 ..
4.1.d:
कलत्रं कन्यकां बंधुं शिष्यं दौहित्रमात्मनः ॥
किंकरान्किंकरीश्चैवमुद्धरेद्वैष्णवः सदा ॥ 53 ॥
4.1.m:
his wife, daughter, kinsman, pupil, and his own daughter's son,
and likewise male and female servants: a Vaiṣṇava always delivers [them].

4.1.s:
sadā vāṃchati tīrthāni vaiṣṇavasparśadarśane ..
pāpidattāni pāpāni teṣāṃ naśyaṃti saṃgataḥ .. 54 ..
4.1.d:
सदा वांछति तीर्थानि वैष्णवस्पर्शदर्शने ॥
पापिदत्तानि पापानि तेषां नश्यंति संगतः ॥ 54 ॥
4.1.m:
Sacred places constantly desire the sight and touch of a Vaiṣṇava;
the sins deposited by sinners are destroyed from contact with them.

4.1.s:
godohanakṣaṇaṃ yāvadyatra tiṣṭhaṃti vaiṣṇavāḥ ..
tatra sarvāṇi tīrthāni saṃti tāvanmahītale ..55..
4.1.d:
गोदोहनक्षणं यावद्यत्र तिष्ठंति वैष्णवाः ॥
तत्र सर्वाणि तीर्थानि संति तावन्महीतले ॥55॥
4.1.m:
Wherever Vaiṣṇavas stay for as long as the milking of a cow,
right there are all the sacred places on the earth for that duration.

4.1.s:
dhruvaṃ tatra mṛtaḥ pāpī mukto yāti hareḥ padam ..
tathaiva jñānagaṃgāyāmaṃte kṛṣṇasmṛtau yathā..56..
4.1.d:
ध्रुवं तत्र मृतः पापी मुक्तो याति हरेः पदम् ॥
तथैव ज्ञानगंगायामंते कृष्णस्मृतौ यथा॥56॥
4.1.m:
Surely a sinner who dies there is liberated and goes to the abode of Hari.
Just so in the Gaṅgā of knowledge, as when remembering Kṛṣṇa at the end,

4.1.s:
tulasīkānane goṣṭhe śrīkṛṣṇamaṃdire pare..
vṛṃdāraṇye haridvāre tīrtheṣvanyeṣu vā yathā ..57..
4.1.d:
तुलसीकानने गोष्ठे श्रीकृष्णमंदिरे परे॥
वृंदारण्ये हरिद्वारे तीर्थेष्वन्येषु वा यथा ॥57॥
4.1.m:
in a grove of Tulasī, in a cow-pen, in the supreme temple of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,
in Vṛndāraṇya, in Haridvāra, or in other sacred bathing places.

4.1.s:
pāpāni pāpināṃ yāṃti tīrthasnānāvagāhanāt ..
teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyaṃti vaiṣṇavasparśavāyunā ..58..
4.1.d:
पापानि पापिनां यांति तीर्थस्नानावगाहनात् ॥
तेषां पापानि नश्यंति वैष्णवस्पर्शवायुना ॥58॥
4.1.m:
The sins of sinners depart from bathing and plunging into a sacred bathing place;
their sins perish by the wind of a Vaiṣṇava's touch.

4.1.s:
na hi sthātuṃ śaknuvaṃti pāpānyeva kṛtāni ca ..
jvaladagnau yathā kṣipraṃ śuṣkāṇi hi tṛṇāni ca ..59..
4.1.d:
न हि स्थातुं शक्नुवंति पापान्येव कृतानि च ॥
ज्वलदग्नौ यथा क्षिप्रं शुष्काणि हि तृणानि च ॥59॥
4.1.m:
Indeed, committed sins are not able to remain,
just as dry grasses quickly perish in a blazing fire.

4.1.s:
bhaktaṃ vartmani gacchaṃtaṃ ye ye paśyaṃti mānavāḥ..
saptajanmārjitāghāni teṣāṃ naśyaṃti niścitam ..4.1.60..
4.1.d:
भक्तं वर्त्मनि गच्छंतं ये ये पश्यंति मानवाः॥
सप्तजन्मार्जिताघानि तेषां नश्यंति निश्चितम् ॥4.1.60॥
4.1.m:
Whichever men see a devotee walking on the path,
the sins acquired in seven lifetimes by them surely perish.

4.1.s:
ye niṃdaṃti hṛṣīkeśaṃ tadbhaktaṃ puṇyarūpiṇam ..
śatajanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ teṣāṃ naśyati niścitam.. 61 ..
4.1.d:
ये निंदंति हृषीकेशं तद्भक्तं पुण्यरूपिणम् ॥
शतजन्मार्जितं पुण्यं तेषां नश्यति निश्चितम्॥ 61 ॥
4.1.m:
Those who revile Hṛṣīkeśa and his devotee whose nature is virtue,
the merit acquired by them in a hundred lifetimes surely perishes.

4.1.s:
te pacyaṃte mahāghore kuṃbhīpāke bhayānake ..
bhakṣitāḥ kīṭasaṃghena yāvaccaṃdradivākarau .. 62 ..
4.1.d:
ते पच्यंते महाघोरे कुंभीपाके भयानके ॥
भक्षिताः कीटसंघेन यावच्चंद्रदिवाकरौ ॥ 62 ॥
4.1.m:
They are cooked in the terrifying, terrible Kumbhīpāka [hell],
eaten by swarms of worms as long as the moon and the sun endure.

4.1.s:
tasya darśanamātreṇa puṇyaṃ naśyati niścitam ..
gaṃgāṃ snātvā raviṃ natvā tadā vidvānviśudhyati .. 63 ..
4.1.d:
तस्य दर्शनमात्रेण पुण्यं नश्यति निश्चितम् ॥
गंगां स्नात्वा रविं नत्वा तदा विद्वान्विशुध्यति ॥ 63 ॥
4.1.m:
