By the mere sight of such a one, one's merit surely perishes;
bathing in the Gaṅgā and bowing to the sun, the wise man then becomes pure.

4.1.s:
vaiṣṇavasparśamātreṇa mukto bhavati pātakī ..
tasya pāpāni haṃtyeva svāṃtaḥstho madhusūdanaḥ.. .. 64 ..
4.1.d:
वैष्णवस्पर्शमात्रेण मुक्तो भवति पातकी ॥
तस्य पापानि हंत्येव स्वांतःस्थो मधुसूदनः॥ ॥ 64 ॥
4.1.m:
By the mere touch of a Vaiṣṇava, a sinner becomes liberated;
Madhusūdana dwelling within him destroys his sins.

4.1.s:
ityevaṃ kathito vipra viṣṇuvaiṣṇavayorguṇaḥ ..
adhunā śrīharerjanma nibodha kathayāmi te .. 65 ..
4.1.d:
इत्येवं कथितो विप्र विष्णुवैष्णवयोर्गुणः ॥
अधुना श्रीहरेर्जन्म निबोध कथयामि ते ॥ 65 ॥
4.1.m:
Thus the virtue of Viṣṇu and of the Vaiṣṇava has been told, O Brahmin.
Now understand the birth of Śrī Hari; I will tell you.

4.2.s:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
yena vā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇa ājagāma mahītalam..
yaṃ yaṃ vidhāya bhūmau sa jagāma svālayaṃ vibhuḥ .. 1..
4.2.d:
॥ श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
येन वा प्रार्थितः कृष्ण आजगाम महीतलम्॥
यं यं विधाय भूमौ स जगाम स्वालयं विभुः ॥ 1॥

4.2.s:
bhārāvataraṇopāyaṃ duṣṭānāṃ ca vadhodyamam ..
sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi suvicārya vidhānataḥ .. 2 ..
4.2.d:
भारावतरणोपायं दुष्टानां च वधोद्यमम् ॥
सर्वं ते कथयिष्यामि सुविचार्य विधानतः ॥ 2 ॥

4.2.s:
adhunā gopaveṣaṃ ca gokulāgamanaṃ hareḥ ..
rādhā gopālikā yena nibodha kathayāmi te .. 3 ..
4.2.d:
अधुना गोपवेषं च गोकुलागमनं हरेः ॥
राधा गोपालिका येन निबोध कथयामि ते ॥ 3 ॥

4.2.s:
śaṃkhacūḍavadhaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ śrutam ..
adhunā tatsuvistārya nibodha kathayāmi te .. .. 4 ..
4.2.d:
शंखचूडवधं पूर्वं संक्षेपात्कथितं श्रुतम् ॥
अधुना तत्सुविस्तार्य निबोध कथयामि ते ॥ ॥ 4 ॥

4.2.s:
śrīdāmnaḥ kalahaścaiva babhūva rādhayā saha ..
śrīdāmā śaṃkhacūḍaśca śāpāttasyā babhūva ha .. 5 ..
4.2.d:
श्रीदाम्नः कलहश्चैव बभूव राधया सह ॥
श्रीदामा शंखचूडश्च शापात्तस्या बभूव ह ॥ 5 ॥

4.2.s:
rādhāṃ śaśāpa śrīdāmā yāhi yoniṃ ca mānavīm ..
vraje vrajāṃganā bhūtvā vicarasva mahītale .. 6 ..
4.2.d:
राधां शशाप श्रीदामा याहि योनिं च मानवीम् ॥
व्रजे व्रजांगना भूत्वा विचरस्व महीतले ॥ 6 ॥

4.2.s:
bhītā śrīdāmaśāpātsā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ samuvāca ha ..
gopīrūpā bhaviṣyāmi śrīdāmā māṃ śaśāpa ha .. 7 ..
4.2.d:
भीता श्रीदामशापात्सा श्रीकृष्णं समुवाच ह ॥
गोपीरूपा भविष्यामि श्रीदामा मां शशाप ह ॥ 7 ॥

4.2.s:
kamupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi vada māṃ bhayabhaṃjana ..
tvayā vinā kathamahaṃ dhariṣyāmi svajīvanam .. 8 ..
4.2.d:
कमुपायं करिष्यामि वद मां भयभंजन ॥
त्वया विना कथमहं धरिष्यामि स्वजीवनम् ॥ 8 ॥

4.2.s:
kṣaṇamekaṃ yugaśataṃ kālanātha tvayā vinā ..
cakṣurnimeṣavirahādbhavedaṃdhaṃ mano mama .. 9..
4.2.d:
क्षणमेकं युगशतं कालनाथ त्वया विना ॥
चक्षुर्निमेषविरहाद्भवेदंधं मनो मम ॥ 9॥

4.2.s:
śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrābhaṃ kṣudhāpūrṇānanaṃ tava ..
nātha cakṣuñcakorābhyāṃ pibāmyahamaharniśam.. 4.2.10 ..
4.2.d:
शरत्पार्वणचंद्राभं क्षुधापूर्णाननं तव ॥
नाथ चक्षुञ्चकोराभ्यां पिबाम्यहमहर्निशम्॥ 4.2.10 ॥

4.2.s:
tvamātmā me manaḥ prāṇā dehamātraṃ vahāmyaham ..
dṛṣṭiśaktiśca cakṣustvaṃ jīvanaṃ paramaṃ dhanam ..11..
4.2.d:
त्वमात्मा मे मनः प्राणा देहमात्रं वहाम्यहम् ॥
दृष्टिशक्तिश्च चक्षुस्त्वं जीवनं परमं धनम् ॥11॥

4.2.s:
svapne jñāne tvayi manaḥ smarāmi tvatpadāṃbujam ..
tava dāsyaṃ vinā nātha na jīvāmi kṣaṇaṃ vibho .. 12 ..
4.2.d:
स्वप्ने ज्ञाने त्वयि मनः स्मरामि त्वत्पदांबुजम् ॥
तव दास्यं विना नाथ न जीवामि क्षणं विभो ॥ 12 ॥

4.2.s:
kṛṣṇastadvacanaṃ śrutvā bodhayāmāsa suṃdarīm ..
vakṣasi preyasīṃ kṛtvā cakāra nirbhayāṃ ca tām ..13..
4.2.d:
कृष्णस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा बोधयामास सुंदरीम् ॥
वक्षसि प्रेयसीं कृत्वा चकार निर्भयां च ताम् ॥13॥

4.2.s:
mahītalaṃ gamiṣyāmi vārāhe ca varānane ..
mayā sārdhaṃ bhūgamanaṃ janma te'pi nirūpitam ..14..
4.2.d:
महीतलं गमिष्यामि वाराहे च वरानने ॥
मया सार्धं भूगमनं जन्म तेऽपि निरूपितम् ॥14॥

4.2.s:
vrajaṃ gatvā vraje devi vihariṣyāmi kānane ..
mama prāṇādhikā tvaṃ ca bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite ..15..
4.2.d:
व्रजं गत्वा व्रजे देवि विहरिष्यामि कानने ॥
मम प्राणाधिका त्वं च भयं किं ते मयि स्थिते ॥15॥

4.2.s:
tāmityuktvā haristatra virarāma jagatpatiḥ ..
ato hetorjagannātho jagāma naṃdagokulam.. 15 ..
4.2.d:
तामित्युक्त्वा हरिस्तत्र विरराम जगत्पतिः ॥
अतो हेतोर्जगन्नाथो जगाम नंदगोकुलम्॥ 15 ॥

4.2.s:
kiṃ vā tasya bhayaṃ kaṃsādbhayāṃtakārakasya ca ..
māyā bhayacchalenaiva jagāma rādhikāṃtikam .. 17 ..
4.2.d:
किं वा तस्य भयं कंसाद्भयांतकारकस्य च ॥
माया भयच्छलेनैव जगाम राधिकांतिकम् ॥ 17 ॥

4.2.s:
vijahāra tayā sārdhaṃ gopaveṣaṃ vidhāya saḥ ..
saha gopāṃganābhiśca pratijñāpālanāya ca ..18..
4.2.d:
विजहार तया सार्धं गोपवेषं विधाय सः ॥
सह गोपांगनाभिश्च प्रतिज्ञापालनाय च ॥18॥

4.2.s:
brahmaṇā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samāgatya mahītalam ..
bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtvā jagāma svālayaṃ vibhuḥ .. 19 ..
4.2.d:
ब्रह्मणा प्रार्थितः कृष्णः समागत्य महीतलम् ॥
भारावतरणं कृत्वा जगाम स्वालयं विभुः ॥ 19 ॥

4.2.s:
nārada uvāca ..
śrīdāmnaḥ kalahaścaiva kathaṃ vā rādhayā saha ..
saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃvyasya kathayādhunā .. 4.2.20 .. ..
4.2.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
श्रीदाम्नः कलहश्चैव कथं वा राधया सह ॥
संक्षेपात्कथितं पूर्वं संव्यस्य कथयाधुना ॥ 4.2.20 ॥ ॥

4.2.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
ekadā rādhayā sārdhaṃ goloke śrīhariḥ svayam ..
vijahāra mahāraṇye nirjane rāsamaṃḍale .. .. 21 ..
4.2.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
एकदा राधया सार्धं गोलोके श्रीहरिः स्वयम् ॥
विजहार महारण्ये निर्जने रासमंडले ॥ ॥ 21 ॥
4.2.m:
Once, along with Rādhā in Goloka, Śrī Hari himself
sported in the great forest in the solitary circle of the rāsa. // 21

4.2.s:
rādhikāsukhasaṃbhogād bubudhe na svakaṃ param..
kṛtvā vihāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇastāmapṛṣṭvā vihāya ca..22..
4.2.d:
राधिकासुखसंभोगाद् बुबुधे न स्वकं परम्॥
कृत्वा विहारं श्रीकृष्णस्तामपृष्ट्वा विहाय च॥22॥
4.2.m:
From the enjoyment of bliss with Rādhikā, he was aware of neither himself nor another.
Having finished his sporting, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, without asking her, left her,

4.2.s:
gopikāṃ virajāmanyāṃ śṛṅgārārthaṃ jagāma ha ..
vṛṃdāraṇye ca virajā subhagā rādhikāsamā ..23..
4.2.d:
गोपिकां विरजामन्यां शृङ्गारार्थं जगाम ह ॥
वृंदारण्ये च विरजा सुभगा राधिकासमा ॥23॥
4.2.m:
and went for amorous pleasure indeed to another cowherd maiden, Virajā. // 22
In Vṛndāvana, Virajā was fortunate and equal to Rādhikā;

4.2.s:
tasyā vayasyāḥ suṃdaryo gopīnāṃ śatakoṭayaḥ ..
kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā gopī dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām ..24..
4.2.d:
तस्या वयस्याः सुंदर्यो गोपीनां शतकोटयः ॥
कृष्णप्राणाधिका गोपी धन्या मान्या च योषिताम् ॥24॥
4.2.m:
her friends were a billion beautiful cowherd maidens. // 23
She was a cowherd maiden dearer to Kṛṣṇa than his own life, blessed and honoured among women. // 24

4.2.s:
ratnasiṃhāsanasthā sā dadarśa harimantike..
dadarśa śrīharistāṃ ca śaraccaṃdranibhānanām ..25..
4.2.d:
रत्नसिंहासनस्था सा ददर्श हरिमन्तिके॥
ददर्श श्रीहरिस्तां च शरच्चंद्रनिभाननाम् ॥25॥
4.2.m:
Seated on a jewelled throne, she saw Hari nearby,
and Śrī Hari saw her, whose face resembled the autumn moon, // 25

4.2.s:
manoharāṃ sasmitāṃ ca paśyaṃtīṃ vakracakṣuṣā ..
sadā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ prodbhinnanavayauvanām ..26..
4.2.d:
मनोहरां सस्मितां च पश्यंतीं वक्रचक्षुषा ॥
सदा षोडशवर्षीयां प्रोद्भिन्ननवयौवनाम् ॥26॥
4.2.m:
enchanting, smiling, looking with sidelong glances,
ever sixteen years of age, her fresh youth just blossoming, // 26

4.2.s:
ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ bhūṣitāṃ śuklavāsasā ..
pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgīṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitām ..27..
4.2.d:
रत्नालंकारशोभाढ्यां भूषितां शुक्लवाससा ॥
पुलकांकितसर्वांगीं कामबाणप्रपीडिताम् ॥27॥
4.2.m:
abundant in the splendour of jewelled ornaments, adorned in white garments,
all her limbs marked with horripilation, tormented by the arrows of love. // 27

4.2.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ śrīharistūrṇaṃ vijahāra tayā saha ..
puṣpatalpe mahāraṇye nirjane ratnamaṃḍape ..28..
4.2.d:
दृष्ट्वा तां श्रीहरिस्तूर्णं विजहार तया सह ॥
पुष्पतल्पे महारण्ये निर्जने रत्नमंडपे ॥28॥
4.2.m:
Seeing her, Śrī Hari quickly sported with her
upon a bed of flowers in the great forest, in a solitary jewelled pavilion. // 28

4.2.s:
mūrcchāmavāpa virajā kṛṣṇaśṛṃgārakautukāt ..
kṛtvā vakṣasi prāṇeśaṃ koṭikaṃdarpasannibham .. 29 ..
4.2.d:
मूर्च्छामवाप विरजा कृष्णशृंगारकौतुकात् ॥
कृत्वा वक्षसि प्राणेशं कोटिकंदर्पसन्निभम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.2.m:
Virajā swooned from the delight of lovemaking with Kṛṣṇa,
holding to her breast the lord of her life, who resembled ten million Kāmadevas. // 29

4.2.s:
tayā saktaṃ śrīhariṃ ca ratnamaṃḍapasaṃsthitam ..
dṛṣṭvā ca rādhikālyaśca cakrustāṃ ca nivedanam .. 4.2.30 ..
4.2.d:
तया सक्तं श्रीहरिं च रत्नमंडपसंस्थितम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा च राधिकाल्यश्च चक्रुस्तां च निवेदनम् ॥ 4.2.30 ॥
4.2.m:
Seeing Śrī Hari attached to her, staying in the jewelled pavilion,
Rādhikā's female companions reported it to her. // 30

4.2.s:
tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā suṣvāpa ca cukopa ha ..
bhṛśaṃ ruroda sā devī raktapaṃkajalocanā .. 31 ..
4.2.d:
तासां च वचनं श्रुत्वा सुष्वाप च चुकोप ह ॥
भृशं रुरोद सा देवी रक्तपंकजलोचना ॥ 31 ॥
4.2.m:
Hearing their words, she lay down and grew furious;
the goddess wept bitterly, her eyes [red like] red lotuses. // 31

4.2.s:
tā uvāca mahādevī māṃ taṃ darśayituṃ kṣamāḥ ..
yadi satyaṃ brūta yūyaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ pragacchata .. 32 ..
4.2.d:
ता उवाच महादेवी मां तं दर्शयितुं क्षमाः ॥
यदि सत्यं ब्रूत यूयं मया सार्धं प्रगच्छत ॥ 32 ॥
4.2.m:
The great goddess said to them: “Are you able to show him to me?
If you speak the truth, come along with me. // 32

4.2.s:
kariṣyāmi phalaṃ gopyāḥ kṛṣṇasya ca yathocitam ..
ko rakṣitā'dya tasyāśca mayi śāstiṃ prakurvati .. 33 ..
4.2.d:
करिष्यामि फलं गोप्याः कृष्णस्य च यथोचितम् ॥
को रक्षिताऽद्य तस्याश्च मयि शास्तिं प्रकुर्वति ॥ 33 ॥
4.2.m:
I will give the cowherd maiden and Kṛṣṇa the fruit they deserve!
Who will protect her today when I inflict punishment? // 33

4.2.s:
śīghramānayatālyaśca tayā sārddhaṃ hariṃ priyam ..
aṃtarvaktraṃ sasmitaṃ ca viṣakuṃbhaṃ sudhāmukham .. 34 ..
4.2.d:
शीघ्रमानयताल्यश्च तया सार्द्धं हरिं प्रियम् ॥
अंतर्वक्त्रं सस्मितं च विषकुंभं सुधामुखम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.2.m:
Bring quickly, friends, that beloved Hari along with her—
he whose face smiles inwardly, a vessel of poison with nectar at its rim! // 34

4.2.s:
madāśrayaṃ samāgaṃtuṃ yūyaṃ dāsaṃ na dāsyatha ..
tameva maṃḍapaṃ ramyaṃ yāta saṃrakṣateśvaram .. 35 ..
4.2.d:
मदाश्रयं समागंतुं यूयं दासं न दास्यथ ॥
तमेव मंडपं रम्यं यात संरक्षतेश्वरम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.2.m:
You will not allow that servant to return to my shelter!
Go to that very charming pavilion; guard the master!” // 35

4.2.s:
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā kāścidgopyo bhayānvitāḥ ..
tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃpuṭāṃjalyo bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharāḥ ..
tāmūcuḥ purataḥ sthitvā sarvā eva priyāṃ satīm .. 36 ..
4.2.d:
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा काश्चिद्गोप्यो भयान्विताः ॥
ताः सर्वाः संपुटांजल्यो भक्तिनम्रात्मकंधराः ॥
तामूचुः पुरतः स्थित्वा सर्वा एव प्रियां सतीम् ॥ 36 ॥

4.2.s:
.. ālya ūcuḥ ..
vayaṃ taṃ darśayiṣyāmo virajāsahitaṃ vibhum .. 37 ..
4.2.d:
॥ आल्य ऊचुः ॥
वयं तं दर्शयिष्यामो विरजासहितं विभुम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.2.m: “We will show you the all-pervading lord together with Virajā.” // 37

4.2.s:
tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā rathamāruhya suṃdarī ..
jagāma sārdhaṃ gopībhistriṣaṣṭiśatakoṭibhiḥ .. 38 ..
4.2.d:
तासां च वचनं श्रुत्वा रथमारुह्य सुंदरी ॥
जगाम सार्धं गोपीभिस्त्रिषष्टिशतकोटिभिः ॥ 38 ॥
4.2.m:
Hearing their words, the beautiful woman mounted a chariot
and went forth, accompanied by sixty-three billion cowherd maidens, // 38

4.2.s:
ratneṃdrasāraracitaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham ..
maṇīṃdrasāraracitaṃ kalaśānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ .. 39 ..
4.2.d:
रत्नेंद्रसाररचितं कोटिसूर्यसमप्रभम् ॥
मणींद्रसाररचितं कलशानां त्रिकोटिभिः ॥ 39 ॥
4.2.m:
[in a chariot] crafted from the essence of supreme jewels, radiant like ten million suns,
fashioned from the essence of prime gems, with thirty million finials. // 39

4.2.s:
rājitaṃ citrarājībhirvaijayaṃtīvirājitam ..
lakṣacakrasamāyuktaṃ manoyāyi manoharam .. 4.2.40 ..
4.2.d:
राजितं चित्रराजीभिर्वैजयंतीविराजितम् ॥
लक्षचक्रसमायुक्तं मनोयायि मनोहरम् ॥ 4.2.40 ॥
4.2.m:
shining with wonderful patterns, resplendent with victory banners,
fitted with a hundred thousand wheels, moving at the speed of thought, captivating;

4.2.s:
maṇisāravikāraiśca koṭistaṃbhaiḥ suśobhitam ..
nānācitravicitraiśca sahitaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ .. 41 ..
4.2.d:
मणिसारविकारैश्च कोटिस्तंभैः सुशोभितम् ॥
नानाचित्रविचित्रैश्च सहितैः सुमनोहरैः ॥ 41 ॥
4.2.m:
well adorned with ten million pillars fashioned from the best of gems,
joined with diverse, multicoloured, most charming [ornaments],

4.2.s:
siṃdūrākāramaṇibhirmadhyadeśe vibhūṣitaiḥ ..
ratnakṛtrimasiṃhaiśca rathacakrordhvasaṃsthitaiḥ .. 42 ..
4.2.d:
सिंदूराकारमणिभिर्मध्यदेशे विभूषितैः ॥
रत्नकृत्रिमसिंहैश्च रथचक्रोर्ध्वसंस्थितैः ॥ 42 ॥
4.2.m:
decorated in its middle portion with gems resembling vermilion,
and with artificial lions made of gems stationed above the chariot wheels;

4.2.s:
caturlakṣaparimitaiścitraghaṃṭāsamanvitaiḥ ..
citraputtaliśobhāḍhyairvicitraiśca virājitam .. 43 ..
4.2.d:
चतुर्लक्षपरिमितैश्चित्रघंटासमन्वितैः ॥
चित्रपुत्तलिशोभाढ्यैर्विचित्रैश्च विराजितम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.2.m:
measuring four hundred thousand [cubits], furnished with wondrous bells,
rich in the beauty of wondrous dolls, shining and diverse;

4.2.s:
ratimaṃdiralakṣaiśca ratnasāravinirmitaiḥ ..
maṇisārakapāṭaiśca śobhitaiścitravājibhiḥ .. 44 ..
4.2.d:
रतिमंदिरलक्षैश्च रत्नसारविनिर्मितैः ॥
मणिसारकपाटैश्च शोभितैश्चित्रवाजिभिः ॥ 44 ॥
4.2.m:
with a hundred thousand pleasure chambers crafted from the best of jewels,
with doors of the best gems, and adorned with wondrous horses;

4.2.s:
maṇīṃdrasārakalaśaiḥ śekharojjvalitairyutam ..
bhogadravyasamāyuktaṃ veṣadravyasamanvitam .. 45 ..
4.2.d:
मणींद्रसारकलशैः शेखरोज्ज्वलितैर्युतम् ॥
भोगद्रव्यसमायुक्तं वेषद्रव्यसमन्वितम् ॥ 45 ॥
4.2.m:
fitted with pinnacles blazing with finial pots of the best gems;
furnished with articles for enjoyment, and stocked with articles of adornment;

4.2.s:
śobhitaṃ ratnaśayyābhī ratnapātraghaṭānvitam ..
harinmaṇīnāṃ vedīnāṃ samūhena samanvitam .. 46 ..
4.2.d:
शोभितं रत्नशय्याभी रत्नपात्रघटान्वितम् ॥
हरिन्मणीनां वेदीनां समूहेन समन्वितम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.2.m:
adorned with jewelled beds, accompanied by jewelled vessels and jars;
provided with an array of altars made of emeralds;

4.2.s:
kuṃkumābhamaṇīnāṃ ca sopānaiḥ koṭibhiryutam ..
syamaṃtakaiḥ kaustubhaiśca rucakaiḥ pravaraistathā .. 47 ..
4.2.d:
कुंकुमाभमणीनां च सोपानैः कोटिभिर्युतम् ॥
स्यमंतकैः कौस्तुभैश्च रुचकैः प्रवरैस्तथा ॥ 47 ॥
4.2.m:
endowed with tens of millions of stairs made of gems resembling saffron,
as well as with Syamantakas, Kaustubhas, and choice Rucakas;

4.2.s:
padmakṛtrimakoṭīnāṃ śatakaiśca suśobhitam ..
citrakānanavāpībhi rviśiṣṭābhirvirājitam .. 48 ..
4.2.d:
पद्मकृत्रिमकोटीनां शतकैश्च सुशोभितम् ॥
चित्रकाननवापीभि र्विशिष्टाभिर्विराजितम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.2.m:
well adorned with hundreds of tens of millions of artificial lotuses,
and resplendent with excellent stepwells and wondrous groves;

4.2.s:
ratneṃdrasāraracitakalaśojjvalaśekharam ..
śatayojanamūrdhvaṃ ca daśayojanavistṛtam .. 49 ..
4.2.d:
रत्नेंद्रसाररचितकलशोज्ज्वलशेखरम् ॥
शतयोजनमूर्ध्वं च दशयोजनविस्तृतम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.2.m:
with radiant pinnacles topped by pots made of the essence of fine gems;
a hundred yojanas high and ten yojanas wide;

4.2.s:
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālākoṭivirājitam ..
kuṃdānā karavīrāṇāṃ yūthikānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 4.2.50 ..
4.2.d:
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाकोटिविराजितम् ॥
कुंदाना करवीराणां यूथिकानां तथैव च ॥ 4.2.50 ॥
4.2.m:
resplendent with ten million garlands of pārijāta blossoms,
and likewise of kundas, karavīras, and yūthikās,

4.2.s:
sucārucaṃpakānāṃ ca nāgeśānāṃ manoharaiḥ ..
mallikānāṃ mālatīnāṃ mādhavīnāṃ sugaṃdhinām .. 51 ..
4.2.d:
सुचारुचंपकानां च नागेशानां मनोहरैः ॥
मल्लिकानां मालतीनां माधवीनां सुगंधिनाम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.2.m:
and lovely campakas, and charming nāgeśvaras,
of fragrant mallikās, mālatīs, and mādhavīs;

4.2.s:
kadaṃbānāṃ ca mālānāṃ kadaṃbaiśca virājitam ..
sahasradalapadmānāṃ mālābhiśca virājitam .. 52 ..
4.2.d:
कदंबानां च मालानां कदंबैश्च विराजितम् ॥
सहस्रदलपद्मानां मालाभिश्च विराजितम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.2.m:
resplendent with clusters of kadamba garlands,
and adorned with garlands of thousand-petalled lotuses;

4.2.s:
citrapuṣpodyānasaraḥ kānanaiśca vibhūṣitam ..
sarveṣāṃ syaṃdanānāṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ vāyuvahaṃ param .. 53 ..
4.2.d:
चित्रपुष्पोद्यानसरः काननैश्च विभूषितम् ॥
सर्वेषां स्यंदनानां च श्रेष्ठं वायुवहं परम् ॥ 53 ॥
4.2.m:
embellished with wondrous flower gardens, lakes, and groves;
the best of all chariots, supreme, borne by the wind;

4.2.s:
tatsūkṣmavastrasārāṇāṃ varairācchāditaṃ param ..
ratnadarpaṇalakṣāṇāṃ śatakaiśca samanvitam .. 54 ..
4.2.d:
तत्सूक्ष्मवस्त्रसाराणां वरैराच्छादितं परम् ॥
रत्नदर्पणलक्षाणां शतकैश्च समन्वितम् ॥ 54 ॥
4.2.m:
covered with the finest choice, delicate fabrics, supreme,
and furnished with hundreds of hundreds of thousands of jewel mirrors;

4.2.s:
śvetacāmarakoṭībhirvajrakoṭibhiranvitam ..
candanāgarukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitaiḥ .. 55 ..
4.2.d:
श्वेतचामरकोटीभिर्वज्रकोटिभिरन्वितम् ॥
चन्दनागरुकस्तूरीकुंकुमद्रवचर्चितैः ॥ 55 ॥
4.2.m:
provided with tens of millions of white fly-whisks and tens of millions of diamonds,
anointed with pastes of sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and saffron;

4.2.s:
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ koṭitalpavirājitam ..
koṭighaṃṭāsamāyuktaṃ patākākoṭibhiryutam .. 56 ..
4.2.d:
पारिजातप्रसूनानां कोटितल्पविराजितम् ॥
कोटिघंटासमायुक्तं पताकाकोटिभिर्युतम् ॥ 56 ॥
4.2.m:
resplendent with tens of millions of beds of pārijāta blossoms,
joined with ten million bells and ten million banners;

4.2.s:
ratnaśayyākoṭibhiśca citravajraparicchadaiḥ ..
caṃdanāktaiścaṃpakānāṃ kuṃkumaiśca vicitritaiḥ .. 57 ..
4.2.d:
रत्नशय्याकोटिभिश्च चित्रवज्रपरिच्छदैः ॥
चंदनाक्तैश्चंपकानां कुंकुमैश्च विचित्रितैः ॥ 57 ॥
4.2.m:
with tens of millions of jewelled beds and varied diamond canopies,
smeared with sandalwood, and variegated with campaka saffron;

4.2.s:
puṣpopadhānasaṃyuktaiḥ śṛṃgārārhābhiranvitam ..
adṛśyairaśrutairdravyaiḥ suṃdaraiśca vibhūṣitam .. 58 ..
4.2.d:
पुष्पोपधानसंयुक्तैः शृंगारार्हाभिरन्वितम् ॥
अदृश्यैरश्रुतैर्द्रव्यैः सुंदरैश्च विभूषितम् ॥ 58 ॥
4.2.m:
endowed with pillows of flowers, suited for love;
and embellished with beautiful treasures unseen and unheard of.

4.2.s:
evaṃbhūtādrathāttūrṇamavaruhya haripriyā ..
jagāma sahasā devī taṃ ratnamaṃḍapaṃ mune .. 59 ..
4.2.d:
एवंभूताद्रथात्तूर्णमवरुह्य हरिप्रिया ॥
जगाम सहसा देवी तं रत्नमंडपं मुने ॥ 59 ॥
4.2.m:
Quickly descending from such a chariot, Hari’s beloved,
the goddess, O sage, went at once to that jewelled pavilion.

4.2.s:
dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśe dvārapālaṃ manoharam ..
lakṣagopaiḥ parivṛtaṃ smerānanasaroruham .. 4.2.60 ..
4.2.d:
द्वारे नियुक्तं ददृशे द्वारपालं मनोहरम् ॥
लक्षगोपैः परिवृतं स्मेराननसरोरुहम् ॥ 4.2.60 ॥
4.2.m:
She saw a handsome doorkeeper stationed at the door,
surrounded by a hundred thousand cowherds, his lotus-face smiling:

4.2.s:
gopaṃ śrīdāmanāmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapriyakiṃkaram ..
tamuvāca ruṣā devī raktapaṃkajalocanā .. 61 ..
4.2.d:
गोपं श्रीदामनामानं श्रीकृष्णप्रियकिंकरम् ॥
तमुवाच रुषा देवी रक्तपंकजलोचना ॥ 61 ॥
4.2.m:
the cowherd named Śrīdāman, the beloved servant of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
To him the goddess spoke in fury, her eyes like red lotuses:

4.2.s:
gaccha dūraṃ gaccha dūraṃ ratilaṃpaṭakiṃkara ..
kīdṛśīṃ matparāṃ kāṃtāṃ drakṣyāmi tvatprabhoraham .. 62 ..
4.2.d:
गच्छ दूरं गच्छ दूरं रतिलंपटकिंकर ॥
कीदृशीं मत्परां कांतां द्रक्ष्यामि त्वत्प्रभोरहम् ॥ 62 ॥
4.2.m:
“Away, go far away, servant of a lustful lover!
What sort of beloved superior to me shall I see of your master?”

4.2.s:
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā niḥśaṃkaḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ ..
tāmeva na dadau gaṃtuṃ vetrapāṇirmahābalaḥ .. 63 ..
4.2.d:
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा निःशंकः पुरतः स्थितः ॥
तामेव न ददौ गंतुं वेत्रपाणिर्महाबलः ॥ 63 ॥
4.2.m:
Hearing Rādhikā’s words, he stood before her without fear;
cane in hand, the mighty one did not allow her to enter.

4.2.s:
tūrṇaṃ ca rādhikālyaśca śrīdāmānaṃ sakiṃkaram ..
balena prerayāmāsuḥ kopena sphuritādharāḥ .. 64 ..
4.2.d:
तूर्णं च राधिकाल्यश्च श्रीदामानं सकिंकरम् ॥
बलेन प्रेरयामासुः कोपेन स्फुरिताधराः ॥ 64 ॥
4.2.m:
Then Rādhikā’s female companions quickly thrust away Śrīdāman
together with his attendants by force, their lips trembling with anger.

4.2.s:
śrutvā kolāhalaṃ śabdaṃ gopikānāṃ hariḥ svayam ..
jñātvā ca kopitāṃ rādhāmaṃtardhānaṃ cakāra ha .. 65 ..
4.2.d:
श्रुत्वा कोलाहलं शब्दं गोपिकानां हरिः स्वयम् ॥
ज्ञात्वा च कोपितां राधामंतर्धानं चकार ह ॥ 65 ॥
4.2.m:
Hearing the clamorous sound of the cowherd women, Hari himself,
knowing that Rādhā was enraged, made himself disappear.

4.2.s:
virajā rādhikāśabdādaṃtardhānaṃ harerapi ..
dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ bhayārtā sā jahau prāṇāṃśca yogataḥ .. 66 ..
4.2.d:
विरजा राधिकाशब्दादंतर्धानं हरेरपि ॥
दृष्ट्वा राधां भयार्ता सा जहौ प्राणांश्च योगतः ॥ 66 ॥
4.2.m:
Virajā, hearing the voice of Rādhikā and [noticing] Hari’s disappearance,
and seeing Rādhā, was stricken with fear and gave up her life-breaths through yoga.

4.2.s:
sadyastatra saridrūpaṃ taccharīraṃ babhūva ha ..
vyāptaṃ ca vartulākāraṃ tayā golokameva ca .. 67 ..
4.2.d:
सद्यस्तत्र सरिद्रूपं तच्छरीरं बभूव ह ॥
व्याप्तं च वर्तुलाकारं तया गोलोकमेव च ॥ 67 ॥
4.2.m:
Instantly her body turned into the form of a river,
and in circular shape it encompassed Goloka itself;

4.2.s:
koṭiyojanavistīrṇaṃ prasthe'tinimnameva ca ..
dairghye daśaguṇaṃ cāru nānāratnākaraṃ param .. 68 .. ..
4.2.d:
कोटियोजनविस्तीर्णं प्रस्थेऽतिनिम्नमेव च ॥
दैर्घ्ये दशगुणं चारु नानारत्नाकरं परम् ॥ 68 ॥ ॥
4.2.m:
ten million yojanas broad, extremely deep in width,
ten times that in length, lovely, a supreme mine of diverse gems.

4.3.s:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
rādhā ratigṛhaṃ gatvā na dadarśa hariṃ mune ..
virajāṃ ca saridūpāṃ dṛṣṭvā gehaṃ jagāma sā..1..
4.3.d:
॥ श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
राधा रतिगृहं गत्वा न ददर्श हरिं मुने ॥
विरजां च सरिदूपां दृष्ट्वा गेहं जगाम सा॥1॥
4.3.m:
Rādhā, having gone to the house of pleasure, did not see Hari, O sage.
And seeing Virajā in the form of a river, she went home.

4.3.s:
śrīkṛṣṇo virajāṃ dṛṣṭvā saridrūpāṃ priyāṃ satīm ..
uccai ruroda virajātīre nīramanohare..2..
4.3.d:
श्रीकृष्णो विरजां दृष्ट्वा सरिद्रूपां प्रियां सतीम् ॥
उच्चै रुरोद विरजातीरे नीरमनोहरे॥2॥
4.3.m:
Seeing Virajā, his beloved, faithful woman, in the form of a river,
Śrī Kṛṣṇa wept aloud on the bank of the Virajā, charming with its waters:

4.3.s:
mamāṃtikaṃ samāgaccha preyasīnāṃ pare vare ..
tvayā vinā'haṃ subhage kathaṃ jīvāmi suṃdari .. 3 ..
4.3.d:
ममांतिकं समागच्छ प्रेयसीनां परे वरे ॥
त्वया विनाऽहं सुभगे कथं जीवामि सुंदरि ॥ 3 ॥
4.3.m:
“Come near to me, O supreme and excellent among beloved women!
Without you, O fortunate one, how can I live, O beautiful woman?

4.3.s:
nadyadhiṣṭhātri devi tvaṃ bhava mūrtimatī satī ..
mamāśiṣā rūpavatī suṃdarī yoṣitā varā..4..
4.3.d:
नद्यधिष्ठात्रि देवि त्वं भव मूर्तिमती सती ॥
ममाशिषा रूपवती सुंदरी योषिता वरा॥4॥
4.3.m:
O goddess presiding over the river, become an embodied, faithful woman,
shapely, beautiful, the best of women, by my blessing!

4.3.s:
pūrvarūpācca saubhāgyādidānīṃ subhagā bhava ..
purātanaṃ śarīraṃ te saridūpamabhūtsati ..5..
4.3.d:
पूर्वरूपाच्च सौभाग्यादिदानीं सुभगा भव ॥
पुरातनं शरीरं ते सरिदूपमभूत्सति ॥5॥
4.3.m:
Become fortunate now beyond your former beauty and good fortune.
Your former body became the river-form, O faithful woman;

4.3.s:
jalādutthāya cāgaccha vidhāya tanumuttamām..
aṣṭau siddhīrmayā dattāḥ surasuṃdari satvaram .. 6 ..
4.3.d:
जलादुत्थाय चागच्छ विधाय तनुमुत्तमाम्॥
अष्टौ सिद्धीर्मया दत्ताः सुरसुंदरि सत्वरम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.3.m:
rising from the water, come, having assumed an excellent body.
The eight supernatural powers have been given by me swiftly, O divine beauty!”

4.3.s:
kṛṣṇājñayā ca virajā vidhāya tanumuttamām ..
ājagāma hareragre sākṣādrādheva suṃdarī .. 7 ..
4.3.d:
कृष्णाज्ञया च विरजा विधाय तनुमुत्तमाम् ॥
आजगाम हरेरग्रे साक्षाद्राधेव सुंदरी ॥ 7 ॥
4.3.m:
And by Kṛṣṇa’s command, Virajā, having assumed an excellent body,
came before Hari, beautiful like Rādhā in bodily presence,

4.3.s:
pītavastraparīdhānā smerānanasaroruhā ..
paśyaṃtaṃ prāṇanāthaṃ ca paśyaṃtī vakracakṣuṣā .. 8 ..
4.3.d:
पीतवस्त्रपरीधाना स्मेराननसरोरुहा ॥
पश्यंतं प्राणनाथं च पश्यंती वक्रचक्षुषा ॥ 8 ॥
4.3.m:
wearing yellow garments, her face like a smiling lotus,
gazing with sidelong glances at the lord of her life who was looking [at her],

4.3.s:
nitaṃbaśroṇibhārārtā pīnonnatapayodharā ..
māninī māninīnāṃ ca gajeṃdramaṃdagāminī .. 9 ..
4.3.d:
नितंबश्रोणिभारार्ता पीनोन्नतपयोधरा ॥
मानिनी मानिनीनां च गजेंद्रमंदगामिनी ॥ 9 ॥
4.3.m:
weighed down by the heavy burden of her hips and buttocks, with full, elevated breasts,
proud among proud women, moving with the slow gait of a royal elephant,

4.3.s:
suṃdarī sudarīṇāṃ ca dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām ..
cārucaṃpakavarṇābhā pakvabiṃbādharā varā ..4.3.10..
4.3.d:
सुंदरी सुदरीणां च धन्या मान्या च योषिताम् ॥
चारुचंपकवर्णाभा पक्वबिंबाधरा वरा ॥4.3.10॥
4.3.m:
beautiful among beautiful women, blessed and honoured among wives,
with a hue radiant like the lovely campaka, excellent, with lower lip like a ripe bimba fruit,

4.3.s:
pakva dāḍimabījābhadaṃtapaṃktimanoharā ..
śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyā phulleṃdīvaralocanā .. 11 ..
4.3.d:
पक्व दाडिमबीजाभदंतपंक्तिमनोहरा ॥
शरत्पार्वणचंद्रास्या फुल्लेंदीवरलोचना ॥ 11 ॥
4.3.m: with a face like the autumn full moon, with eyes like blossomed blue lotuses,

4.3.s:
kastūrībiṃdunā sārdhaṃ siṃdūrabiṃdubhūṣitā ..
cārupatraka śobhāḍhyā sucārukabarīyutā .. 12 ..
4.3.d:
कस्तूरीबिंदुना सार्धं सिंदूरबिंदुभूषिता ॥
चारुपत्रक शोभाढ्या सुचारुकबरीयुता ॥ 12 ॥
4.3.m:
adorned with a mark of vermilion together with a drop of musk,
rich in the beauty of lovely leaf-designs, endowed with a very lovely braid of hair,

4.3.s:
ratnakuṃḍalagaṃḍasthā bhūṣitā ratnamālayā ..
gajamauktikanāsāgrā muktāhāravirājitā .. 13 ..
4.3.d:
रत्नकुंडलगंडस्था भूषिता रत्नमालया ॥
गजमौक्तिकनासाग्रा मुक्ताहारविराजिता ॥ 13 ॥
4.3.m:
with cheeks [bearing the glow] of jewelled earrings, adorned with a necklace of jewels,
the tip of her nose [adorned with] an elephant-pearl, radiant with a necklace of pearls,

4.3.s:
ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūracāruśaṃkhakarojjvalā ..
kiṃkiṇījālaśabdāḍhyā ratnamaṃjīraraṃjitā .. 14 ..
4.3.d:
रत्नकंकणकेयूरचारुशंखकरोज्ज्वला ॥
किंकिणीजालशब्दाढ्या रत्नमंजीररंजिता ॥ 14 ॥
4.3.m:
her hands dazzling with jewelled bracelets, armlets, and lovely conch-bangles,
resounding with the tinkling of a network of small bells, beautified by jewelled anklets.

4.3.s:
tāṃ ca rūpavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā premodrekā jagatpatiḥ ..
cakārāliṃganaṃ tūrṇaṃ cucuṃba ca muhurmuhuḥ ..15..
4.3.d:
तां च रूपवतीं दृष्ट्वा प्रेमोद्रेका जगत्पतिः ॥
चकारालिंगनं तूर्णं चुचुंब च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥15॥
4.3.m:
And seeing her shapely form, the Lord of the universe, out of an overflow of love,
embraced her swiftly and kissed her again and again.

4.3.s:
nānāprakāraśṛṃgāraṃ viparītādikaṃ vibhuḥ ..
rahasi preyasīṃ prāpya cakāra ca punaḥ punaḥ .. 16 ..
4.3.d:
नानाप्रकारशृंगारं विपरीतादिकं विभुः ॥
रहसि प्रेयसीं प्राप्य चकार च पुनः पुनः ॥ 16 ॥
4.3.m:
Diverse modes of lovemaking, inverted intercourse and the like,
the all-pervading Lord, having gained his beloved in secret, engaged in again and again.

4.3.s:
virajā sā rajoyuktā dhṛtvā vīryamamoghakam ..
sadyo babhūva tatraiva dhanyā garbhavatī satī.. 17 ..
4.3.d:
विरजा सा रजोयुक्ता धृत्वा वीर्यममोघकम् ॥
सद्यो बभूव तत्रैव धन्या गर्भवती सती॥ 17 ॥
4.3.m:
That Virajā, being in her fertile period and receiving his unfailing semen,
immediately became pregnant right there, blessed and faithful.

4.3.s:
dadhāra garbhamīśasya divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ ca sā ..
tataḥ suṣāva tatraiva putrānsapta manoharān .. 18 ..
4.3.d:
दधार गर्भमीशस्य दिव्यं वर्षशतं च सा ॥
ततः सुषाव तत्रैव पुत्रान्सप्त मनोहरान् ॥ 18 ॥
4.3.m:
She bore the seed of the Lord for a divine hundred years,
and then gave birth right there to seven charming sons.

4.3.s:
mātā sā saptaputrāṇāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya priyā satī ..
tasthau tatra sukhāsīnā sārddhaṃ putraiśca saptabhiḥ .. 19 ..
4.3.d:
माता सा सप्तपुत्राणां श्रीकृष्णस्य प्रिया सती ॥
तस्थौ तत्र सुखासीना सार्द्धं पुत्रैश्च सप्तभिः ॥ 19 ॥
4.3.m:
She, the mother of seven sons, the faithful beloved of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,
remained there seated at ease together with her seven sons.

4.3.s:
ekadā hariṇā sārddhaṃ vṛṃdāraṇye ca nirjane ..
vijahāra punaḥ sādhvī śṛṃgārāsaktamānasā .. 4.3.20 ..
4.3.d:
एकदा हरिणा सार्द्धं वृंदारण्ये च निर्जने ॥
विजहार पुनः साध्वी शृंगारासक्तमानसा ॥ 4.3.20 ॥
4.3.m:
Once, in the secluded Vṛndāraṇya with Hari,
The virtuous woman sported again, her mind intent on lovemaking.

4.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra mātuḥ kroḍaṃ jagāma ha ..
kaniṣṭhaputrastasyāśca bhrātṛbhiḥ pīḍito bhiyā .. 21 ..
4.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र मातुः क्रोडं जगाम ह ॥
कनिष्ठपुत्रस्तस्याश्च भ्रातृभिः पीडितो भिया ॥ 21 ॥
4.3.m:
In the meantime, there came to the mother’s lap
her youngest son, tormented by his brothers in fear.

4.3.s:
bhītaṃ svatanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatyāja tāṃ kṛpānidhiḥ ..
kroḍe cakāra bālaṃ sā kṛṣṇo rādhāgṛhaṃ yayau .. 22 ..
4.3.d:
भीतं स्वतनयं दृष्ट्वा तत्याज तां कृपानिधिः ॥
क्रोडे चकार बालं सा कृष्णो राधागृहं ययौ ॥ 22 ॥
4.3.m:
Seeing her own son frightened, the treasury of compassion left her.
She took the boy into her lap; Kṛṣṇa went to the house of Rādhā.

4.3.s:
prabodhya bālaṃ sā sādhvī na dadarśāṃtike priyam ..
vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ tatra śṛṃgārātṛptamānasā .. 23 ..
4.3.d:
प्रबोध्य बालं सा साध्वी न ददर्शांतिके प्रियम् ॥
विललाप भृशं तत्र शृंगारातृप्तमानसा ॥ 23 ॥
4.3.m:
Having comforted the child, the virtuous woman did not see her beloved near her.
She wailed bitterly there, her mind unsated by lovemaking.

4.3.s:
śaśāpa svasutaṃ kopāllavaṇodo bhaviṣyasi..
kadā'pi te jalaṃ kecinna khādiṣyaṃti jīvinaḥ .. 24 ..
4.3.d:
शशाप स्वसुतं कोपाल्लवणोदो भविष्यसि॥
कदाऽपि ते जलं केचिन्न खादिष्यंति जीविनः ॥ 24 ॥
4.3.m:
In anger she cursed her own son: 'You will become a salt-water ocean!
No living beings shall ever drink your water!'

4.3.s:
śaśāpa bālānsarvāṃśca yāṃtu mūḍhā mahītalam ..
gacchadhvaṃ ca mahīṃ mūḍhā jaṃbudvīpaṃ manoharam .. 25 ..
4.3.d:
शशाप बालान्सर्वांश्च यांतु मूढा महीतलम् ॥
गच्छध्वं च महीं मूढा जंबुद्वीपं मनोहरम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.3.m:
And she cursed all the boys: 'Let the fools go to the surface of the earth!
Go to the earth, fools, to charming Jambudvīpa!

4.3.s:
sthitirnaikatra yuṣmākaṃ bhaviṣyati pṛthakpṛthak ..
dvīpe dvīpe sthitiṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhaṃtu sukhinaḥ sadā .. 26 ..
4.3.d:
स्थितिर्नैकत्र युष्माकं भविष्यति पृथक्पृथक् ॥
द्वीपे द्वीपे स्थितिं कृत्वा तिष्ठंतु सुखिनः सदा ॥ 26 ॥
4.3.m:
Your dwelling will not be together in one place, but separate from each other.
Taking up residence in island after island, let them dwell ever happy.

4.3.s:
dvīpasthābhirnadībhiśca saha krīḍaṃtu nirjane ..
kaniṣṭho mātṛśāpācca lavaṇodo babhūva ha .. 27 ..
4.3.d:
द्वीपस्थाभिर्नदीभिश्च सह क्रीडंतु निर्जने ॥
कनिष्ठो मातृशापाच्च लवणोदो बभूव ह ॥ 27 ॥
4.3.m:
Let them sport in secret with the rivers residing in the islands.'
And by his mother's curse, the youngest became a salt-water ocean.

4.3.s:
kaniṣṭhaḥ kathayāmāsa mātṛśāpaṃ ca bālakān ..
ājagmurduḥkhitāḥ sarve mātṛsthāne ca bālakāḥ..28..
4.3.d:
कनिष्ठः कथयामास मातृशापं च बालकान् ॥
आजग्मुर्दुःखिताः सर्वे मातृस्थाने च बालकाः॥28॥
4.3.m:
The youngest told the mother’s curse to the [other] boys.
Sorrowful, all the boys came to their mother’s dwelling.

4.3.s:
śrutvā vivaraṇaṃ sarve prajagmurdharaṇītalam ..
praṇamya caraṇaṃ māturbhaktinamrātmamūrtayaḥ .. 29 ..
4.3.d:
श्रुत्वा विवरणं सर्वे प्रजग्मुर्धरणीतलम् ॥
प्रणम्य चरणं मातुर्भक्तिनम्रात्ममूर्तयः ॥ 29 ॥
4.3.m:
Having heard the whole account, all of them went to the surface of the earth.
Having bowed at their mother’s feet, their forms bent with devotion,

4.3.s:
saptadvīpasamudrāśca sapta tasthurvibhāgaśaḥ ..
kaniṣṭhādvṛddhaparyaṃtaṃ dviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ mune .. 4.3.30 ..
4.3.d:
सप्तद्वीपसमुद्राश्च सप्त तस्थुर्विभागशः ॥
कनिष्ठाद्वृद्धपर्यंतं द्विगुणं द्विगुणं मुने ॥ 4.3.30 ॥
4.3.m:
the seven oceans of the seven islands took their place separately,
from the youngest to the eldest, twice as large [each time], O sage:

4.3.s:
lavaṇekṣusurā sarpirdadhidugdhajalārṇavāḥ ..
eteṣāṃ ca jalaṃ pṛthvyāṃ sasyārthaṃ ca bhaviṣyati .. 31 ..
4.3.d:
लवणेक्षुसुरा सर्पिर्दधिदुग्धजलार्णवाः ॥
एतेषां च जलं पृथ्व्यां सस्यार्थं च भविष्यति ॥ 31 ॥
4.3.m:
the oceans of salt water, sugarcane juice, liquor, ghee, curds, milk, and sweet water.
And their water on earth shall be for the sake of crops.

4.3.s:
vyāptāḥ samudrāḥ saptaiva saptadvīpāṃ vasuṃdharām ..
rurudurbālakāḥ sarve mātṛbhrātṛśucā'nvitāḥ .. 32 ..
4.3.d:
व्याप्ताः समुद्राः सप्तैव सप्तद्वीपां वसुंधराम् ॥
रुरुदुर्बालकाः सर्वे मातृभ्रातृशुचाऽन्विताः ॥ 32 ॥
4.3.m:
The seven oceans covered the earth with its seven islands.
All the boys wept, filled with sorrow for their mother and brothers.

4.3.s:
ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ sādhvī putravicchedakātarā ..
mūrcchāmavāpa śokena putrāṇāṃ bhartureva ca .. 33 ..
4.3.d:
रुरोद च भृशं साध्वी पुत्रविच्छेदकातरा ॥
मूर्च्छामवाप शोकेन पुत्राणां भर्तुरेव च ॥ 33 ॥
4.3.m:
And the virtuous woman wept bitterly, distressed by separation from her sons;
she fell into a faint out of grief for her sons and her husband.

4.3.s:
tāṃ śokasāgare magnāṃ vijñāya rādhikāpatiḥ ..
ājagāma punastasyāḥ smerānanasaroruhaḥ .. 34 ..
4.3.d:
तां शोकसागरे मग्नां विज्ञाय राधिकापतिः ॥
आजगाम पुनस्तस्याः स्मेराननसरोरुहः ॥ 34 ॥
4.3.m:
Understanding that she was plunged in an ocean of grief, the lord of Rādhikā
came back to her, the lotus of his face smiling.

4.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā hariṃ sā tatyāja śokaṃ rodanameva ca ..
ānandasāgare magnā dṛṣṭvā kāṃtaṃ babhūva ha ..35..
4.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा हरिं सा तत्याज शोकं रोदनमेव च ॥
आनन्दसागरे मग्ना दृष्ट्वा कांतं बभूव ह ॥35॥
4.3.m:
Seeing Hari, she abandoned her grief and weeping;
seeing her beloved, she was plunged into an ocean of bliss.

4.3.s:
cakāra śrīhariṃ kroḍe vijahāra smarāturā ..
tāṃ ca putra parityaktāṃ haristuṣṭo babhūva ha.. 36 ..
4.3.d:
चकार श्रीहरिं क्रोडे विजहार स्मरातुरा ॥
तां च पुत्र परित्यक्तां हरिस्तुष्टो बभूव ह॥ 36 ॥
4.3.m:
She took Śrī Hari into her lap and sported, stricken with passion.
And Hari was pleased with her, who had abandoned her sons.

4.3.s:
varaṃ tasyai dadau prītyā prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ..
kāṃte nityaṃ tava sthānamāgamiṣyāmi niścitam .. 37 ..
4.3.d:
वरं तस्यै ददौ प्रीत्या प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणः ॥
कांते नित्यं तव स्थानमागमिष्यामि निश्चितम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.3.m:
With affectionate eyes and a cheerful face, he gave her a boon:
'Beloved, I will certainly come to your dwelling every day.

4.3.s:
yathā rādhā tatsamā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi priyā mama ..
putrāndrakṣyasi nityaṃ tvaṃ madvarasya prasādataḥ .. 38 ..
4.3.d:
यथा राधा तत्समा त्वं भविष्यसि प्रिया मम ॥
पुत्रान्द्रक्ष्यसि नित्यं त्वं मद्वरस्य प्रसादतः ॥ 38 ॥
4.3.m:
You will be dear to me, just equal to Rādhā.
By the grace of my boon, you will always see your sons.'

4.3.s:
ityuktavaṃtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vasaṃtaṃ virajāṃtike ..
dṛṣṭvā rādhāvayasyāśca kathayāmāsurīśvarīm .. 39 ..
4.3.d:
इत्युक्तवंतं श्रीकृष्णं वसंतं विरजांतिके ॥
दृष्ट्वा राधावयस्याश्च कथयामासुरीश्वरीम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.3.m:
Seeing Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who had spoken thus, staying near Virajā,
Rādhā’s female companions told the goddess.

4.3.s:
śrutvā ruroṣa sā devī suṣvāpa krodhamaṃdire ..
etasminnaṃtare kṛṣṇo jagāma rādhikāṃtikam .. 4.3.40 ..
4.3.d:
श्रुत्वा रुरोष सा देवी सुष्वाप क्रोधमंदिरे ॥
एतस्मिन्नंतरे कृष्णो जगाम राधिकांतिकम् ॥ 4.3.40 ॥
4.3.m:
Hearing this, the goddess became enraged and lay down in the chamber of anger.
In the meantime, Kṛṣṇa went into the presence of Rādhikā.

4.3.s:
sa tasthau rādhikādvāre śrīdāmnā saha nārada ..
rāseśvarī hariṃ dṛṣṭvā ruṣṭovāca priyaṃ puraḥ .. 41 ..
4.3.d:
स तस्थौ राधिकाद्वारे श्रीदाम्ना सह नारद ॥
रासेश्वरी हरिं दृष्ट्वा रुष्टोवाच प्रियं पुरः ॥ 41 ॥
4.3.m:
He stood at Rādhikā’s door together with Śrīdāman, O Nārada.
Seeing Hari, the queen of the rāsa-dance spoke angrily before her beloved:

4.3.s:
matto bahutarāḥ kāṃtā goloke saṃti te hare ..
yāhi tāsāṃ sannidhānaṃ mayā te kiṃ prayojanam .. 42 ..
4.3.d:
मत्तो बहुतराः कांता गोलोके संति ते हरे ॥
याहि तासां सन्निधानं मया ते किं प्रयोजनम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.3.m:
'You have many lovers in Goloka other than me, O Hari!
Go to their presence! What need have you of me?

4.3.s:
virajā preyasī kāṃtā saridrūpā babhūva ha ..
dehaṃ tyaktvā mama bhayāttathā'pi yāhi tāṃ prati .. 43 ..
4.3.d:
विरजा प्रेयसी कांता सरिद्रूपा बभूव ह ॥
देहं त्यक्त्वा मम भयात्तथाऽपि याहि तां प्रति ॥ 43 ॥
4.3.m:
Virajā, your beloved darling, turned into the form of a river
after abandoning her body out of fear of me; nevertheless, go to her!

4.3.s:
tattīre maṃdiraṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭha tiṣṭha ca yāhi tām..
nadī babhūva sā tvaṃ ca nado bhavitumarhasi .. 44 ..
4.3.d:
तत्तीरे मंदिरं कृत्वा तिष्ठ तिष्ठ च याहि ताम्॥
नदी बभूव सा त्वं च नदो भवितुमर्हसि ॥ 44 ॥
4.3.m:
Build a temple on her bank, stay and stay [there], and go to her!
She became a river, and you ought to become a male river!

4.3.s:
nadasya nadyā sārddhaṃ ca saṃgamo guṇavānbhavet ..
svajātau paramā prītiḥ śayane bhojane sukhāt .. 45 ..
4.3.d:
नदस्य नद्या सार्द्धं च संगमो गुणवान्भवेत् ॥
स्वजातौ परमा प्रीतिः शयने भोजने सुखात् ॥ 45 ॥
4.3.m:
Union of a male river with a female river would be fitting.
Supreme affection belongs within one's own kind, happily in sleeping and eating!

4.3.s:
devacūḍāmaṇeḥ krīḍā nadyā sārddhamaho bata ..
mahājanaḥ smeramukhaḥ śrutvā sadyo bhaviṣyati .. 46 ..
4.3.d:
देवचूडामणेः क्रीडा नद्या सार्द्धमहो बत ॥
महाजनः स्मेरमुखः श्रुत्वा सद्यो भविष्यति ॥ 46 ॥
4.3.m:
Ah, what sporting of the crest-jewel of the gods with a river!
The great folk will at once become smiling-faced upon hearing it!

4.3.s:
ye tvāṃ vadaṃti sarveśaṃ te kiṃ jānaṃti tattvataḥ ..
bhagavānsarvabhūtātmā nadīṃ saṃbhoktumicchati .. 47 ..
4.3.d:
ये त्वां वदंति सर्वेशं ते किं जानंति तत्त्वतः ॥
भगवान्सर्वभूतात्मा नदीं संभोक्तुमिच्छति ॥ 47 ॥
4.3.m:
Those who call you the lord of all—do they know the truth?
The Blessed One, the self of all beings, desires to enjoy a river!'

4.3.s:
ityuktvā rādhikā devī virarāma ruṣā'nvitā ..
nottasthau bhūmiśayanādgopīlakṣasamanvitā..48 ..
4.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा राधिका देवी विरराम रुषाऽन्विता ॥
नोत्तस्थौ भूमिशयनाद्गोपीलक्षसमन्विता॥48 ॥
4.3.m:
Having spoken thus, the goddess Rādhikā ceased, filled with anger.
Surrounded by a hundred thousand gopīs, she did not rise from her bed on the ground.

4.3.s:
kāściccāmarahastāśca kāścitsūkṣmāṃśukāṃbarāḥ ..
kāścittāṃbūlahastāśca kāścinmālākarā varāḥ .. 49 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चिच्चामरहस्ताश्च काश्चित्सूक्ष्मांशुकांबराः ॥
काश्चित्तांबूलहस्ताश्च काश्चिन्मालाकरा वराः ॥ 49 ॥
4.3.m:
Some had chowries in hand, some wore fine muslin garments,
some had betel in hand, and some excellent ones held garlands in their hands;

4.3.s:
vāsitodakarāḥ kāścitkāścitpadmakarā varāḥ ..
kāścitsiṃdūrahastāśca pānahastāśca kāścana .. 4.3.50 ..
4.3.d:
वासितोदकराः काश्चित्काश्चित्पद्मकरा वराः ॥
काश्चित्सिंदूरहस्ताश्च पानहस्ताश्च काश्चन ॥ 4.3.50 ॥
4.3.m:
some held perfumed water, and some excellent ones held lotuses in their hands.
Some had vermilion in their hands, and some held betel.

4.3.s:
ratnālaṃkārahastāśca kāścitkajjalavāhikāḥ ..
veṇuvīṇākarāḥ kāścitkāścitkaṃkatikākarāḥ .. 51 ..
4.3.d:
रत्नालंकारहस्ताश्च काश्चित्कज्जलवाहिकाः ॥
वेणुवीणाकराः काश्चित्काश्चित्कंकतिकाकराः ॥ 51 ॥
4.3.m:
Some held jewelled ornaments, and some carried collyrium.
Some held flutes and vīṇās, and some held combs in their hands.

4.3.s:
kāścidāvīrahastāśca yaṃtrahastāśca kāścana ..
sugaṃdhitailahastāśca kāścana pramadottamāḥ .. 52 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चिदावीरहस्ताश्च यंत्रहस्ताश्च काश्चन ॥
सुगंधितैलहस्ताश्च काश्चन प्रमदोत्तमाः ॥ 52 ॥
4.3.m:
Some held colored powder (ābīra) in their hands, and some held musical instruments.
And some excellent women held fragrant oils in their hands.

4.3.s:
karatālakarāḥ kāścidgeṃduhastāśca kāścana ..
kāścinmṛdaṃgamurajamuralītānakārikāḥ .. 53 ..
4.3.d:
करतालकराः काश्चिद्गेंदुहस्ताश्च काश्चन ॥
काश्चिन्मृदंगमुरजमुरलीतानकारिकाः ॥ 53 ॥
4.3.m:
Some held cymbals, and some held balls in their hands.
Some played musical tunes on mṛdaṅgas, muraja drums, and flutes.

4.3.s:
saṃgītanipuṇāḥ kāścitkāścinnartanatatparāḥ ..
krīḍāvastukarāḥ kāścinmadhuhastāśca kāścana .. 54 ..
4.3.d:
संगीतनिपुणाः काश्चित्काश्चिन्नर्तनतत्पराः ॥
क्रीडावस्तुकराः काश्चिन्मधुहस्ताश्च काश्चन ॥ 54 ॥
4.3.m:
Some were skilled in music, and some were intent on dancing.
Some held playthings, and some held honey in their hands.

4.3.s:
sudhāpātrakarāḥ kāścidaṃghripīṭhakarāḥ parāḥ ..
veṣavastukarāḥ kāścitkāściccaraṇasevikāḥ .. 55 ..
4.3.d:
सुधापात्रकराः काश्चिदंघ्रिपीठकराः पराः ॥
वेषवस्तुकराः काश्चित्काश्चिच्चरणसेविकाः ॥ 55 ॥
4.3.m:
Some held nectar cups in their hands, and other [women] held footstools.
Some held apparel and garments, and some attended to her feet.

4.3.s:
puṭāṃjalikarāḥ kāścitkāścitstutiparā varāḥ ..
evaṃ katividhāḥ saṃti rādhikāpurato mune .. 56 ..
4.3.d:
पुटांजलिकराः काश्चित्काश्चित्स्तुतिपरा वराः ॥
एवं कतिविधाः संति राधिकापुरतो मुने ॥ 56 ॥
4.3.m:
Some made cupped hands in reverence, and some excellent women were devoted to praising her.
In this way, of how many kinds were they before Rādhikā, O sage!

4.3.s:
bahirdeśasthitāḥ kāścitkoṭiśaḥ koṭiśaḥ sadā ..
kāściddvāraniyuktāśca vayasyā vetradhārikāḥ .. 57 ..
4.3.d:
बहिर्देशस्थिताः काश्चित्कोटिशः कोटिशः सदा ॥
काश्चिद्द्वारनियुक्ताश्च वयस्या वेत्रधारिकाः ॥ 57 ॥
4.3.m:
Always tens of millions stood in the outer area.
And some female companions, stationed at the door, were cane-bearers.

4.3.s:
kṛṣṇamabhyaṃtaraṃ gaṃtuṃ na dadurdvārasaṃsthitāḥ ..
puraḥsthitaṃ taṃ prāṇeśaṃ rādhā punaruvāca sā ..
nānurūpamatyakathyayamayogyamatikarkaśam .. 58 ..
4.3.d:
कृष्णमभ्यंतरं गंतुं न ददुर्द्वारसंस्थिताः ॥
पुरःस्थितं तं प्राणेशं राधा पुनरुवाच सा ॥
नानुरूपमत्यकथ्ययमयोग्यमतिकर्कशम् ॥ 58 ॥
4.3.m:
Stationed at the door, they did not allow Kṛṣṇa to enter inside.
Seeing that lord of her life standing before her, Rādhā spoke again—
[words] that were improper, utterly unspeakable, unworthy, and extremely harsh.

4.3.s:
.. rādhikovāca ..
he kṛṣṇa virajākāṃta gaccha matpurato hare ..
kathaṃ dunoṣi māṃ lola raticaurātilaṃpaṭa .. 59 ..
4.3.d:
॥ राधिकोवाच ॥
हे कृष्ण विरजाकांत गच्छ मत्पुरतो हरे ॥
कथं दुनोषि मां लोल रतिचौरातिलंपट ॥ 59 ॥
4.3.m:
"O Kṛṣṇa, lover of Virajā! Go away from my presence, O Hari!
Why do you torment me, you fickle thief of pleasure, you extreme libertine?

4.3.s:
śīghraṃ padmāvatīṃ gaccha ratnamālāṃ manoramām ..
athavā vanamālāṃ vā rūpeṇāpratimāṃ vraja .. 4.3.60 ..
4.3.d:
शीघ्रं पद्मावतीं गच्छ रत्नमालां मनोरमाम् ॥
अथवा वनमालां वा रूपेणाप्रतिमां व्रज ॥ 4.3.60 ॥
4.3.m:
Go quickly to Padmāvatī, or to charming Ratnamālā,
or go to Vanamālā, who is peerless in beauty!

4.3.s:
he nadīkāṃta deveśa devānāṃ ca gurorguro ..
mayā jñāto'si bhadraṃ te gaccha gaccha mamāśramāt .. 63 ..
4.3.d:
हे नदीकांत देवेश देवानां च गुरोर्गुरो ॥
मया ज्ञातोऽसि भद्रं ते गच्छ गच्छ ममाश्रमात् ॥ 63 ॥
4.3.m:
O lover of the river, O lord of gods, O teacher of the teacher of the gods,
I have found you out! Good luck to you; go, go from my abode!

4.3.s:
śaśvatte mānuṣāṇāṃ ca vyavahārasya laṃpaṭa ..
labhatāṃ mānuṣīṃ yoniṃ golokādvraja bhāratam .. 62 ..
4.3.d:
शश्वत्ते मानुषाणां च व्यवहारस्य लंपट ॥
लभतां मानुषीं योनिं गोलोकाद्व्रज भारतम् ॥ 62 ॥
4.3.m:
You always behave like a human libertine!
May you attain a human womb! Go from Goloka to Bhārata!

4.3.s:
he suśīle śaśikale he padmāvati mādhavi ..
nivāryatāṃ ca dhūrto'yaṃ kiṃmasyātra prayojanam .. 63 ..
4.3.d:
हे सुशीले शशिकले हे पद्मावति माधवि ॥
निवार्यतां च धूर्तोऽयं किंमस्यात्र प्रयोजनम् ॥ 63 ॥
4.3.m:
O Suśīlā, O Śaśikalā, O Padmāvatī, O Mādhavī,
turn this rogue away! What need is there of him here?"

4.3.s:
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tamūcurgopikā harim ..
hitaṃ tathyaṃ ca vinayaṃ sāraṃ yatsamayocitam .. 64 ..
4.3.d:
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा तमूचुर्गोपिका हरिम् ॥
हितं तथ्यं च विनयं सारं यत्समयोचितम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.3.m:
Hearing Rādhikā's words, the gopīs spoke to Hari,
[words] that were beneficial, true, courteous, substantial, and suited to the occasion.

4.3.s:
kāścidūcuriti hare gaccha sthānāṃtaraṃ kṣaṇam ..
rādhākopāpanayane hyāgamiṣyāmahe vayam .. 69 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चिदूचुरिति हरे गच्छ स्थानांतरं क्षणम् ॥
राधाकोपापनयने ह्यागमिष्यामहे वयम् ॥ 69 ॥
4.3.m:
Some spoke thus: "O Hari, go to another place for a moment.
When Rādhā's anger is dispelled, we shall surely come."

4.3.s:
kāścidūcuriti prītyā kṣaṇaṃ gaccha gṛhāṃtaram ..
tvayaiva vardhitā rādhā tvāṃ vinā kaṃ ca vakṣyati .. 66 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चिदूचुरिति प्रीत्या क्षणं गच्छ गृहांतरम् ॥
त्वयैव वर्धिता राधा त्वां विना कं च वक्ष्यति ॥ 66 ॥
4.3.m:
Some said affectionately: "Go to another chamber for a moment.
Rādhā was nurtured by you alone; whom will she speak to without you?"

4.3.s:
kāścidūcuriti premṇā rādhikāyāṃ hariṃ mune ..
kṣaṇaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ gaccha mānāpanayanāvadhi .. 67 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चिदूचुरिति प्रेम्णा राधिकायां हरिं मुने ॥
क्षणं वृंदावनं गच्छ मानापनयनावधि ॥ 67 ॥
4.3.m:
Some said lovingly to Hari concerning Rādhikā, O sage:
"Go to Vṛndāvana for a moment, until her injured pride is dispelled."

4.3.s:
kāścidityūcurīśaṃ ca parihāsaparaṃ vacaḥ ..
mānāpanayanaṃ bhaktyā māninyāḥ kuru kāmuka .. 68 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चिदित्यूचुरीशं च परिहासपरं वचः ॥
मानापनयनं भक्त्या मानिन्याः कुरु कामुक ॥ 68 ॥
4.3.m:
Some spoke mockingly to the Lord:
"Dispel the injured pride of that proud woman with devotion, O passionate lover!"

4.3.s:
kāścanocuritīśaṃ taṃ yāhi jāyāṃtaraṃ tava ..
lolupasya kathaṃ nātha kariṣyāmo yathocitam .. 69 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चनोचुरितीशं तं याहि जायांतरं तव ॥
लोलुपस्य कथं नाथ करिष्यामो यथोचितम् ॥ 69 ॥
4.3.m:
Some said to that Lord: "Go to your other wife.
How can we do what is proper for a covetous person, O Lord?"

4.3.s:
kāścanocuriti hariṃ sasmitaṃ purataḥ sthitam ..
gatvā samīpamutthāya mānāpanayanaṃ kuru .. 4.3.70 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चनोचुरिति हरिं सस्मितं पुरतः स्थितम् ॥
गत्वा समीपमुत्थाय मानापनयनं कुरु ॥ 4.3.70 ॥
4.3.m:
Some said to Hari, who stood smiling before them:
"Having approached and stood near her, dispel her injured pride."

4.3.s:
kāścanocuriti prāṇanāthaṃ gopyo durakṣaram ..
kaḥ kṣamaḥ sāṃprataṃ draṣṭaṃ rādhikāmukhapaṃkajam .. 71 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चनोचुरिति प्राणनाथं गोप्यो दुरक्षरम् ॥
कः क्षमः सांप्रतं द्रष्टं राधिकामुखपंकजम् ॥ 71 ॥
4.3.m:
Some gopīs spoke harsh words to the lord of their life:
"Who is capable of looking upon Rādhikā's lotus-face right now?"

4.3.s:
kāścanocuriti vibhuṃ vraja sthānāṃtaraṃ hare ..
kopāpanayane kāle punarāgamanaṃ tava .. 72 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चनोचुरिति विभुं व्रज स्थानांतरं हरे ॥
कोपापनयने काले पुनरागमनं तव ॥ 72 ॥
4.3.m:
Some said to the all-pervading Lord: "Go to another place, O Hari!
When her anger is dispelled, you may return."

4.3.s:
kāścanocuritīdaṃ taṃ pragalbhāḥ pramadottamāḥ ..
vayaṃ tvāṃ dārayiṣyāmo na cedyāhi gṛhāṃtaram .. 73 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चनोचुरितीदं तं प्रगल्भाः प्रमदोत्तमाः ॥
वयं त्वां दारयिष्यामो न चेद्याहि गृहांतरम् ॥ 73 ॥
4.3.m:
Some bold, excellent women said this to him:
"We shall tear you to pieces! If not, go to another house!"

4.3.s:
kāścinnivārayāmāsurmādhavaṃ pramadottamāḥ ..
smitavaktraṃ ca sarveśaṃ svasthamakrodhamīśvaram .. 74 ..
4.3.d:
काश्चिन्निवारयामासुर्माधवं प्रमदोत्तमाः ॥
स्मितवक्त्रं च सर्वेशं स्वस्थमक्रोधमीश्वरम् ॥ 74 ॥
4.3.m:
Some excellent women turned Mādhava away—
the Lord who was smiling-faced, the Lord of all, calm, and free from anger.

4.3.s:
gopīrbhirvāryamāṇe ca jagatkāraṇakāraṇe ..
sadyaścukopa śrīdāmā harau gehāṃtaraṃ gate .. 79 ..
4.3.d:
गोपीर्भिर्वार्यमाणे च जगत्कारणकारणे ॥
सद्यश्चुकोप श्रीदामा हरौ गेहांतरं गते ॥ 79 ॥
4.3.m:
While the Cause of all causes of the world was being turned away by the gopīs,
Śrīdāman suddenly became enraged as Hari went to another chamber.

4.3.s:
kopāduvāca śrīdāmā rādhikāṃ parameśvarīm ..
raktapadmekṣaṇāṃ ruṣṭāṃ raktapaṃkajalocanām .. 76 ..
4.3.d:
कोपादुवाच श्रीदामा राधिकां परमेश्वरीम् ॥
रक्तपद्मेक्षणां रुष्टां रक्तपंकजलोचनाम् ॥ 76 ॥
4.3.m:
In anger, Śrīdāman spoke to the supreme sovereign Rādhikā,
whose eyes were like red lotuses, who was furious, her eyes reddened like a red lotus.

4.3.s:
.. śrīdāmovāca .. ..
kathaṃ vadasi mātastvaṃ kaṭuvākyaṃ madīśvaram ..
vicāraṇāṃ vinā devi karoṣi bhartsanaṃ vṛthā .. 77 ..
4.3.d:
॥ श्रीदामोवाच ॥ ॥
कथं वदसि मातस्त्वं कटुवाक्यं मदीश्वरम् ॥
विचारणां विना देवि करोषि भर्त्सनं वृथा ॥ 77 ॥
4.3.m:
"Why, O Mother, do you speak harsh words to my Lord?
Without reflection, O goddess, you rebuke him in vain!

4.3.s:
brahmānaṃteśadeveśaṃ jagatkāraṇakāraṇam ..
vāṇīpadmālayāmāyāprakṛtīśaṃ ca nirguṇam .. 78 ..
4.3.d:
ब्रह्मानंतेशदेवेशं जगत्कारणकारणम् ॥
वाणीपद्मालयामायाप्रकृतीशं च निर्गुणम् ॥ 78 ॥
4.3.m:
[To him who is] the Lord of gods, of Brahmā, and of Ananta; the Cause of all causes of the world;
the Lord of Sarasvatī, of Padmā, of Māyā and of Prakṛti, and without attributes!

4.3.s:
svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ karoṣi tvaṃ viḍaṃbanam ..
devīnāṃ pravarā tvaṃ ca nibodha yasya sevayā .. 79 ..
4.3.d:
स्वात्मारामं पूर्णकामं करोषि त्वं विडंबनम् ॥
देवीनां प्रवरा त्वं च निबोध यस्य सेवया ॥ 79 ॥
4.3.m:
You mock him who delights in his own Self and whose desires are completely fulfilled.
Know, O foremost of goddesses, that it is through his service

4.3.s:
yasya pādārcanenaiva sarveṣāmīśvarī parā ..
tanna jānāsi kalyāṇi kimahaṃ vaktumīśvaraḥ .. 4.3.80 ..
4.3.d:
यस्य पादार्चनेनैव सर्वेषामीश्वरी परा ॥
तन्न जानासि कल्याणि किमहं वक्तुमीश्वरः ॥ 4.3.80 ॥
4.3.m:
and by worshipping his feet alone that you are the supreme ruler over all.
Do you not know this, auspicious lady? What am I able to say?

4.3.s:
bhrūbhaṃgalīlayā kṛṣṇaḥ sraṣṭuṃ śaktaśca tvadvidhāḥ ..
koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo devyastaṃ na jānāsi nirguṇam .. 81 ..
4.3.d:
भ्रूभंगलीलया कृष्णः स्रष्टुं शक्तश्च त्वद्विधाः ॥
कोटिशः कोटिशो देव्यस्तं न जानासि निर्गुणम् ॥ 81 ॥
4.3.m:
With the mere playful knitting of his brow, Kṛṣṇa is capable of creating
millions upon millions of goddesses like you; you do not know him who is beyond the gunas.

4.3.s:
vaikuṃṭhe śrīharerasya caraṇāṃbujamārjanam ..
karoti keśaiḥ śaśvacchrīḥ sevanaṃ bhaktipūrvakam .. 82 ..
4.3.d:
वैकुंठे श्रीहरेरस्य चरणांबुजमार्जनम् ॥
करोति केशैः शश्वच्छ्रीः सेवनं भक्तिपूर्वकम् ॥ 82 ॥
4.3.m:
In Vaikuṇṭha, Śrī wipes the lotus feet of Śrī Hari
with her hair, serving him constantly with devotion.

4.3.s:
sarasvatī ca stavanaiḥ karṇapīyūṣasuṃdaraiḥ ..
satataṃ stauti yaṃ bhaktyā na jānāsi tamīśvaram .. 83 ..
4.3.d:
सरस्वती च स्तवनैः कर्णपीयूषसुंदरैः ॥
सततं स्तौति यं भक्त्या न जानासि तमीश्वरम् ॥ 83 ॥
4.3.m:
And Sarasvatī, with hymns of praise sweet as nectar to the ear,
praises him continually with devotion; you do not know that Lord.

4.3.s:
bhītā ca prakṛtirmāyā sarveṣāṃ bījarūpiṇī ..
satataṃ stauti yaṃ bhaktyā taṃ na jānāsi mānini .. 84 ..
4.3.d:
भीता च प्रकृतिर्माया सर्वेषां बीजरूपिणी ॥
सततं स्तौति यं भक्त्या तं न जानासि मानिनि ॥ 84 ॥
4.3.m:
Prakṛti, who is Māyā and the seed of all beings, in awe
praises him continually with devotion; you do not know him, proud lady.

4.3.s:
stuvaṃti satataṃ vedā mahimnaḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ..
kadāpi na vijānaṃti taṃ na jānāsi bhāmini .. 85 ..
4.3.d:
स्तुवंति सततं वेदा महिम्नः षोडशीं कलाम् ॥
कदापि न विजानंति तं न जानासि भामिनि ॥ 85 ॥
4.3.m:
The Vedas continually praise him, yet they never comprehend
even a sixteenth part of his majesty; you do not know him, passionate lady.

4.3.s:
vaktraiścaturbhiryaṃ brahmā vedānāṃ janako vibhuḥ ..
stauti sevāṃ ca kurute caraṇāṃbujamīśvari .. 86 ..
4.3.d:
वक्त्रैश्चतुर्भिर्यं ब्रह्मा वेदानां जनको विभुः ॥
स्तौति सेवां च कुरुते चरणांबुजमीश्वरि ॥ 86 ॥
4.3.m:
The all-pervading Brahmā, the father of the Vedas, with four faces
praises him and serves his lotus feet, O sovereign lady.

4.3.s:
śaṃkaraḥ paṃcabhirvaktraiḥ stauti yaṃ yogināṃ guruḥ ..
sāśrupūrṇaḥ sapulakaḥ sevate caraṇāṃbujam .. 87 ..
4.3.d:
शंकरः पंचभिर्वक्त्रैः स्तौति यं योगिनां गुरुः ॥
साश्रुपूर्णः सपुलकः सेवते चरणांबुजम् ॥ 87 ॥
4.3.m:
Śaṅkara, the guru of yogins, praises him with five faces
and, filled with tears and bristling with joy, serves his lotus feet.

4.3.s:
śeṣaḥ sahasravadanaiḥ paramātmānamīśvaram ..
satataṃ stauti yaṃ bhaktyā sevate caraṇāṃbujam .. 88 ..
4.3.d:
शेषः सहस्रवदनैः परमात्मानमीश्वरम् ॥
सततं स्तौति यं भक्त्या सेवते चरणांबुजम् ॥ 88 ॥
4.3.m:
Śeṣa, with a thousand mouths,
continually praises the Lord, the Paramātman, with devotion, and serves his lotus feet.

4.3.s:
dharmaḥpātā ca sarveṣāṃ sākṣī ca jagatāṃ patiḥ ..
bhaktyā ca caraṇāṃbhojaṃ sevate satataṃ mudā..89..
4.3.d:
धर्मःपाता च सर्वेषां साक्षी च जगतां पतिः ॥
भक्त्या च चरणांभोजं सेवते सततं मुदा॥89॥
4.3.m:
Dharma, the protector of all, the witness, the lord of the worlds,
continually serves his lotus feet with devotion and joy.

4.3.s:
śvetadvīpanivāsī yaḥ pātā viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ vibhuḥ ..
tasyāṃśaśca tathā yaṃ yaṃ dhāryate'pyakṣaraṃ param ..4.3.90..
4.3.d:
श्वेतद्वीपनिवासी यः पाता विष्णुः स्वयं विभुः ॥
तस्यांशश्च तथा यं यं धार्यतेऽप्यक्षरं परम् ॥4.3.90॥
4.3.m:
The all-pervading Viṣṇu himself, the protector who dwells in Śvetadvīpa,
is his portion, and he continually meditates upon him, the supreme imperishable one.

4.3.s:
surāsuramunīṃdrāśca manavo mānavā budhāḥ ..
sevaṃte na hi paśyaṃti svapne'pi caraṇāṃbujam..91..
4.3.d:
सुरासुरमुनींद्राश्च मनवो मानवा बुधाः ॥
सेवंते न हि पश्यंति स्वप्नेऽपि चरणांबुजम्॥91॥
4.3.m:
Gods, asuras, foremost sages, Manus, and wise mortals
serve him, yet they do not behold his lotus feet even in a dream.

4.3.s:
kṣipraṃ roṣaṃ parityajya bhaja pādāṃbujaṃ hareḥ..
bhrūbhaṃgalīlāmātreṇa sṛṣṭisaṃhartureva ca .. 92 ..
4.3.d:
क्षिप्रं रोषं परित्यज्य भज पादांबुजं हरेः॥
भ्रूभंगलीलामात्रेण सृष्टिसंहर्तुरेव च ॥ 92 ॥
4.3.m:
Cast off your anger at once and worship the lotus feet of Hari,
the destroyer of creation by the mere playful knitting of his brow.

4.3.s:
nimeṣamātrādasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhavet ..
yasyaikadivase'pyaṣṭāviṃśatīṃdrāḥ pataṃtyapi .. 93 ..
4.3.d:
निमेषमात्रादस्यैव ब्रह्मणः पतनं भवेत् ॥
यस्यैकदिवसेऽप्यष्टाविंशतींद्राः पतंत्यपि ॥ 93 ॥
4.3.m:
By a mere twinkling of his eye, Brahmā's fall takes place;
in whose single day even twenty-eight Indras fall;

4.3.s:
evamaṣṭottaraśatamāyuryasya jagadvidheḥ ..
tvaṃ vā kā'nyāśca vā rādhe madīśvaravaśe'khilam ..94..
4.3.d:
एवमष्टोत्तरशतमायुर्यस्य जगद्विधेः ॥
त्वं वा काऽन्याश्च वा राधे मदीश्वरवशेऽखिलम् ॥94॥
4.3.m:
and such is the lifespan of that creator of the universe: one hundred and eight [years].
Who are you, or who are the others, O Rādhā? Everything is under my Lord's control."

4.3.s:
śrīdāmno vacanaṃ śrutvā kevalaṃ kaṭumujjvalam ..
sadyaścukopa sā brahmansadyaḥ prāṇeśvarī hareḥ .. 95 ..
4.3.d:
श्रीदाम्नो वचनं श्रुत्वा केवलं कटुमुज्ज्वलम् ॥
सद्यश्चुकोप सा ब्रह्मन्सद्यः प्राणेश्वरी हरेः ॥ 95 ॥
4.3.m:
Hearing Śrīdāman's speech, which was entirely bitter and fiery,
she, the beloved mistress of Hari's life, grew instantly enraged, O Brahman.

4.3.s:
rāseśvarī bahirgatvā tamuvāca ha niṣṭhuram ..
sphuradoṣṭhī muktakeśī raktāṃbhoruhalocanā ..96.. ..
4.3.d:
रासेश्वरी बहिर्गत्वा तमुवाच ह निष्ठुरम् ॥
स्फुरदोष्ठी मुक्तकेशी रक्तांभोरुहलोचना ॥96॥ ॥
4.3.m:
Going outside, the queen of the rāsa spoke harshly to him,
her lips quivering, her hair dishevelled, her eyes like red lotuses.

4.3.s:
rādhikovāca ..
rere jālma mahāmūḍha śṛṇu lèpaṭakiṃkara ..
tvaṃ ca jānāsi sarvārthaṃ na jānāmi tvadīśvaram .. 97 ..
4.3.d:
राधिकोवाच ॥
रेरे जाल्म महामूढ शृणु ल्èपटकिंकर ॥
त्वं च जानासि सर्वार्थं न जानामि त्वदीश्वरम् ॥ 97 ॥
4.3.m:
"Listen, you rogue, you great fool, servant of a libertine!
Do you know everything, while I do not know your Lord?

4.3.s:
tvadīśvaraśca śrīkṛṣṇo na hyasmākaṃ vrajādhama ..
jānāmi janakaṃ stauṣi sadā niṃdasi mātaram .. 98 ..
4.3.d:
त्वदीश्वरश्च श्रीकृष्णो न ह्यस्माकं व्रजाधम ॥
जानामि जनकं स्तौषि सदा निंदसि मातरम् ॥ 98 ॥
4.3.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa is your Lord, but not ours, vile cowherd!
I know you: you praise the father and always revile the mother.

4.3.s:
yathā'surāśca tridaśā nityaṃ niṃdaṃti saṃtatam ..
tathā niṃdasi māṃ mūḍha tasmāttvamasuro bhava .. 99 ..
4.3.d:
यथाऽसुराश्च त्रिदशा नित्यं निंदंति संततम् ॥
तथा निंदसि मां मूढ तस्मात्त्वमसुरो भव ॥ 99 ॥
4.3.m:
Just as the asuras always revile the gods,
so you revile me, you fool; therefore, become an asura!

4.3.s:
gopa vrajāsurīṃ yoniṃ golokācca bahirbhava ..
mayā'dya śapto mūḍhastvaṃ kastvāṃ rakṣitumīśvaraḥ .. 4.3.100 ..
4.3.d:
गोप व्रजासुरीं योनिं गोलोकाच्च बहिर्भव ॥
मयाऽद्य शप्तो मूढस्त्वं कस्त्वां रक्षितुमीश्वरः ॥ 4.3.100 ॥
4.3.m:
Go, cowherd, enter an asura's womb, and be gone from Goloka!
Cursed today by me, you fool, who is able to protect you?"

4.3.s:
rāseśvarī tamityuktvā suṣvāpa virarāma ca ..
vayasyāḥ sevayāmāsuścāmarai ratnamuṣṭibhiḥ .. 101 ..
4.3.d:
रासेश्वरी तमित्युक्त्वा सुष्वाप विरराम च ॥
वयस्याः सेवयामासुश्चामरै रत्नमुष्टिभिः ॥ 101 ॥
4.3.m:
Having spoken thus to him, the queen of the rāsa lay down and grew quiet;
her companions served her with fly-whisks having jeweled handles.

4.3.s:
śrutvā ca vacanaṃ tasyāḥ kopena sphuritādharaḥ ..
śaśāpa tāṃ ca śrīdāmā vraja yoniṃ ca mānuṣīm ..
śrīdāmovāca .. ..
mānuṣyā iva kopaste tasmāttvaṃ mānuṣī bhuvi .. 102 ..
4.3.d:
श्रुत्वा च वचनं तस्याः कोपेन स्फुरिताधरः ॥
शशाप तां च श्रीदामा व्रज योनिं च मानुषीम् ॥
श्रीदामोवाच ॥ ॥
मानुष्या इव कोपस्ते तस्मात्त्वं मानुषी भुवि ॥ 102 ॥
4.3.m:
Hearing her words, Śrīdāman, his lower lip quivering with rage,
cursed her in return: "Go to a human womb!"
"Your anger is like that of mortals; therefore, you shall become a mortal on earth

4.3.s:
bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho mayā śaptā tvamaṃbike ..
chāyayā kalayā vā'pi paraśaktyā kalaṃkinā .. 103 ..
4.3.d:
भविष्यसि न संदेहो मया शप्ता त्वमंबिके ॥
छायया कलया वाऽपि परशक्त्या कलंकिना ॥ 103 ॥
4.3.m:
without doubt, cursed by me, O Ambikā!
By shadow, or by part, or by supreme power, marked with blemish,

4.3.s:
mūḍhā rāpāṇapatnī tvāṃ vakṣyati jagatītale ..
rāpāṇaḥ śrīhareraṃśo vaiśyo vṛṃdāvane vane .. 104 ..
4.3.d:
मूढा रापाणपत्नी त्वां वक्ष्यति जगतीतले ॥
रापाणः श्रीहरेरंशो वैश्यो वृंदावने वने ॥ 104 ॥
4.3.m:
the foolish world will call you the wife of Rāpāṇa on the earthly plane.
Rāpāṇa, a portion of Śrī Hari, will be a Vaiśya

4.3.s:
bhaviṣyati mahāyogī rādhāśāpena garbhajaḥ ..
gokule prāpya taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vihariṣyasi kānane .. 105 ..
4.3.d:
भविष्यति महायोगी राधाशापेन गर्भजः ॥
गोकुले प्राप्य तं कृष्णं विहरिष्यसि कानने ॥ 105 ॥
4.3.m:
in the forest of Vṛndāvana, born of a womb as a great yogin through Rādhā's curse.
Attaining that Kṛṣṇa in Gokula, you will sport in the grove;

4.3.s:
bhavitā te varṣaśataṃ vicchedo hariṇā saha ..
punaḥ prāpya tamīśaṃ ca golokamāgamiṣyasi.. 106 ..
4.3.d:
भविता ते वर्षशतं विच्छेदो हरिणा सह ॥
पुनः प्राप्य तमीशं च गोलोकमागमिष्यसि॥ 106 ॥
4.3.m:
there will be a separation of one hundred years for you from Hari.
Having attained that Lord again, you will return to Goloka."

4.3.s:
tāmityuktvā ca natvā ca sa jagāma hareḥ puraḥ ..
gatvā praṇamya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śāpākhyānamuvāca ha .. 107 ..
4.3.d:
तामित्युक्त्वा च नत्वा च स जगाम हरेः पुरः ॥
गत्वा प्रणम्य श्रीकृष्णं शापाख्यानमुवाच ह ॥ 107 ॥
4.3.m:
Having spoken thus to her and bowed down, he went before Hari.
Having gone and bowed down before Śrī Kṛṣṇa, he told the tale of the curse.

4.3.s:
ānupūrvyāttu tatsarvaṃ ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ punaḥ ..
uvāca taṃ rudaṃtaṃ ca gacchadhvaṃ dharaṇītalam .. 108 ..
4.3.d:
आनुपूर्व्यात्तु तत्सर्वं रुरोद च भृशं पुनः ॥
उवाच तं रुदंतं च गच्छध्वं धरणीतलम् ॥ 108 ॥
4.3.m:
After [telling] it all in order, he wept bitterly again.
[The Lord] said to him as he wept: “Go to the earth's surface.

4.3.s:
na jetā te tribhuvane hyasureṃdro bhaviṣyasi ..
kāle śaṃkaraśūlena dehaṃ tyaktvā mamāṃtikam.. 109 ..
4.3.d:
न जेता ते त्रिभुवने ह्यसुरेंद्रो भविष्यसि ॥
काले शंकरशूलेन देहं त्यक्त्वा ममांतिकम्॥ 109 ॥
4.3.m:
There will be no conqueror over you in the three worlds, for you will become king of the asuras.
In time, having cast off your body by Śaṅkara's trident, you will come

4.3.s:
āgamiṣyasi paṃcāśadyugāṃte tu mamāśiṣā ..
śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā tamuvāca śucā'nvitaḥ .. 4.3.110 ..
4.3.d:
आगमिष्यसि पंचाशद्युगांते तु ममाशिषा ॥
श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तमुवाच शुचाऽन्वितः ॥ 4.3.110 ॥
4.3.m:
near me at the end of fifty yugas by my blessing.”
Hearing Śrī Kṛṣṇa's words, filled with sorrow, he said to him:

4.3.s:
tvadbhaktirahitaṃ māṃ ca kadācinna kariṣyasi ..
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ natvā jagāma svāśramādbahiḥ .. 111 ..
4.3.d:
त्वद्भक्तिरहितं मां च कदाचिन्न करिष्यसि ॥
इत्युक्त्वा श्रीहरिं नत्वा जगाम स्वाश्रमाद्बहिः ॥ 111 ॥
4.3.m:
“Never make me bereft of devotion to you.”
Having said this and bowed to Śrī Hari, he went outside his hermitage.

4.3.s:
paścājjagāma sā devī ruroda ca punaḥpunaḥ ..
kva yāsi vatsetyuccārya vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ satī ..112..
4.3.d:
पश्चाज्जगाम सा देवी रुरोद च पुनःपुनः ॥
क्व यासि वत्सेत्युच्चार्य विललाप भृशं सती ॥112॥
4.3.m:
Afterwards the goddess went and wept again and again.
Calling out, “Where are you going, my child?”, the virtuous woman wailed bitterly.

4.3.s:
śrīdāmā'pi ca tāṃ natvā ruroda premavihvalaḥ ..
sa eva śaṃkhacūḍaśca babhūva tulasīpatiḥ.. 113 ..
4.3.d:
श्रीदामाऽपि च तां नत्वा रुरोद प्रेमविह्वलः ॥
स एव शंखचूडश्च बभूव तुलसीपतिः॥ 113 ॥
4.3.m:
Śrīdāman too, having bowed to her, wept, overwhelmed with love.
He indeed became Śaṅkhacūḍa, the husband of Tulasī.

4.3.s:
gate śrīdāmni sā devī jagāmeśvarasannidhim ..
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa hariḥ pratyuttaraṃ dadau .. 114 ..
4.3.d:
गते श्रीदाम्नि सा देवी जगामेश्वरसन्निधिम् ॥
सर्वं निवेदयामास हरिः प्रत्युत्तरं ददौ ॥ 114 ॥
4.3.m:
When Śrīdāman had gone, the goddess went into the presence of the Lord.
She related everything, [and] Hari gave an answer.

4.3.s:
śokāturāṃ ca tāṃ kṛṣṇo bodhayāmāsa preyasīm ..
śaṃkhacūḍaśca kālena saṃprāpa punarīśvaram .. 115 ..
4.3.d:
शोकातुरां च तां कृष्णो बोधयामास प्रेयसीम् ॥
शंखचूडश्च कालेन संप्राप पुनरीश्वरम् ॥ 115 ॥
4.3.m:
Kṛṣṇa comforted his beloved who was afflicted with grief.
And Śaṅkhacūḍa in time attained the Lord once more.

4.3.s:
rādhā jagāma dharaṇīṃ vārāhe hariṇā saha ..
vṛṣabhānugṛhe janma lalābha gokule mune .. 116 ..
4.3.d:
राधा जगाम धरणीं वाराहे हरिणा सह ॥
वृषभानुगृहे जन्म ललाभ गोकुले मुने ॥ 116 ॥
4.3.m:
Rādhā went to the earth in the Vārāha [kalpa] together with Hari;
she took birth in the house of Vṛṣabhānu in Gokula, O sage.

4.3.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇākhyānamaṃgalam ..
sarveṣāṃ vāṃchitaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ..117..
4.3.d:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं श्रीकृष्णाख्यानमंगलम् ॥
सर्वेषां वांछितं सारं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥117॥
4.3.m:
Thus all the auspicious tale of Śrī Kṛṣṇa has been related,
the essence desired by all. What more do you wish to hear?
